messages.1742: "...I don't remember hearing that about votive pictures."
messages.1817: "W, well, no, but I don't want you to looook..."
messages.1879:
She held it even tighter to her body, turning her back to
me.
messages.1935:
"Oh well, okay. If you don't want me to know so much, I
don't really want to know either."
messages.2049: "Thank you... what about you, what are you doing here...?"
messages.2254: "You can do that in a shrine?"
messages.2299:
"That's what I came here to find out. If God is indeed
almighty, I'm sure he could do it."
messages.2381: Although, I don't know much about the God they worship here.
messages.2570:
Accompanied by Nanako, we passed through the front of the
shrine, and started walking within the grounds.
messages.2675: "Oh yeah, isn't she from your class?"
messages.2771:
"That priestess transfer student I've been eharing so much
about."
messages.2873: "What kind of person do you think she is?"
messages.2978: She was a little outrageous at certain times, but.
messages.3019:
The biggest question was, why she just announced to everyone
that I was her fiancee, like that.
messages.3124:
I spoke vaguely, while racking my brain for a good
description.
messages.3169: "To put it in a single word, she's--"
messages.3276: Nanako and I turned towards the direction of the voice.
messages.3368: She wore a elegant Miko robe, with a scarlet Hakama.
messages.3413:
No matter how you look at it, she resembled the complete
Miko.
messages.3538: She bowed politely. Her eyes then strayed to my side.
messages.3634: "Might you be a friend of Asakura-sama's?"
messages.3761: Nanako's eyes were glittering as they stared at Tamaki.
messages.3819: Tamaki's words didn't penetrate her trance.
messages.3907:
With a slightly flustered face, she called out to Nanako
again.
messages.4007: "Haah, eh...? Ahh! I did it again..."
messages.4080:
"My name is Konomiya Tamaki. You would be a friend of
Asakura-sama's, right?"
messages.4180:
"Ah, yes. A lot kinda happened this morning, but being
friends would be a good way to put it..."
messages.4301: Nanako stole a glance at me.
messages.4472:
With a smile, she removed her glasses, wiping them with her
handkerchief.
messages.4562:
"Then, I'm a friend of Asakura-kun's, Saitama Nanako. Nice
to meet you."
messages.4760: "Did the two of you come to pray today?"
messages.4838:
In the end, I couldn't really tell her that I was here to
exorcise a demon goat.
messages.5067:
...Or so I thought, as she suddenly whirled around to face
us.
messages.5141:
"By the way, it would be preferred if you walk at the sides
of the path."
messages.5243: Tamaki smiled lightly as she explained.
messages.5279:
"In past times, the peasants would walk to the sides, so as
not to interfere with the Gods walking through the middle."
messages.5473:
As she spoke, Nanako took out a pen and something else from
her pocket.
messages.5549:
Muttering "I see..." to herself, she started scribbling
furiously.
messages.5674:
"Gyahh! N, nothing! I was just thinking, hearing such a
ancient custom, that I had to make a memo of it..."
messages.5783: That was way more surprise than was needed, Nanako.
messages.5882:
Nanako shoved the memo pad back into her pocket, trying to
laugh it off.
messages.5959:
She was probably a little put off by Tamaki as well, looking
dignified in her element.
messages.6136: Tamaki set off, with us following. A cool wind blew past us.
messages.6229: After a short walk, we reached the hall of worship.
messages.6295: "The offering place for votive pictures is over there."
messages.6344:
Tamaki pointed to the side of the hall of worship, where
several votive pictures like Nanako's hung.
messages.6464: Nanako dashed over to that area, like a little kid.
messages.6542:
I wasn't really serious in thinking that I had to exorcise
that "demon goat" out of me.
messages.6630:
It's far more likely for that goat to be a simple domestic
animal rather than a tool of Satan.
messages.6764:
I walked up the stairs of the hall of worship, stopping in
front of the offertory box.
messages.6809: "(I better not fool around with Tamaki watching.)"
messages.6893:
Throwing a 5 yen coin inside, I waited for the sound of the
coin hitting the bottom of the box, and bowed.
messages.6963:
I clasped my hands together, and started to state my name
and wish, in my mind.
messages.7051:
"(I don't have much to wish for, but please protect me from
misfortune... oh, and please keep Nemu in good health.)"
messages.7207: For one last time, I bowed towards the hall of worship.
messages.7290: Nanako had returned from her own business too.
messages.7361:
"I still have matters to attend to at the shrine office, so
I shall take my leave."
messages.7443: With a bow, she slowly left.
messages.7496: As she disappeared from our view, Nanako sighed softly.
messages.7595:
"Konomiya-san's amazing... she's so pretty and composed,
it's hard to believe we're the same age."
messages.7724: "Her Miko clothes are so authentic as well."
messages.7833:
Especially to be able to ignore crowds and shoot arrows
right in the middle...
messages.7942:
But really, she has the looks, smarts, intelligence, even
sportiness.
messages.8061:
Why would a girl as perfect as that, call herself my
fiancee? That's a real puzzle.
messages.8135:
"(Suginami would immediately suspect alien conspiracies, for
sure...)"
messages.8216: I then noticed that Nanako was staring at me.
messages.8457: With dusk quickly approaching, we left the shrine.
messages.8676:
After school, I thought of the many misfortunes that befell
me today. I wanted to exorcise the demon goat that attacked
me.
messages.8793:
Heading to the only shrine on Hatsu-nejima, I found Nanako,
with a votive picture.
messages.8851:
While talking to Nanako, Tamaki found and brought us in,
teaching us about some of the etiquette used within the
shrine.
messages.8929:
Nanako was enamoured with the miko costume-clad Tamaki, the
person who called herself my fiancee...
messages.9033: We left the shrine at the coming of dusk.

messages.176:
Walking around idly around the Sakura Park, I happened upon
what seemed like a playground inside.
messages.232: I don't remember seeing this... I think.
messages.267:
No, I have vague memories of this place, but not actually
coming here...
messages.414: Nothing for me to do here anyway.
messages.443:
Although there's no kids around right now, I don't really
feel like playing around.
messages.537:
Well, maybe one day when I get the urge to re-live my
childhood...
messages.771: I don't remember it being there though...

messages.196: I saw a familiar hat in a queue for a food cart.
messages.489:
Her face lit up upon recognizing me. Somehow, her smile is
so infectious.
messages.610:
The front of the line is too far from here to see exactly
what's being sold.
messages.706: "Yes. My stomach was rumbling, and it was on the way, so..."
messages.770:
Kotori's quite famous around Kazami Academy. A lot of people
call her the "School Idol".
messages.858:
But just looking at her queueing up to buy food, she looks
like a perfectly normal girl.
messages.1028:
"Never heard of it? It's like a big piece of meat with a
stick pierced through it, then spun around constantly over a
fire..."
messages.1112:
"...And it's usually eaten on a piece of bread, with
vegetables in between."
messages.1212: "...I won't be able to eat something so filling now."
messages.1346:
"Recently, a vendor selling delicious crepes has started
coming around this park. It's famous around the school."
messages.1542:
While talking about that, Kotori's turn at the vendor
quickly came up.
messages.1730: "Alright, Asakura-kun, please take one. The treat's on me."
messages.1806: With a quick bow, I take one of the crepes.
messages.1968: Kotori was carrying a crepe in each hand.
messages.2060: "Ahh, I'd be eating both of these."
messages.2122: That would be about as filling as a Donel Kebab.
messages.2208: "...You think this would make me fat?"
messages.2337: We found a bench to sit on, and bit into our crepes.
messages.2473:
The sweetness of the crepe filled my tastebuds, and I closed
my eyes in bliss.
messages.2537:
Although it's a bit weird eating such a cold thing in
Feburary, it tastes just as good anytime.
messages.2589:
Besides, even though the air is cold, the sun is still
shining, it's rays showering gently onto the earth.
messages.2659:
"I didn't know you'd eat such a thing though. You've never
said before that you like sweets, have you?"
messages.2762: "I like sweet stuff of all sorts."
messages.2835:
"That's why I'm always thinking of going on a diet, they're
so fattening..."
messages.2916: I do a quick once-over of her with my eyes.
messages.2963: "I don't think you have anything to be worried about."
messages.3008:
She pretty much has the perfect body, with perfect
proportions.
messages.3133:
She muttered, as her face turned red and she looked away in
embarassment.
messages.3289: Said just like some old lady.
messages.3332:
"...Nah, more like you're a slow eater? ...Oh, the crepe's
fillings are oozing out..."
messages.3453:
...If she hadn't noticed the food dripping from her hand,
she'd have to be quite slow...
messages.3599: "Ah, I mean, what you said just now."
messages.3649:
We were talking about Kotori being slow on finshing her
crepe, I nearly forgot.
messages.3709: "Just eat it slowly and enjoy it."
messages.3799: I've already been treated to an ice crepe anyway.
messages.3855: "No, I mean... do you think you can eat one more?"
messages.3986:
The sun's rays were quickly turning the ice crepe into
liquid crepe.
messages.4095:
I tried to prepare my stomach somehow, and took one of the
crepes from Kotori.
messages.4218: "...I won't be able to stomach more than two."
messages.4324: With that, we continued eating the ice crepes together.
messages.4615:
I met Kotori at the Sakura Park, and she treated me to some
ice crepes.
messages.4699: They were great, but such cold stuff in the winter...

messages.240: Slowly savouring her ramen, Nemu was in paradise.
messages.341: "As good as it is, I'm getting sick of Chinese food."
messages.392:
Poking the remnants of my Chinese-style fried rice with my
work, I let out a little sigh.
messages.479:
"I suppose. There's still pizza, take-out, dinner
delivery... how do yo you want to rotate it?"
messages.587:
"No, what I meant was having something different from that
usual menu..."
messages.695: "If that's the case, have fun cooking dinner."
messages.734:
I nearly spit out my after-meal tea, under the scowling gaze
of Nemu.
messages.804:
"If you want me to cook, then don't complain about the
inedibility and cost of ingredients from the result."
messages.910:
"We don't have much money left... so leave the cooking to
me~"
messages.972: Nemu pointed to herself, or more accurately, her nose.
messages.1003: "....In any case, that can wait till after the tests."
messages.1061:
I'd rather pay an assassin to poison my food than taste her
cooking.
messages.1191:
She tilted her head to the side in what looked like an
impossible angle.
messages.1259:
Both ways, I'd have to start preparing my stomach now for
the torture to come...
messages.1310:
"You know, now that I think about it, convenience store food
really does have a large selection..."
messages.1428: Completely ignoring me, Nemu reached for my chopsticks.
messages.1560:
With a little sigh, and with nothing particular to watch on
TV, I went to my room on the second floor.
messages.1889: "What's the fuss about? Did you see a cockroach?"
messages.1936: Nemu's face came peeking out from the kitchen.
messages.1981: "Did we leave any beans from Bean Throwing Night?!"
messages.2140: I ran back up the stairs.
messages.2300:
I picked Sakura up from my bed, and put her on one of the
spare cushions lying around.
messages.2443: "Haa... where on earth did you come in here from?"
messages.2538: "Through the front door, using a key?"
messages.2588:
"By climbing up the sakura tree and through your window.
Didn't you hear me knock?"
messages.2656: Sakura pointed to the window just above the bed.
messages.2693: "...No one in the world would consider that normal."
messages.2762: "You said it would be fine before!"
messages.2805: "Huh? ...Aah, that was back when we were kids."
messages.2863: I fell back into a chair with a sigh.
messages.2896:
Sakura used to climb up the tree near her house to get into
my room to play, as it stretched all the way to my window.
messages.3017: That's right, we used to play well into the night...
messages.3081:
"But, at this age, going into a male's room so casually,
there's a lot of things wrong with that."
messages.3201: "Ah, ehehe. You look ready for that anyway."
messages.3271:
Sakura gave her best impression of a sultry smile, and
started lifting the hem of her skirt.
messages.3364:
Trying not to look, I shook my head from side to side
vigourously.
messages.3464: "What's wrong? Why's your face so red?"
messages.3509: "...Because of all your talk about being "ready"."
messages.3584:
"Psh, I'm wearing bloomers underneath after all. Want to
see?"
messages.3706:
The feeling of gazing at the blue sky is so invigorating...
It washes away the tears of the heart.
messages.3820:
"Aaaah, it would've been so much better if we were in the
same class..."
messages.3884: "...Don't say such terrifying things so easily."
messages.3992: "Don't mind me. Anyway, what did you come here for?"
messages.4056: Some night-viewing of sakura trees, maybe?
messages.4174: "You already made so much fuss about it in school..."
messages.4253:
"Boo! So you still don't want to welcome back someone who
moved away so long ago!"
messages.4325:
Sakura slapped her left knee with her right palm in disgust,
her eyebrows narrowing.
messages.4429:
"You listen! Yoshino Sakura, returning from faraway America,
has finally come back to the unwashed masses!"
messages.4557:
"From now on, I will mingle shoulder-to-shoulder with the
underpriveleged, and eventually take my rightful position at
the top of this mess!"
messages.4762:
"Basically, don't shut your door to someone who's just moved
in next to you♪"
messages.4832: "I don't see why that's a problem."
messages.4884:
"Don't say that~ When duty and personal feelings battle it
out, that duty should win is one of the world's laws-- isn't
it?"
messages.5088:
"What? Are you questioning my Japanese nationality? How
foolish!"
messages.5183: Sakura beat her chest in confidence.
messages.5306: "You're making fun of Japan, arenn't you..."
messages.5343: I point a half-hearted finger at her as I sighed.
messages.5407:
From childhood, she had taken the path of no return, and her
move overseas just further established the fact.
messages.5504:
Sushi, Tempura, Fujiyama... the transition from Japanese to
American appears to have been complete.
messages.5582: "Haah... Is that all you've got to say?"
messages.5652:
"Mmm, I guess. Anyways, I wanted to say, from now on, let's
be good neighbours!"
messages.5732: Still sitting on her cushion, she stuck out three fingers.
messages.5800: "Of course. As long as from now on..."
messages.5841:
From now on, you knock on the door and enter through the
hallway, just like a normal person.
messages.5963:
"Eheheh, that's right, you still haven't fixed the key for
that."
messages.6096: "They key for that window, it broke 6 years ago, remember?"
messages.6141: Grabbing my attention again, Sakura pointed to the window.
messages.6207:
Now that she's said that, Nemu's been insecure about that
and always bothering me to fix that window...
messages.6306: Although, the way I look at it, that's no problem at all.
messages.6360: "...That's because it's troublesome to do so."
messages.6530:
"Yeah, very convenient. Whenever I want to hang out with
you..."
messages.6594:
Sakura stood up and opened the window, then turned her head
around and giggled slightly.
messages.6662:
The cold air blew through, and the scent of sakuras could be
smelt; not a bad feeling at all.
messages.6766: "Hey, can you still make that come out?"
messages.6799:
Sakura stuck out her palm, then opened and closed it a few
times.
messages.6865:
I closed my hand up into a fist, and pictured an appropriate
wagashi--a manjuu, in my head.
messages.6931: Soon enough, my hand started getting a lot heavier.
messages.6993:
--As well as the power to see into dreams, the strange power
to create wagashis--
messages.7075: It really does sound like some strange fairytale.
messages.7110:
It's something that sounds so stupid that only Nemu, and of
course Sakura, knows about it.
messages.7215: "Lots of red bean in this one. Catch!"
messages.7295:
I threw the manjuu in the air, and Sakura, after a bout of
confusion, managed to hold onto it.
messages.7351:
"You better remember to brush your teeth after you eat
that."
messages.7483:
Acting childlike anyway, Sakura stuck out her tongue, then
started heading out the window.
messages.7618:
From the darkness outside the window, I could hear Sakura's
reply.
messages.7687: "Ah... Eheh, it's good to be back~"
messages.7752:
Sakura quickly dropped out the window, her figure
disappearing from sight.
messages.7806:
I could still see her hand grasping the branch of the Sakura
tree.
messages.7843:
Since I was a bit foolhardy in my younger days, the branch
still held the wound of being broken into half.
messages.7931: "That girl... she hasn't changed one bit."
messages.7978:
As the sakura continued fluttering right outside my window,
I went over and shut it.
messages.8191:
After dinner, when I went to my room, Sakura was there. She
didn't come through the door, but instead from the window.
Really, she scared me half to death...
messages.8308:
Sakura came to finagle a "welcome back" out of me. She
managed to come in through the window, since it's lock has
been broken for the last 6 years.
messages.8411:
After a bit of reminscience, she went out the same way she
came in.
messages.8491:
The sakura tree branch outside which she used to climb,
thanks to my clumsiness before, was torn quite badly.
messages.8559: That Sakura... she really hasn't changed one bit.

messages.150:
I read a manga while resting my head on my bolster. Next
door, I can hear Sakura's shrill voice every now and then.
messages.269: Even alone, she can make so much noise.
messages.342:
I reach out to the alarm clock and set the alarm for
tomorrow.
messages.470: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
messages.528: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
messages.577: After setting the alarm, I slept.
messages.746:
I figured it was the right time to sleep once Sakura next
door actually quietened down for once.
messages.855: Time to set the alarm clock, then.

messages.197: I closed my eyelids, and relaxed my body...

messages.166: "There's no announcements today, so I'd end HR now."
messages.222: As she left the classroom, the weekly duty quickly stood up.
messages.332:
With just the announcement from the weekly duty, today's HR
ended as soon as it started.
messages.396: "Now then... how will I go back today."
messages.443: I stretch my arms above my head as I question myself.
messages.637:
After school, Koyomi-sensei started the HR session and
immediately said that she'd end it.

messages.306:
Today wasn't very different. A normal morning routine of
waking up, breakfast, measuring Nemu's temperature...
messages.443:
"I never thought I'd see the day where I'd have to say
"Nii-san, wait up!"..."
messages.537: She pretended to wipe away tears, mocking me further.
messages.582: "...Excuuuse me. You've said that plenty of times to me."
messages.682:
"...That's true. Like when that time when you stole my
afternoon snack, or at the zoo when you tried to ditch me at
the playpen...
messages.813: "You have a memory like an elephant..."
messages.858: Clicking my tongue, I answered her back.
messages.915: "Of course, it has to do with you after all."
messages.956:
Her reply was in the same manner, down to the action. How
many times have people fallen to that terrifying face...
messages.1061: "From now on, please let me say that in a good way instead."
messages.1187:
Sheesh, I wake up early for once, and I get this treatment.
Makes me not want to get up early at all.
messages.1259:
Glancing to the side, I saw a briskly-walking figure easing
past us.
messages.1340:
Her pretty, fluttering hair came to a halt at the sound of
my voice.
messages.1396: "Morning. I wasn't expecting to meet you here."
messages.1517: A barely audible voice as usual.
messages.1546:
"So you go to school at this time? Looks like we can walk to
school toget..."
messages.1631:
Before I could complete my sentence, Tsukishiro had
completely overtaken us and continued her brisk walk to
school.
messages.1784:
"Nii-san, who was that girl? She seemed like a second year
student..."
messages.1844:
"Mm? Ah, yeah. I found and returned her student notebook a
few days ago."
messages.1948:
"Hmm, I see. How unusual for you to make acquaintances so
easily."
messages.2028: "What do you mean by unusual, huh?"
messages.2079: Besides, the one that's unusual is... Tsukishiro, really.
messages.2133:
The strange doll she carries, her foreign appearance, and
those mysterious eyes always staring at something...
messages.2232:
And staying in that huge mansion, with a butler at her
service...
messages.2475: "I called out to you so many times."
messages.2594: Nemu puffed her cheeks in exasperation.
messages.2633: "Come on, don't give me that kind of face. Let's go."
messages.2676: I suddenly stepped up my walking speed.
messages.2715:
There's no point waking up this early, only to walk like a
slug to school.
messages.2854: Saying those magic words, Nemu started chasing after me.
messages.3081: I unusually woke up early, and accompanied Nemu to school.
messages.3133:
En-route, we bumped into Tsukishiro, who whispered a simple
"Good morning" and hurried off to school.
messages.3254: I don't think she was being rude, but...

messages.377: Sleepy... I couldn't have set the alarm this early..
messages.475:
I opened my eyes into slits, and searched for the snooze
button on the alarm clock.
messages.529:
I hit the snooze button, then turn over and try to sleep
again.
messages.597: Beside me and right in front of my eyes, I saw a face.
messages.667:
My drowziness wore off in an instant as I jumped up in
horror.
messages.690: Lying on my futon was Sakura, clad only in her pajamas.
messages.795:
I try to calm myself down, and recall the events of the
night before.
messages.847: I don't remember anything about this before I fell asleep.
messages.888:
"(Don't tell me, another unauthorized intrusion from the
window?)"
messages.921: Whatever the case, I can't let Nemu see this.
messages.1046: Sakura was still half-asleep, and replied in a dreamy voice.
messages.1093:
"Come on, hurry up and wake up! Go back out through the
window again!"
messages.1163:
I forcefully sit her up, and shake her shoulders
vigourously.
messages.1253: Sakura finally opened her massive eyelids.
messages.1378: "Don't just greet me normally! Why're you sleeping here?"
messages.1452: I poke Sakura's sleepy face in the forehead.
messages.1589:
"Anyway, wake up already and go back to your house through
the window! If Nemu sees this, she'd kill me!"
messages.1770: I turn to face Sakura, and see her usual grin.
messages.1854:
"Then I'd leave now. If I'm around, Nemu will be maaad
right?"
messages.1934: "That's why I said, hurry up and go!"
messages.2036:
She lightly jumped out the window, and standing on the
branch, turned back and gave a little wave before
disappearing out of sight.
messages.2175:
With one hand on my chest and one in my hair, I head to the
bathroom to wash my face.
messages.2422:
Waken up by the alarm, somehow, Sakura was sleeping beside
me. Just why did she come here now...
messages.2514: I quickly woke her up, and chased her out of my room.

messages.149:
There are only three places in Kazami Academy that I have
never set foot in.
messages.213:
The girl's bathroom, the girl's locker room, and the
library.
messages.256:
Well, more accurately, if I don't have a specific reason to
go there, I never will.
messages.330:
Of course, for the first two, there's absolutely no reason
for me to enter.
messages.377:
But there is for the last. For example, when I need to take
a lunchtime nap.
messages.416:
However, this time, my reason for going there was slightly
different--
messages.547: "Nii-san, could you...? I can't bring these over by myself."
messages.598: "The dictionaries we used for fourth period?"
messages.683: "There isn't anyone else you can ask?"
messages.760:
"Well... look at Murasaki-san for yourself, do you think she
could? I don't have the heart to ask her."
messages.861:
"You should pay for your own mistakes. You knew you weren't
going to be able to do it, yet volunteered so eagerly for
it."
messages.973:
"That's true, but... well, then what do you think I should
do?"
messages.1102:
"Letting your adorable sister collapse due to too much hard
labour, what would our family think..."
messages.1188:
"...Okay, okay, I got it. Just take these to the library,
right?"
messages.1303: "...Then why did I end up carrying all of them!?"
messages.1354: In the end, I was a substitute more than a helper.
messages.1428:
I slowly started to place the 20 dictionaries back on their
respective shelves.
messages.1482: She owes me one hell of a take-out for this tonight...
messages.1544:
I looked around, and noticed a familiar-looking female
sitting at a desk, and reading a book. ...It's Tsukishiro.
messages.1632:
Even while wearing the black gloves, she skillfully brushed
past each page.
messages.1688: The book she was reading was nothing short of huge.
messages.1742: The usual doll was sitting quietly in her lap.
messages.1816:
Noticing my shadow falling onto her book, she gazed up at
me.
messages.1937:
She removed her hand from over the book, to reveal a piece
of paper with a rough sketch of a plant on it.
messages.2066:
"So that's what you're looking at... I guess regarding the
plant behind the gym?"
messages.2186: "You mean, you don't know that plant's name?"
messages.2237: A shake of the head no, this time.
messages.2285:
"Then, you're trying to find out how to take care of it
properly?"
messages.2364:
"Ehhnn... it's hard to talk like this, maybe you should get
your doll to talk again like before."

I shouldn't show my ignorance at something she's obviously

Rather than talking about mindless things, I should just try

"I haven't seen any... priests around, though. What's with

"Well, if you don't want to talk about it, fine... but if

But it looks like saying what it is would really be too much

"What comes to your mind, when you think about the duties of

"There is also the maintenance of the shrine area, and the

My imagination started running, with the thought of a male

Dancing like that in full public view, that'd be way too

Tamaki had to concentrate on her cleaning to finish it, so I

In the end, I didn't know any more about our supposed

I headed to the shrine, and found Tamaki sweeping the stone

While having a cup of tea with her, I found out why she

The chief priest's health had deteroriated, so her family

I yawned and stretch my back, sitting cross-legged on my

That Sakura, don't tell me she's going to do this every

As I take a glance at him, he was wearing the same

messages.560:
Nemu... being a disciplinary club member, of course she's

Shigeru's here. Kakuta... isn't here yet. Poor guy, he'd be

I pointed to the strange pink-coloured bear sitting at the

Right in front of my eyes, the pink bear-- something you'd

"What's wrong, Asakura. Found something scary so early in

Suginami's voice from behind me snapped me out of my trance,

I turn to face Suginami and answer him with a smile. What I

"Ahh, nothing's wrong, nothing at all. Right, I'd go to the

I headed for the exit of the classroom, making sure not to

Suginami went beside me and rubbed his shoulder with mine,

messages.2080:
"Occasionally, it is a fine idea to deepen our

That's right, what I saw just now must definitely have been

Steeling my mind on that idea-- no, truth, my heart felt a

messages.2400:
Surely my heart will be able to keep beating for the rest of

"Not particularly... you're tired? I see, I see. Nemu must

"Just kidding. You're still young, you won't tire from that

"I told you I was joking! Although truthfully, you don't

messages.3410:
"Nevermind... what I'm seeing now is too crazy for anyone to

messages.3559:
"What are you talking about? Do you remember who you're

messages.3730:
"Of course! Even if you've heard something or seen something

"Even if you told me that aliens were overrunning this

Thank goodness... at least in these times, Suginami's a

"The truth is... there's a bear in the classroom right

"You just said you'd surely understand and believe my

"Younger sister Asakura will certainly be sad to hear

I close my eyes and rub them again. As I open them, I pray

As I continue staring at the pink bear and it's school

Right now, I have to believe in what I feel in my heart!

messages.4844:
But, really, this does seem to be reality... no, it is

No one else seems to be bothered by it, and it's definitely

messages.5075:
Then I might as well take the iniatiative and participate

I bet everyone else is too shy to unless someone else does

"Eh, I'm being a rabbit? What about you, being a monkey I

"We have a bear and a rabbit, now we need a monkey, dog, and

"...You should tell the teacher that you need to go to the

Maybe... I'm the weird one? I'm the one who's acting

I have to be fine... yet everyone else doesn't see it. How

Maybe if I investigate that bear, everything will be

I rushed up to the back of the bear, and jabbed my finger

"Why're you wearing a bear costume in school?! It is a

In front of me was the pure face of a bear, it's plastic

Once again, I said something incredibly stupid before I

"Brother... at the very least, don't throw away what

I tried to explain myself, but cut myself short. I'm really

Everyone around me was staring at me with pitiful contempt

Everyone, including the bear, nodded again. The entire class

There probably isn't a simple answer for all of this... I

There is a bear. It is wearing clothes. No one else has

Koyomi-sensei had entered the classroom, banging the

Like a bunch of spiders scattering back to their webs, my

Everyone else must be deceiving me. Surely the teacher can

What on earth is going on here? There's definitely a pink

Yet the class was completely unaware, as was the teacher,

But the rest of her features are vague to me. Was her hair

Everything I remembered about her has been replaced by a

messages.11019:
I thought aloud, and stood up from my desk. The bear was

messages.11139:
"Yoshita, Yonesawa... there's nothing weird, Asakura! If

"Of course you have, geez. Oh yeah, but she only came here
at the start of the third year, though."
messages.12825: "What's wrong, brother? You're acting really weird today."
messages.12883:
"...Nothing, I'm all right now. I was just a little tired.
Anyway, you should hurry back to class."
messages.13034:
"Me? I'd probably just rest here for another period or
so..."
messages.13139: I pull the blanket over my head.
messages.13211:
That bear... I don't know whether I'm hallucinating about it
anymore.
messages.13248:
Despite knowing nearly everything about my class, I still
can't picture the human Murasaki in my mind.
messages.13359:
Why can't I even remember this supposedly normal-looking
phantom? It must be some fault of my mood right now...
messages.13464:
Maybe after I take a good rest here, I can clear my head and
maybe stop stubornly claiming that I can see a bear...
messages.13571: Daaah! I can't sleep just yet!
messages.13637: If I do, I'd completely forget what happened just now.
messages.13715:
I did something pretty bad to Murasaki... I did try to take
off her clothes, after all.
messages.13793: I have to apologize to her soon.
messages.13826:
Yet I still can't forget the soft and fluffy feel of fur on
my hand...
messages.13896:
Still lying on the futon in the nurse's office, I let on a
large yawn.
messages.13966: From outside my blanket, I heard Nemu sigh.
messages.14086: I heard a timid voice through the blanket.
messages.14180:
"Ah, Murasaki... Sorry about earlier. I don't know what I
was thinking... but I honestly wasn't trying to hurt you.
messages.14309:
I made a heartfelt apology, but didn't have the guts to face
her.
messages.14390: "Aya, I'm fine with it... please don't worry about that."
messages.14487: I finally uncover my face from the blanket.
messages.14543: Ance once I did, in front of my eyes was--
messages.14654: Yet again, I saw the pink bear.
messages.14767:
We simultaneously recoil in a combination of surprise and
horror.
messages.14812:
I calm myself, straight my posture, blink my eyes a few
times... and that freaking bear is still there.
messages.14972: The bear gave a quick nod.
messages.15031: "Uhm... Asakura-san, do you see me as a bear?"
messages.15150: "Um, about that, please don't tell anyone else about it..."
messages.15206: The bear bowed in polite request.
messages.15241:
"...You mean, that your real figure is really that of a
bear?..."
messages.15337:
"Ya... the truth is, there's a good reason for this... why
I'm wearing clothes, and why you see me as a bear..."
messages.15509: "The reason? ...Please don't make me tell the reason..."
messages.15571: The bear hung it's head in shame, fidgeting nervously.
messages.15625:
"Well... It's not like I'd tell anyone else. What's wrong
with explaining this whole thing to me?"
messages.15722:
"But if I do, you probably won't understand or believe
me..."
messages.15784:
"Isn't the fact that I've accepted this bear standing in
front of me enough proof that I would?"
messages.15898:
"So would it be okay to tell me? This is pretty weird after
all."
messages.15976:
Although this island is pretty notorious for weird
occurrences, this one must beat them all easily.
messages.16092: "Well... please don't laugh or get mad..."
messages.16166:
"I won't get mad. Unless you say you're some alien doing
scouting for an invsaion or something."
messages.16268:
"Ayaya... looks like there's no need for me to say
anything."
messages.16343:
"Why not? I said I won't get mad... unless you mean you're
really some alien planning on kidnapping our cattle and
humans."
messages.16472: I start guffawing at my own joke, if only so someone would.
messages.16546: I didn't expect her to fall for it so well.
messages.16664:
"It, it's not about that... it's the Galaxy Federation's
plan to prevent uncivilized planets from being forcefully
colonized..."
messages.16815:
"We don't have the time or motivation to do any kidnapping
or live experiments or anything like that..."
messages.16963:
It worried me quite a bit that she's taking my joke about
invasion and kidnapping far more seriously than I expected.
messages.17067:
I wasn't exactly expecting any sort of reply for a horrible
joke like that.
messages.17158:
"That is... the reason I'm currently staying on this planet.
I mean no harm whatsoever..."
messages.17263: "Um...? Murasaki-san, can you tell me one thing?"
messages.17422:
"Ah... about 820 light years away from Earth, the 4th planet
of the Kilito Star System, Sheem."
messages.17546:
Another serious reply to a lighthearted question... wait,
don't tell me...
messages.17696: "As you can see... yes I am."
messages.17743: "So there really is an earth invasion..."
messages.17791:
"Aya, I told you earlier, there's no real worth in invading
Earth anyway, so..."
messages.17890:
A weird island, a weird grandmother, weird powers, so many
strange things...
messages.17950:
Yet no matter how many of those strange things I've
experienced, I can't say I've ever met an alien before.
messages.18038:
Suginami's a alien fanatic, so he's talked a lot about these
things, although I've rarely listened to him.
messages.18096:
But I would've figured the first contact would be some form
of galaxy-wide peace announcement or something...
messages.18211:
Instead, the first contact... is with a single alien which
apparently looks like a bear.
messages.18283:
"Err, can you provide any proof to show that you're really
an alien?"
messages.18431: "...Nevermind, sorry. It was a stupid question."
messages.18485:
The very fact that this bear stands before me cannot be
explained by earthly means.
messages.18543:
Despite the completely insane-sounding situation under any
other circumstances, at this point, it's not sounding as
far-fetched anymore...
messages.18645: "So anyway, why am I seeing you as a bear?"
messages.18733:
"Well, originally, to prevent confusion and chaos, I
temporarly took the place of a human. That human was
Murasaki Izumiko."
messages.18853:
"The people around me treated me just the same as if I was
really her."
messages.18909:
"Well, I honestly have no idea why, but I've completely
forgotten what Murasaki looks like anymore, or anything like
that..."
messages.19027:
"I'm clueless as well. Possibly the machine had a breakdown
or something..."
messages.19097:
"But really... I'm meeting a non-earthling intelligent life
form for the first time, and it's some toy-like bear-type
alien..."
messages.19226:
In my mind, I was imagining some Grey-type alien, the kind
that would want to invade and take over the earth. Instead,
I get this.
messages.19389:
"Uhm, I'm not exactly a "bear-type alien" or anything like
that..."
messages.19508:
"In my present state, my condition would deteriorate quickly
if I was exposed to this atmosphere... so I wear a space
suit..."
messages.19629:
I look up and down Murasaki's figure, licking my lips
unconsciously.
messages.19719: "Aya... don't stare at me so carefully like that..."
messages.19781:
Murasaki, having a bout of self-consciousness, tried somehow
to hide herself.
messages.19901: "Ayaya... I'm not a bear, I'm not a bear~!"
messages.19971:
The bear waved her large, bright pink hand around
frantically.
messages.20071:
"...in any case, Asakura-san, do you now believe everything
I've said?"
messages.20161:
"What you said just now? I'm more or less used to weird
phenomena anwyay. Now that I know this, I feel more relaxed
than anything."
messages.20289:
The truth is, whether she's an alien or some subeterranean,
I'm really glad anyway.
messages.20361: Whether she's really an alien or not,
messages.20410:
the very fact that I'm not hallucinating about giant pink
bears existing randomly is enough for me.
messages.20511:
Well, there's no proof that I'm not hallucinating and she's
not lying to me, but her explanation sounds reasonable
enough.
messages.20599:
It's something I can agree with anyway, so that's good
enough.
messages.20663:
Yet inside me, I know that this Murasaki is quite an
enigma...
messages.20721: "But... why does it... heh heh... have to look like that?"
messages.20805:
It's a bit hard to be serious about talking to a giant pink
bear.
messages.20897: Not to mention wearing those clothes on top of that...
messages.20991:
"Aya... it couldn't be helped. I needed to find some
clothes, so I copied that which I saw on an animal..."
messages.21182:
"Well, we don't really have much information on this
uncivilized planet, so clothing information is scarce as
well..."
messages.21262: Murasaki gave a light apology with her words.
messages.21301:
I guess she doesn't think much of the earth in the large
scale of things.
messages.21391:
"Ah, now that I remember, look at this! This outfit is
pretty useful, there's a function within the fingernail of
the hands..."
messages.21502:
While saying that, Murasaki skillfully opened the fingernail
of one of her fingers.
messages.21641:
At the very tip of her fingernail, a bunch of candies were
rolling around...
messages.21712: "This is really handy for when I get hungry!"
messages.21799:
Right here, right now, is the start of an inter-galactic
war. At least, that's what I thought, as I took one of the
candies.
messages.21932:
"In any case, Asakura-san, I'm heading back to the
classroom."
messages.21981:
"Okay. Don't worry about what you've said today. I won't
tell anyone anything, now that I've understood."
messages.22113:
If I tell anyone that I have a bear for a classmate, they'd
just laugh at me anyway.
messages.22199:
"But, since I've come to earth, this is the first time I've
told anyone about this entire thing. It makes me feel
relieved..."
messages.22306:
"That's understandable. And besides, myself as an earthling,
I'm happy to be able to meet people from other planets."
messages.22439: After saying that, Murasaki silently left the infirmary.
messages.22526:
Really though, meeting an alien... that has to be pretty
damn strange, even by my standards.
messages.22594:
No no, I'm already used to strange things, this isn't a rare
thing for me.
messages.22670: I make a Karintou in my hand, and throw it in my mouth.
messages.22732: As always, a completely useless power.
messages.22765: I guess now I'd have to sleep for two periods...
messages.22990:
In the morning, as I entered my classroom, somehow, I saw a
pink bear.
messages.23060:
One of those things that look like they belong in an
amusement park.
messages.23103:
But I was the only one who saw it. Everyone else saw the
usual classmate, Murasaki Izumiko.
messages.23204:
I got a bit too heated up about the subject, and was sent to
the infirmary.
messages.23268:
After a while, the bear came and confessed that she was
actually an alien...
messages.23354: She then explained to me the rest of her secrets.

messages.203: I was early for school today, for once.
messages.252:
With enough time on my hands, I decide to walk to school and
avoid the crowds on the bus.
messages.480:
"This is a pretty rare sight, seeing you here walking so
calmly at this time."
messages.589:
I turned my head over my shoulder to answer her. It's not
surprising that she thinks that, I suppose.
messages.661:
No matter how many times I'm early for school now, it won't
be easy to shake the title of "Lateness King" off my
reputation.
messages.777:
"Anyway, my friends are waiting for me up ahead, so I'd make
a move."
messages.871:
That Kotori, with her cheerful style, light voice and ready
smile... it's always enough to brighten up someone's day.
messages.1003: "This is rare, Asakura. You're going to make it rain now."
messages.1054: A light punch on my shoulder followed the words.
messages.1113:
"Oh, it's just you Kudou. As biting as ever even this early
in the morning, huh?"
messages.1182: "It's the truth, this doesn't happen often at all."
messages.1241: "Well, it won't do to be late anyway."
messages.1297:
We started walking towards the school, participating in
thoughtless morning chatter.
messages.1365: This is a pretty new experience for me...
messages.1398:
Not to mention there's some oddly sweet smell in the morning
air...
messages.1521:
"Hm? Scent? Sorry, must've been from the morning bath I
took."
messages.1583:
Kudou ran his thumb and index finger through his hair a few
times.
messages.1651:
"Well, it's okay I guess. Nemu always takes morning showers
as well."
messages.1735:
That's pretty typical of a girl, and I've never followed her
example.
messages.1791:
But having enough time to linger around and enjoy a bath
makes me feel sort of envious.
messages.1859: Maybe I should consider waking up earlier to do so...
messages.2076:
Tsukishiro actually saying something to me doesn't happen
very often... I'm glad she did, though.
messages.2161:
--Then, before I could even continue the "conversation",
Tsukishiro had already walked right past and moved in front
of me.
messages.2353:
I felt a bit sad just leaving it as "knowing her", but it's
a bit too much to call her a friend right now.
messages.2547: "But, why's she holding that doll with her..."
messages.2609: "Ahh, Tsukishiro has a knack for ventriloquism."
messages.2701:
I don't even know whether it's really ventriloquism... but
it's too early to say something like "the doll can actually
talk".
messages.2908: "Heyy, that laugh sounded like it implied something."
messages.3016:
Although he said that, it's obvious he was thinking about
something involving a close friendship between senpai and
kouhai*...
messages.3117: Of course the situation isn't like that.
messages.3164: But he somehow got that idea, I bet...
messages.3243: "Yo, guys. The weather is superb today!"
messages.3319:
Suddenly, Suginami appeared from between us, seperating our
shoulders with his hands.
messages.3426:
After the usual morning greeting, the three of us continued
our way down the avenue.
messages.3478: Along the way, we also passed by Mako and said hello.
messages.3556:
From this morning, I started thinking that maybe going to
school on time isn't bad after all.
messages.3624: I should get up early more often.
messages.3853:
On a rare occasion when I woke up early, I met Kotori and
Kudou on the way to school, which I don't usually do when I
sleep till my usual time.
messages.3952:
Even more oddly, Tsukishiro greeted me, although she
immediately cut the conversation off from there.
messages.4055:
I also met Suginami and Mako... I see, I should learn to
wake up early more often.

messages.148:
My destination was beyond the school gates, to buy some
stuff.
messages.208: Right at the school gates, I unexpectedly saw Tsukishiro.
messages.270: "Tsukishiro! Are you heading out to do shopping too?"
messages.336: Noticing me, she nodded in answer to my question.
messages.385: "Heh, it's odd to meet you here."
messages.432:
I pointed out the school gates, indirectly suggesting "let's
go together", and started off.
messages.595: The gloves came off once again, and after a few pats;
messages.668:
"Nope, Alice is looking for notebooks for the afternoon
classes."
messages.736: Getting that doll to talk won't solve anything.
messages.798:
As long as Tsukishiro keeps up this stance, she won't ever
get used to talking to people.
messages.866: I want to get her to talk to me, somehow.
messages.911: "Can't you just buy that at the school's stationery shop?"
messages.992:
"The ones Alice uses can't be bought at school. We have no
choice but to go out to get it."
messages.1086: "That's odd. Notebooks all look the same to me."
messages.1273:
Suddenly opening her mouth like that, I could only force out
a vague, stammered reply.
messages.1624: "We thought you'd be kinda different than you are now..."
messages.1743:
"Yeah, like how you were during last year's Christmas and
graduation parties."
messages.1838:
This school has a lot of yearly events that students have to
participate in, such as the Christmas and graduation
parties.
messages.1955:
I ended up being involved in a lot of mischief at those
functions last year.
messages.2017:
Along with Suginami, I was quickly placed on the discplinary
committee's blacklist.
messages.2085:
Well, I guess this year being the one I graduate myself, has
made me mellow down a bit.
messages.2391:
I don't normally partake in gossping, but to hear that even
the lowerclassmen know my name, gives me a sense of pride.
messages.2492: I could practically feel my head getting bigger.
messages.2580:
"Shirakawa-sensei and the other senseis talk about you
often, saying things like "Don't be like Asakura and
Suginami from 3rd year"."
messages.2712: Those people... talking like that about me behind my back...
messages.2768:
Wait till they see the newspapers tomorrow... "Student
refuses to go to school!", how good that'd look.
messages.2881: "You're sure talking a lot today, aren't you?"
messages.2960:
"Me? Mm, but that's because I'm basically a proxy for Alice
trying to communicate her feelings."
messages.3170:
"Well, whatever. I know a good stationery shop at the main
street... I have stuff to do there, shall we go together?"
messages.3401:
Doesn't seem like they dislike the idea, but in the same
vein, I can't really tell whether they enjoy it either.
messages.3506: Well, at least getting this far is good enough.
messages.3733:
While heading out to do some shopping during lunch break, I
ran into Tsukishiro.
messages.3797:
At my attempts to start conversation, Tsukishiro once again
used the doll to answer for her.
messages.3859:
The limit of what I could find out, was that the doll was
"Alice's proxy in trying to communicate her feelings."
messages.3984:
But when I asked her herself, she said she didn't
particularly want to talk.
messages.4052:
Well, I don't understand at all, but it's not something I
can't stand, at least.

messages.149: "Mm, mm, ahh~, testing testing."
messages.182: "Huh?"
messages.210:
"...Hm? Aaaahh, can people here this? Oh well, I'd give it a
try..."
messages.274:
Slightly fearful words emnated from the speakers stationed
at the ceiling.
messages.416: "Onii-chan, can you hear me~? Let's each lunch together~"
messages.520: "I'd be waiting at the broadcasting room, onii-chan♪"
messages.603: I didn't know someone had a sister in this school as well.
messages.663:
"Anyway, I should hurry up. The bread will all be gone by
now..."
messages.835: "Ah~... unya, testing testing... mmm, can you hear me?"
messages.1012: "Do you dislike eating lunch with me that much!?"
messages.1091:
"It took so much effort to get to the broadcasting system to
-- ah, t, teacher? U, unyaaa!"
messages.1248:
Yet, a while after, Koyomi-sensei was angry at me because of
that.
messages.1486:
From the speakers came an enigmatic voice, calling out for
her brother.
messages.1540:
It was actually Sakura, trying to ask me to eat lunch with
her.
messages.1626:
And she somehow managed to get me in trouble with the
teachers as well...

messages.182:
With bought bread in hand, I start to return to the
classroom.
messages.248: A tiny little thing rolled past me on the floor.
messages.350:
Immediately following it was Koyomi-sensei. She had her
glasses on top of her head, holding our her hands like a
zombie.
messages.475: "Damnit... I can't see a thing without my glasses..."
messages.543:
She immediately stopped as I called to her back. As she put
back her glasses, I chased the rolling thing.
messages.656: It was a can of coffee, unsweetened.
messages.749:
She looked around a bit, then put her glasses back on her
face.
messages.836:
I hand over the canned coffee with a little grin, rubbing my
head a bit.
messages.911:
"Sorry, I've been forgetful lately. And I've not really been
able to keep up my appearance either..."
messages.1071:
"I'm not normally one to exert my powers as a civil servant,
but if the time and place is right..."
messages.1199: "Asakura-kun, I hope you go through graduation smoothly."
messages.1275: With the voice of a kitten, I meekly raise the white flag.
messages.1337:
"Glad we have an understanding. ...That's right, what drink
do you want? I should treat you for getting my coffee back."
messages.1472:
"Well, as long as your request involves coffee, it'll be
fine."
messages.1635: "Didn't you invite me here for coffee?"
messages.1689: "Right. What do you think I'm doing here?"
messages.1806: My eyes caught a beaker sitting right next to it.
messages.1862:
...I see。 The beaker's probably used as a container to hold
the coffee.
messages.1940:
Although really, if coffee can be made here, I don't see the
point in buying canned coffee.
messages.2050:
"Hm? Didn't you want to come here to have a drink of
coffee?"
messages.2130:
"Well, yes. But I thought it would be canned coffee from a
vending machine or something."
messages.2217: "It's good to drink normal coffee once in a while."
messages.2275: ...Is she saying this coffee she's brewing isn't...
messages.2360:
I quickly turn to leave, but Koyomi-sensei managed to stop
me before I got to the door.
messages.2425:
"Wait, I'm just joking, sheesh. Just grab a chair and sit
down."
messages.2504:
Still wondering whether my stomach will really be okay, I
take her advice and sit down on a nearby chair.
messages.2592:
I've seen raw food being prepared before, so watching coffee
brew isn't my idea of a good time.
messages.2678: I randomly look around the room.
messages.2738:
"Don't make yourself look so conspicious. I do have a sister
in this school."
messages.2830:
With her back turned to me, she made an idle complaint, with
me being unable to see her expression.
messages.2944:
"Mm? You're calling her so freely already? You two are that
close, huh?"
messages.3014: "No no. She's just, how you say it... very friendly."
messages.3097: That word seemed to get stuck in between her teeth.
messages.3188: "...Are you saying you can see my face through my back?"
messages.3298:
"Myself, of course. Anyway, about Kotori. You don't think
she's friendly?"
messages.3499:
It wasn't a beaker, but a fragrant cup with steam rising
from it that was handed to me.
messages.3578:
"Kotori... she's definitely a socialable person, but she
always seems like she's overdoing it. From what I see,
anyway.
messages.3687:
Koyomi-sensei opened the previously-rolling canned coffee
using the pull-top, and took a drink from it.
messages.3795:
"Well, whether you or anyone else, if she wants to make
friends with them, there's nothing I can say about it."
messages.3887: "Would I be an "anyone else" as well?"
messages.4007:
"I wouldn't consider you just "one of them". You should be
happy for that."
messages.4085:
"Both ways, she's so popular that if she were to marry, I
bet there'd be an unofficial day of mourning for this
island."
messages.4395:
I bumped into Koyomi-sensei, and somehow or other, she ended
up treating me to some coffee.
messages.4459:
From talking about private and public matters, the subject
of her sister came up.
messages.4533:
Apparently, Kotori mixing around so well gives her something
of a bad feeling... I wonder why.

messages.186: Tamaki and Kudou were talking, behind the school gym.
messages.252:
The school's number one pretty boy, and the traditional
beauty Tamaki...
messages.289: They actually look pretty good together.
messages.332:
I wonder what they're talking about? They seem pretty
serious...
messages.453: Kudou noticed me in the shadows.
messages.480: "Hey, you two. Sorry for the rudeness."
messages.529:
I wasn't meaning to eavesdrop, but the circumstances
certainly didn't look good anyway.
messages.593:
I tried to laugh off the tension, as I made myself more
visible to the two of them.
messages.683: "Am I interrupting something? Like a confession, perhaps?"
messages.856: I mockingly rubbed my chin and smirked at Kudou.
messages.916:
"You've got it wrong, Asakura. I was just asking
Konomiya-san about something..."
messages.982:
"Now now, it's not something you need to hide! It's good to
be close, after all!"
messages.1058:
Of course, I knew. Kudou probably guessed that I was just
acting, as well.
messages.1132:
If it really was a confession scene though, I'd be the real
idiot.
messages.1272:
My eyes instinctively moved to the sound of the passionate
voice. The previously silent Tamaki had spoken.
messages.1334:
It took me a second to digest the sudden change in
atmosphere.
messages.1371:
It was rare to see the usually calm Tamaki, so emotional
about somehting.
messages.1569:
Tamaki was still staring at me, the seriousness on her face
plain to see.
messages.1608:
It was an atmosphere that indicated that all jokes had to be
stopped.
messages.1645: "Y, you don't need to react that much..."
messages.1731: "Yeah, you know... it was just a joke."
messages.1803:
He may not have directly acknowledged it, but he certanily
recognized it...
messages.1912: Tamaki was genuinely taken aback at my "revelation".
messages.2000:
"W, why did I... why did I act so strongly... what should
I...?"
messages.2092: Tamaki's words were garbled and rushed.
messages.2172:
"I'm very sorry, for speaking so loudly... to you as well,
Kudou-sama."
messages.2309:
"No, well... I was making a stupid joke as well, so I'm
sorry too."
messages.2415: "Hm, the air's gotten darker... I shall head back to class."
messages.2524: Running away successfully, Tamaki left for the classroom.
messages.2592: "I guess I went a bit too far."
messages.2653: "Perhaps. A young woman's heart is complex."
messages.2880:
During lunch, I went to the back of the gym, and found Kudou
and Tamaki engrossed in a serious conversation.
messages.2952:
I teased them about the relationship, which Tamaki got
seirously angry about.
messages.3014: Did I say something that bad?

messages.141:
The plant that Tsukishiro was taking care of, didn't seem to
show any signs of growth.
messages.203:
It looked like it was weak, but still trying it's best to
live.
messages.275:
Tsukishiro's taking care of it with all she's got, though. I
don't think it'd die just yet.
messages.367: I do wonder what kind of flower this is, though.
messages.406:
Not that I know much about biology, but it seems very
strange for a plant to be growing in this damp, dark place.
messages.540: From behind me, a tiny voice broke the silence.
messages.579:
In this deserted place, there's no mistaking who it belonged
to.
messages.735:
"Nothing, just checking on the plant. For now, it seems to
be growing, doesn't it?"

english exam, but I had no answer for him.
messages.3087: We ended up listening to Professor Nemu's lecture.

messages.145:
Ina way, this was completely like me, and in another way,
completely out-of-character.
messages.240:
The things I didn't care about, I completely shoved to the
side, compared to the things I did care about, regardless of
importance.
messages.353:
And since that's what I am, I continued on my merry way, not
thinking too much.
messages.473:
"Tsukishiro, given that it's the test period, should you
really be here?"
messages.523:
As usual, Tsukishiro was squatting in front of the plant,
doing nothing else but staring at it.
messages.620:
My words at least manage to wake her out of her trance, and
she replied,
messages.706: Without even movng her gaze from the plant, though.
messages.772:
"You may be good at exams, but you should still go home and
study a bit..."
messages.842:
Displaying my worries about her studies, I could only laugh
at myself inside.
messages.898: That's what I should be doing, instead.
messages.931:
Still keeping the plant in her line of sight, she shook her
head no.
messages.1029: She showed no signs of movement whatsoever.
messages.1066:
"But, just staring at it endlessly isn't going to help it
grow, right?"
messages.1134: Tsukishiro finally turned to look at me.
messages.1206: "And if so, then there's no reason to do so."
messages.1274:
"It's just a weed right now anyway, and it's not going to
live forever."
messages.1346:
I let my mouth do the talking, deicding to just go wtih what
I felt without thinking.
messages.1412: "And when it dies, it'd have did the best--"
messages.1478: Tsukishiro looked up at me, with a heartbreakingly-sad face.
messages.1594: She hugged her doll more tightly than I'd ever seen.
messages.1643: Seeing that, I finally realized what I was saying.
messages.1709: "...Sorry. I said a lot of terrible things."
messages.1785:
Tsukishiro shook her head left and right, far more fiercely
than I've ever seen.
messages.1930: Those big purple eyes were on the verge of tears.
messages.2043:
"I'm sorry. Of course, it's the plant you took so much pains
to grow, how could I..."
messages.2121:
Tsukishiro refused to face me, keeping her head bowed. With
yet another fierce shake of the head, she grabbed onto my
sleeve.
messages.2285:
She looked up at me with fear in her eyes, then ran off
before I could say anymore.
messages.2380: The feeling of her tiny hand remained on my sleeve.
messages.2440: I said far more than I should've.
messages.2479:
I thought it would provoke the normally reticient Tsukishiro
into a reaction, but it was a horrible failure.
messages.2613: No way I'd be in any mood to study now.
messages.2841:
Before I knew it, I was instinctively walking to the back of
the gym.
messages.2905: As usual, Tsukishiro was there, taking care of the plant.
messages.2961:
Wanting to find out her real intentions, I tried to provoke
a reaction out of her, but all I succeeded in doing was make
her sad.
messages.3064:
It seems that plant is even more important to her than I
thought.

At Koyomi-sensei's signal, the class flipped over their exam
sheets at once.
messages.231: "(So, the most fearsome enemy has shown it's face...)"
messages.272:
Looking at the english question sheet in front of me, I
gulped my saliva down hard.
messages.323:
"(I don't remember much, I doubt I can do the vocabulary
questions...)"
messages.385:
I leave the vocabulary questions blank and move on to the
rest of the paper.
messages.616:
Today's most fearsome enemy was english. I forgot most of
what I studied about the vocabulary questions, so I quickly
moved on to the other ones...

messages.163: "If I go home, there's nothing much to do..."
messages.212: Then again, if I don't, there's nothing to do either.
messages.261: "Blah, might as well just go home."
messages.304: With nothing in mind, I head for the school entrance.
messages.395: Nearing the entrance, I see Kotori heading out through it.
messages.436:
She had just peered into her locker, then suddenly stiffened
up and walked off.
messages.578:
As if I was about to play a joke on her, she ran off as soon
as she saw my face.
messages.656: "W, what?"
messages.677: My expression was one of blank surprise.
messages.825:
"Okay, Kudou. You come from here, and I'd go from over
there. We'd catch Kotori in a pincer attack."
messages.943: "H, hey, Asakura, what are you trying to do..."
messages.994: "It's okay. I'm not sure myself either."
messages.1035:
Only she would know the reason why she ran off like that at
the sight of me.
messages.1206: Ignoring the confused Kudou, I walk out of the entrance.
messages.1309: A normal chase will definitely not be enough now.
messages.1385: I yelled at him as I ran off in pursuit.
messages.1439: "O, okay. We just have to catch Kotori, right?"
messages.1522: I managed to take a shortcut.
messages.1659:
Jumping in front of her suddenly, Kotori stopped in her
tracks.
messages.1715: And right after me, from behind Kotori, came--
messages.1761:
"Haah... Haah... Haah, Kotori, you run pretty... Haah...
fast..."
messages.1938:
Before she could say anything else, something she was
holding close to her chest --a multi-coloured envolope--
dropped to the ground.
messages.2097:
Just as I started bending downwards to pick it up, her voice
shrieked out from above my head.
messages.2176:
A gust of wind suddenly blew past. With surprising agility,
Kotori squatted down and grabbed the flapping letter in
mid-flight.
messages.2271:
she quickly threw the envelope back into a bag. I caught a
glimpse inside, and would do well to forget it.
messages.2353:
It was a bag full of envelopes, about the size of a garbage
bag.
messages.2521: "...A bunch of embarassing poems inside, I bet?"
messages.2659: "Ah~ Geez~, you know already, don't tease me like that..."
messages.2752:
The colourful envelopes-- they definitely housed love
letters.
messages.2866: "It's painful for a girl to be popular."
messages.2899: "You obviously haven't been an unpopular guy."
messages.3021: "That's not true, I think you are!"
messages.3066: Kotori turned her head to face behind her.
messages.3145:
Kudou was taken aback for a second, but quickly regained his
composure and returned a willing smile.
messages.3301: "...Should I be happy at your compliments?"
messages.3439:
"A, ahh, of course. I'd be glad to make someone else happy
as well!"
messages.3497: "...In that case, I guess I am, thanks."
messages.3540:
Then again, being complimented by the school's number one
good looking girl and guy, doesn't really make me feel
comforted.
messages.3641:
Just looking at the pair in front of me was already enough
evidence against it.
messages.3724:
"...Anyway, what are you going to do with those love
letters?
messages.3795:
"That's right... I'd probably just answer "I'm sorry" to all
of them or something. So don't worry."
messages.3867: "W, what do you mean, me, worry?"
messages.3928: "I mean, you seem pretty concerned about it..."
messages.3994:
I unconciously started to blush. Did my face give anything
away?
messages.4082:
"And in the end, I don't think the senders are serious about
their love..."
messages.4227: "Isn't sending a love letter pretty serious as is?"
messages.4319: "...I'm not saying that they aren't being serious. But..."
messages.4455:
"...I don't think it's possible to express love through a
letter."
messages.4600:
"...From just words, you can't really tell the person's true
feelings..."
messages.4750: "It's so uneasy that way, I feel..."
messages.4791: Kotori had her head bowed slightly, chewing on her lip.
messages.4843: Then, she quickly lifted it back up.
messages.4906: "I, I'm so sorry... I just started saying weird things..."
messages.4970:
"No, it's nothing. It's for the better anyway, now I have
something to reference."
messages.5105:
"Y, you don't mean what I think you do, do you? Don't say
such weird things..."
messages.5177: "Hm, how to put it... perhaps, a heartstopping matter?"
messages.5305: "W, well, I'm heading back. Bye bye!"
messages.5386: Before I could even finish my farewell, she had disappeared.
messages.5634:
Despite getting all those declarions of love, she hasn't
seemed to take up any of them...
messages.5710:
Maybe being popular, and having so many suitors, isn't as
much of an easy road as it seems?
messages.5787: No use thinking about it now.
messages.5827: "My stomach's grumbling, I need to go fill it."
messages.5957: Leaving the dumbfounded Kudou, I head back towards home.
messages.6004: This has shown me just how unfair the world is.
messages.6068: Tonight, I'm going to cry into my pillow.
messages.6286:
As I was heading home, I saw Kotori at the school building's
entrance. When I called to her though, she ran off
immediately.
messages.6374: Coercing Kudou into assistance, we ran off in hot pursuit.
messages.6428:
We maanged to chase her down, and got the entire matter out
of her.
messages.6481:
It was completely unsurprising to be honest. Kotori was
exactly the type I'd imagine to receive so many love
letters.
messages.6559: As expected from someone so popular.

messages.175:
"That place always stirs up weird feelings inside me... it
must be the nostalgia from years ago."
messages.275:
I thought to myself, as I thought about the times I spent
there recently.
messages.324: There is a reason why I'm here, though.
messages.397:
After tests, the school becomes filled with noise from the
people with club activities, and loiterers talking about the
exams.
messages.502: "So, there's no reason for me to stay there."
messages.551: I stretched, feeling the tiredness run through my body.
messages.621:
...Which was strange, as I slept quite a bit during the
exams.
messages.670: "I won't be able to sleep if I head home, anyway."
messages.764: Sakura interrupted my train of thought, filled with spirit.
messages.862: A completely mindless and energetic attitude, as usual.
messages.950: "Unya? What's up? Your staring is making embarassing me!"
messages.1069:
Looking at her, the end of humanity as we know it could take
place, and you could probably forget that it's happening.
messages.1443: "I'm more serious than a really serious person!"
messages.1497:
"(If I go home with her, I'm not gonna be alone for the rest
of the day...)"
messages.1575: And end up doing lots of crap.
messages.1617: TIme to come up with a good excuse.
messages.1654: "Sorry, I've got stuff to do at the shrine today."
messages.1813: "Isn't that where that famous Miko is?"
messages.1987:
"I'm really interested in Miko, after all! And she's my
rival in love too, so even more reason to go!"
messages.2211: Out of the frying pan, and into the fire.
messages.2261:
Quickly checking around the classroom, it appeared that
Tamaki had already went home.
messages.2310: "(Sakura isn't one who'd get discouraged easily either...)"
messages.2440:
"What will you be doing, onii-chan? If you don't hurry up
and decide, the line will only get longer~"
messages.2510: She waved to me from the door of the classroom.
messages.2571: The line will only get longer?
messages.2637:
With a tiny smile playing on my lips, I followed after
Sakura.
messages.2773: She whirled around as she skipped up each step.
messages.2929:
We made steady progress up the steps, eventually reaching
the top, where Tamaki was sweeping.
messages.3045: Sakura greeted Tamaki with her usual pep.
messages.3194: "I see the two of you have come to visit today."
messages.3241: She met us with a smile.
messages.3354:
"Huh? Didn't you say that you had something to do
at.....mmphmpph..."
messages.3428: Not shutting up herself, I shut Sakura's mouth for her.
messages.3488: "Ha ha ha, I wonder what she's saying!"
messages.3592: She sounded a bit angry, but put up no resistance anyway.
messages.3702:
Tamaki kept on looking at our camaderie, smiling and
giggling throughout.
messages.3893:
With Tamaki's guidance, we made our way deeper into the
shrine.
messages.3984: "Ehhh? It looks just like a normal home."
messages.4021:
Sakura had escaped from my grip, and was wandering around
the place.
messages.4092:
"I thought there'd be more wallscrolls, or animal ornaments,
and stuff like that."
messages.4227:
"Aren't Miko exorcers of the undead, travelers to the
underworld, using techniques of the Gods to assassinate
evil?"
messages.4409:
"Those Miko and diviners in manga are hardly the same in
real life."
messages.4512:
Tamaki let out a tiny chuckle at Sakura's interpretation of
her kind.
messages.4593:
"Speaking of whch, I more or less know what Miko do, but
what about diviners? What do they do, exactly?"
messages.4677:
Having reprimanded Sakura for her ignorance, I then became
acutely aware of my own.
messages.4726:
Manga and movies tend to potray them as specialists in
exorcism and ghost extermination.
messages.4808: They couldn't be the same thing in real life, surely...
messages.4864:
Tamaki cleared her throat, and proceeded to answer my
question.
messages.4958:
"Diviners work with the 5 elements of the world, based on
the forces of yin and yang..."
messages.5057:
"From the forces, the 5 elements of wood, fire, earth, gold
and water were conjured."
messages.5208:
"Spiritual charms, onmyoudou, bean-throwing night and the
Hina and Weaver festivals are other examples of customs from
diviners."
messages.5324: I unconsciously made a small sound in wonder.
messages.5384:
"Although they are an important part of most shrines, and
although it's not explained in detail..."
messages.5498:
"In general, the abilties of Miko in channeling spirits is
stronger."
messages.5611:
"Yes. A Miko's duty is to listen to, and communicate the
words of the Gods and spirits."
messages.5694:
"In olden days, the words of a Miko had a large influence in
the politics of the land."
messages.5784:
"Of course, nowadays, no such thing takes place, and a
Miko's duty now is to assist the chief Shinto priest in
their duties."
messages.5872: I see. Miko have a interesting history...
messages.5921:
They don't just exist for fanboys to go "moeeee~" over,
apparently.
messages.6017: "I want to be a Miko too!"
messages.6058: Her eyes were sparkling at the mere thought of it.
messages.6118:
"...Didn't you just hear her explanation? You won't be able
to do it."
messages.6210: "What do you mean by that, onii-chan!?"
messages.6359: "Then... then, I want to try on a Miko dress!"
messages.6484: She begged to Tamaki, hugging her hips.
messages.6606:
"I do believe we have a spare hakama somewhere... it should
be fine."
messages.6762: Overjoyed, she followed Tamaki with a spring in her step.
messages.6832: Seems like she's just attracted to the "national costume".
messages.6961:
As I sipped my tea, my ears picked up the sound of
unnaturally hurried footsteps, getting louder and louder.
messages.7106:
The Miko dress-clad Sakura came bursting through the door
back to the room.
messages.7205: "How does it look, how does it look?"
messages.7244: She twirled around once, to give me a good look.
messages.7429: She smiled, still enchanted with her dress.
messages.7518: "I had thought that child size might be a bit too small."
messages.7634:
Tamaki followed in shortly after, with unexpectedly
insulting words.
messages.7694:
But the way she looks at Sakura so lovingly... nah, there
couldn't have been any abd intentions.
messages.7874: "That would require a camera... please use this."
messages.7919: Tamaki passed me a souvenir-type instant camera.
messages.8055: Sakura held onto Tamaki's arm, a wide smile on her face.
messages.8111: Tamaki had her usual calm smile on hers, as well.
messages.8185: I made sure both of them fit into the frame.
messages.8272: With the press of a button, the shutter closed.
messages.8396: Sakura lined herself up next to me.
messages.8455: "Onii-chan, put your arm around my shoulder!"
messages.8492: "Why do I have to do such a troublesome thing?"
messages.8623:
Upon finishing her sentence, she immediately grabbed my arm,
and draped it around her shoulders, without waiting for my
reply.
messages.8780:
At the signal of Sakura's voice, the shutters closed once
again.
messages.8852:
Even if I wanted to voice a complaint, I wouldn't be able to
get a word in.
messages.8979:
Sakura took the camera from Tamaki's hands, and guided her
beside me.
messages.9099:
A slight flush of red crept into her cheeks, as she tried to
step out.
messages.9163: "Ehhh~, why not? There's still film! Let's take a picture~"
messages.9233: "And if we don't, Sakura won't ever shut up anyway."
messages.9278: I encouraged her in my own way.
messages.9374: She hesitatingly placed herself beside me.
messages.9413:
"Now, Sakura, hurry up and take the picture, then we're
done."
messages.9551: I heard a barely audible voice.
messages.9620:
"C, could you... do that with my shoulders, like you did to
Sakura-san?"
messages.9688:
Her eyes were fully concentrated at me now, the slight flush
from before levelling up to a full-blown blush.
messages.9787: For Tamaki to say something like that...
messages.9851:
Still slightly shocked, I reached my arm around her
shoulders.
messages.9890:
Through the palm of my hand, I could feel her body
temperature flowing through me.
messages.9937: She really feels so slender and delicate...
messages.9984: And her shoulders seem so tiny...
messages.10070:
My heart was beating so fast, I was afraid Tamaki would hear
it...
messages.10157: With the sound of the shutters closing,
messages.10218: Came the capturing of the two of us on the frame of a photo.
messages.10257:
When it develops, I'd probably have a blush rivaling that of
Tamaki's...
messages.10532: I accompanied the Miko-obssessed Sakura to the shrine.
messages.10588:
Sakura's perceptions of a Miko were completely off. Tamaki
corrected and explained further with good-naturedness.
messages.10683:
With her interest in Miko only piqued further, Sakura begged
Tamaki to try on a Miko dress.
messages.10755:
And I ended up taking photographs with the two Miko
dress-clad girls.
messages.10817: Not a bad thing to do.

I shouldn't botther trying to memorize the entire

After setting the alarm clock, my eyes returned to the

"Time's up. I'd be going around to collect the answer sheets

All around me, I could hear the voices of students starting

Bit by bit, I could feel my mind, body and soul being

With test papers in hand, Koyomi-sensei passed by Ren-sensei

With the end of the exams nigh, everyone was in an excited

"Okay, I'm going on ahead. Remember to lock the doors before

I walk downstairs to the living room while putting on the

There are tons of students on the road to school this time

messages.834:
Keep it up, I think to them as I concentrate on getting to

messages.1282:
I don't really have the time to chat with her, I need to

messages.1542: Her pitiful voice cried out. I hastened my pace.
messages.1602: "(Sorry Miharu. This is all for the exams battle.)"
messages.1843:
To prevent being late, lots of students were around when I
went to school. Typical for an exam day.
messages.1913:
And I met a dazed Miharu on the way. She must've pulled an

messages.176: Unconsciously, I let out a huge sigh of relief.
messages.234:
Not just from that pressure finally being over, but from the
fact that everything that was tested, I knew how to do.
messages.333:
My smile was filled with pride. Mako, next to me then,
displayed the same kind of smile.
messages.403:
Whereas Suginami didn't carry either achievement or relief
in his expression, and instead one of studying, the mark of

messages.536:
I should be heading back to class soon, but for just a
little longer, I wanted to continue drinking my juice here.
messages.628:
A gust of wind blew a bunch of sakura petals past me, and I
started talking to myself.
messages.713: With a hearty laugh, I breathed in the cool air.
messages.760: It was like tasting some of Kyoto's delicacies.
messages.854:
Opening my mouth wide to breathe in further, my eyes caught
onto something peculiar.
messages.939: S, she didn't see anything, I'm sure...
messages.974: "H, hey, Tsukishiro. Did you do well on your tests?"
messages.1075:
Once again, her black gloves came off, and her bare hands
stroked her doll, which soon turned to face me.
messages.1208:
Tsukishiro's talking doll-- although she doesn't explain it,
there's no doubt it's ventriloquism.
messages.1282: But even so, her ability at it is scary...
messages.1396:
"Going back to class so soon seemed troublesome, so I stayed
out here to relax a bit."
messages.1464:
Drinking up the last of my juice, I threw the bottle into a
nearby trash basket.
messages.1524: "And you must spend lots of your time practicing, right?"
messages.1622:
"You know, how to project your voice using a barely visible
gap in your mouth to make it look like someone else is
talking."
messages.1776: Tsukishiro's head tilted to the side, in confusion.
messages.1948:
"Anyway, what about you? What are you doing here,
Tsukishiro?"
messages.2073:
"We figured that no one would come here during lunchtime, so
we made a lunchbox to eat here."
messages.2145:
I then noticed Tsukishiro taking out a tiny lunchbox from
her bag.
messages.2241:
"The cafeteria would normally be fine, but there's a lot of
people there today."
messages.2288: "Huh, you don't like being with many people?"
messages.2445: "...It's not nice, with so many strangers."
messages.2490: "It'd be fine if there's some people you know, right?"
messages.2540:
"Yeah, recently, Amakase-san from the neighbouring class has
been inviting us to her class."
messages.2608: That Miharu... so she's been doing that.
messages.2685: "Is it okay to sit beside you, senpai?"
messages.2793:
Tsukishiro placed her doll on the bench as well, then put
her gloves back on, and took a seat.
messages.2861: She then opened the lunchbox on her lap.
messages.2921: "Is it okay for me to be here?"

Her lunch consisted of onigiri seasoned with fish flour,

messages.3220: "...Wait a minute, did Seiba-san make this?"

How on earth could such a tiny cute lunchbox be made by such

messages.3411:
Those beefy hands, rolling up those small onigiris,

messages.3568:
"Eh? Ah, nothing... just thinking that your lunch looks

messages.3670:
"That's... well, such a tiny lunch won't be enough for me,

"Besides, Tsukishiro, if you don't eat, you won't get any

messages.3974:
She continued eating her lunch, her tiny mouth slowly

messages.4089:
"After you're done eating, want to go see the plant? I don't
have anything else to do."
messages.4173:
I caught her in the middle of her eating her onigiri, and
she looked at me with a surprised face. After a while,
messages.4289:
So, she said. It may have been my imagination, but I thought

It was lunchtime, and I was relaxing on the bench, when
Tsukishiro appeared.

It seems she didn't want to eat where lots of people were,

messages.4658: I was here, but according to her, that was fine.

I invited her to go see the plant together, after she
