As Koyomi-sensei took the attendance, the tired students

Following from yesterday, there were no latecomers. Well,

messages.752:
As the day starts, I wish for it to be over as quickly as

messages.127:
In the silent classroom, only the soft sounds of a pencil
being sharpened could be heard.
messages.471:
Three families of Tokugawa... 8th Shogun... buh, I should've

"Now that eating in the courtyard is no longer cold, that

"Maybe coldness would prevent me from keeping my mind on

messages.776:
"......You sure you don't want to know? It's rather

This all started when I heard Tamaki's voice calling out to

Our goal was to find a deserted area. We eventually landed

The sight before me taught me the real feeling of being

messages.3810: Maybe, just maybe, her heart is starting to open up.

I met Kotori while she was buying medicine from the

Now that Tamaki said it, i don't really have anything

instead.
messages.4883:
Feeling embarassed for some reason, I tilted my head up to
look at the big blue sky, and the white clouds floating
around.
messages.4988:
The wind started blowing through the rear of the gym,
showing the first signs of spring.
messages.5217:
While talking with Alice behind the gym as usual, Nanako
showed up.
messages.5285:
Piros asked us what kind of relationship we had, which
provided all sorts of disturbance among us.

messages.149:
I aimlessly skimmed the magazines at one of the bookstores
of the shopping district.
messages.209: I didn't have any particular book in mind.
messages.256: "(Today's Wednesday... the magazines should be out today.)"
messages.303:
I looked at the now-familiar "Subaru Bookstore" sign, and
thought about whether to go in, when I sensed something
coming...
messages.439: I instinctively hid behind a nearby streetlamp.
messages.525:
I held my breath. The footsteps, growing louder and louder,
suddenly came to a stop.
messages.589: It should be okay, he can't see me.
messages.630: But as I thought that, my heartbeat quickened.
messages.686: "Heh... there's no use in hiding. Come out like a man."
messages.765: I felt a gun muzzle grazing my head.
messages.802:
"OK, I got it. I'd give you all my money as long as you
spare my life."
messages.870: I smiled wryly, putting my hands up in the air.
messages.934: ...What if this really was that situation.
messages.1025: The bystander, Tsukkomi Kudou, entered the scene.
messages.1171:
He poked his finger into the head of the person holding me
at gunpoint.
messages.1243: Of course, that person was Suginami.
messages.1312:
"Damn it all... who would've expected you dirty fuzz to be
foiling my hostage-taking?"
messages.1453: "As I will keep on saying, what ARE you two doing."
messages.1496:
Kudou's voice sounded shocked, but he was laughing as well.
This certainly wasn't the first time he had seen us like
this.
messages.1639: "...Anyway, why were you all stealth-like when you saw us?"
messages.1697:
"Well, I was afraid if we met, it would trigger a route flag
that I didn't want to happen..."
messages.1783:
The love triangle ending with Suginami, Kudou and I, that
is...
messages.1851:
Following my words, I ferverently prayed that what I said
would not happen.
messages.1962:
Suginami's back hunched slightly, shivers running through
his soldiers.
messages.2018: I continued praying from the bottom of my heart.
messages.2091:
"Anyway, since we're gathered now, let's go to the game
center."
messages.2180:
"That is, if you don't have anything to do at the
bookstore."
messages.2265:
This person hardly ever changes his patterns, but since I
had nothing to do anyway, I accepted.
messages.2408: "Fufufu... I'd wipe you out on the court today."
messages.2472: Suginami mimicked smashing an air hockey puck with his hand.
messages.2644:
It's starting again, Kudou implied, as he held his head with
his hands.
messages.2786:
So, in high spirits, we--well, Suginami and I, and a
resigned Kudou, headed forth to the game centre.
messages.3067:
I had an encounter with Suginami and Kudou in front of the
bookshop.
messages.3104: After that, as usual, we headed forth to the game centre.

messages.142:
All throughout the gym, the sound of balls bouncing on
tarmac could be heard. The final gym class was Free Action
mode.
messages.210:
Of course, I chose to be in the "Observation While Sitting
In A Corner" group.
messages.303:
"What's wrong, Asakura. Why aren't you mixing it up with the
rest of them?"
messages.359: Suginami came up to me twirling a basketball on his finger.
messages.404: "...Why are you wearing your school uniform?"
messages.471: "The reasons don't concern you. Don't worry about it."
messages.561: "And why are you just sitting on a tatami mat?"
messages.690: "Well, it's a Free Action class, what's wrong with it?"
messages.794:
"Speaking of which, I saw you out there before you came
here, and you weren't wearing that."
messages.894:
"Don't worry. I most definitely do not want to know what you
were doing."
messages.967:
Definitely not, I muttered, as Suginami went back to the
playing courts. As I saw him off, my mind wandered
absent-mindedly.
messages.1072: After this, just HR is left.
messages.1294:
After this stupid self-participation basketball playabout is
over, just HR left to go...

messages.155: "Well then, I'd return your exam papers now."
messages.196: The class erupted with noise and worry following his words.
messages.227: Surprisingly, I was the odd one out.
messages.278: "(I think I did well for this one.)"
messages.313:
I looked at the bustling scenes before me with an odd sense
of calmness.
messages.375:
"I'd call your names by attendance number, please come
forward to collect your paper when you are called."
messages.422: At his call, I got moving.
messages.528: "Ooh, this time you actually got good grades, Asakura."
messages.579: "I guess."
messages.596:
Reading my test paper over my shoulder, I could hear
Suginami's muttering.
messages.712:
Attracted by Suginami's voice, Mako went up to my desk as
well. Suginami handed her my exam paper.
messages.1009:
I felt like I should protest, but I couldn't phrase it
somehow.
messages.1162:
"I'm really interested though-- Just what kind of trick did
you use."
messages.1249: Even I could tell I was joking there.
messages.1322:
"But that really is great, Asakura. You've gone up in my
view."
messages.1371:
I started feeling self-concious from the earnest compliment
I'd just received.
messages.1418:
"(In a way, I bet she cares more about others that she does
herself.)"
messages.1698:
She left my table, showing me a admiring smile before
returning to her desk.
messages.1762:
Suginami returned my exam paper back to me, and I tried to
avoid looking at Mako's face again.
messages.2010:
Exam papers were returned. Although I'm usually white with
fear in that propsect, this time I was full of confidence.
messages.2098:
Just as I forecasted, I got excellent grades, and Mako
complimented me a lot for it.
messages.2166: She cares more about others than she does her own matters.

messages.222:
I abruptly muttered under my breath, and Kotori looked a bit
like a surprised cat.
messages.388: My eyes gazed far into the distant.
messages.503:
For some reason, she looked at me with eyes that felt
affectionate, as she said those words... what did she mean
by them?
messages.633:
I better not think about it too deeply. It'd surely be
better if I didn't know the answer.
messages.707: "Anyway Kotori, I thought you went home already?"
messages.795:
"My friends called me to come to this classroom... did you
hear anything about that?"
messages.873: "Well, I think I remember something like that."
messages.904:
I quietly put my bag on my shoulder, and stood up from my
chair.
messages.962: "But as you can see, no one's around."
messages.1033:
"Everyone's left already, why were you still sitting here?
I've never seen you do that before, so you frightened me a
bit."
messages.1162:
"I was sleeping. And apparently my classmates were cruel
enough to leave me here till I woke up."
messages.1270: "It must've been a really deep sleep."
messages.1464:
"You said it yourself, you really should explain it, you
know."
messages.1520:
"Well, it's nothing anyway. What happened to your own cruel
friends?"
messages.1626:
"They're not cruel. We must've just missed each other on the
way, I'm sure."
messages.1736: "I guess they're probably waiting at the music room."
messages.1840:
"We're meeting to practice for the graduation party. It's
getting closer and closer, you know."
messages.1941:
Recently, lots of people have become involved in that thing.
Like Suginami. And Suginami. Not to mention Suginami...
messages.2035:
"If you're meeting at the music room, then I guess you guys
would be doing something related to music?"
messages.2129:
"Yes. We'd be putting on a musical performance. I'd be
handling the vocal parts.
messages.2224:
I could see it in my imagination. Kotori, standing on a
platform with a microphone, a beautiful voice emnating from
that mouth and reverberating throughout the room.
messages.2337:
It would surely raise Kotori's standing in the school even
further than it is now.
messages.2462:
"Eh, I, I won't become more popular just from that~. The
vocals aren't that important to a song..."
messages.2690:
"Y, yeah, you were muttering in a barely audible voice. But
I have good ears!"
messages.2779: She seems much more excitable than usual... well, whatever.
messages.2853:
"Sorry for that then... I probably said something a bit
indecent."
messages.2921:
"Anyway, what kind of song will you be performing? An
original?"
messages.3009:
"No. An original would be too much for everyone.. we're
doing a cover."
messages.3094:
"It's called "FIGLIA", it's a reaaaaaaally old song from an
Italian band."
messages.3178: "...Old and Italian? Guess they're not very big."
messages.3264:
"I don't know about that. We don't know everything about
people, and definitely not their tastes."
messages.3382:
"But, I think it's really good, and if people heard it,
they'd be all "Oooooooh" over it."
messages.3509: "Save that for when you actually hear it~"
messages.3548:
"Just preparing myself first. Both ways, I bet it'd be
great."
messages.3634: "It will. Make sure you come and see it!"
messages.3703:
"We started practicing 2 or 3 days ago, so we should be just
about ready by the time the graduation party rolls around."
messages.3843: "My friends are really skilled, I'm sure it'd be alright."
messages.3909: "You'd be performing in a group of three?"
messages.3974:
"Then, you're like the person the two skilled ones are
trying to catch up to?"
messages.4053:
"...Actually, I'm more worried about myself than anyone
else."
messages.4100: "Really? I don't see any cause for concern for that."
messages.4177:
"My practice time is... shorter. Especially since one day,
I'd be taking off for my own selfish reasons..."
messages.4259:
Kotori gave me a weak smile. It was one that didn't suit her
face at all.
messages.4329:
"But, well, your song could make even crying babies calm
down."
messages.4431: "Calm down crying babies... don't flatter me like that."
messages.4596:
"Fiiiine. Just don't be surprised when you actually hear the
performance."
messages.4744:
The more familiar smile returned to her face, and she bowed
down slightly.
messages.4838:
"Anyway, if I stay here too long to chit-chat, my friends
will get angry with me, so I better get going."
messages.5006: Kotori took light steps out of the classroom.
messages.5089:
Looks like I won't be able to go home together with her, but
oh well.
messages.5343:
The graduation party was approaching quickly. Kotori was
planning to do a musical performance with her friends.
messages.5431: Kotori singing... that'd definitely be a joy to listen to.

messages.153: I walked through the Sakura Park, on the way home.
messages.221: Tamaki... she was standing under a sakura tree.
messages.254:
She was looking up at the tree, seemingly thinking about
something.
messages.316: She turned around at the sound of my voice.
messages.404: "What're you doing here, staring at a tree like this?"
messages.453: "Is a discus going to fall from it?"
messages.651: She covered her mouth with her hand, stifling her giggling.
messages.684: "Well, then what are you contemplating about this tree?"
messages.755:
"No, it's nothing like that. I was just admiring how
majestic and beautiful it is..."
messages.835: "Heh, people who just moved here all say similar things."
messages.927:
"Yes. Seeing sakura petals that bloom all year long, is
wonderful."
messages.1000:
"Although, I can see why other people might think
otherwise."
messages.1101: "But to me, sakura petals display a mysterious quality."
messages.1142: "Hrm... for me, I can't feel anything special about them."
messages.1238:
"Although I have already been here two weeks, I'm happy to
still be constantly discovering new things."
messages.1386: "In that case, let's keep walking a little longer."
messages.1474: "Yeah. I believe I know of a place you haven't seen, yet."
messages.1603:
With her smile showing on her whole face, she followed after
me.
messages.1822:
"With such wonderful places like this... Hatsu-nejima is
indeed a splendid place to live in."
messages.1989:
"The spring sea is very pretty too. Music would go perfectly
with it."
messages.2100: "Yes, such as the strains of a koto..."
messages.2135: "Ah, that instrument women always play on New Year's Day."
messages.2204: "Yes, yes. Ahh, the wind feels good too!"
messages.2245:
She blabbered to herself, the wind blowing through her long
hair.
messages.2406:
"I had almost drowned in the sea during my childhood, but
strangely, I hold no fears of it."
messages.2493:
"Being surrounded by at all sides by water makes me feel
more relaxed."
messages.2597: "Since then, I've always loved the sea."
messages.2636: "Ahh. Well, I guess I like it too."
messages.2683:
You'd think someone with that kind of personal traumatic
experience would try to avoid the cause...
messages.2761: Maybe Miko really are given divine protection?
messages.2839: "Why would you like the sea, Asakura-sama?"
messages.2888:
"Well, I don't really have a reason like yours... the sound
of the waves do calm me down, though."
messages.3008:
"And looking at the sea makes me think of all the fun times
I've had, playing with others there."
messages.3120: "Yes. I feel that I am truly lucky today."
messages.3212:
"From fortuitously meeting you today, and learning of such a
wonderful place..."
messages.3364: She turned to me, with the brightest of smiles on her face.
messages.3426:
I tried to mask my embarassment with my words, and a big
yawn.
messages.3492: We bathed in the sun of another glorious spring day.
messages.3527:
Engaging in light conversation on this kind of day, made a
warm feeling course through my body.
messages.3608: That'd be what a time like this is called, for certain.
messages.3677: If you look at it another way, you could call this a date...
messages.3716:
That doesn't sound bad though. It fits well with the
atmosphere.
messages.3774: I warmly welcomed the name, as we walked together.
messages.3999:
Dropping by the Sakura Park on the way home, I found Tamaki
staring at a Sakura tree.
messages.4059:
We walked to higher ground, and Tamaki enjoyed the view of
the sea.
messages.4139: Anyone from the outside would've thought we were on a date.

messages.150:
Out from the bath, and onto the bed in little more than a
breath.
messages.244:
Although really, since we're just ascending into the main
school, the school doesn't change and the surroundings don't
change, so it's not much of a variation.
messages.334:
My feelings were pretty much the same way. No strong
variations here or there; just casual feelings about the
entire thing.
messages.408: My uniform will change as well... hm.
messages.441:
"In any case, tomorrow begins the graduation party
preparations..."
messages.492: I no longer need to set my alarm clock.
messages.523:
I've become nearly accustomed to it, but there's no need for
me to wake up at a certain time now.
messages.609: This time, I'd get up when I want to.
messages.796: Immediately after, my consciousness left my entire body...
messages.1487:
With the final classes over, I didn't feel any strong
emotions either way.
messages.1584:
That's probably because that nothing much will really
change.
messages.1672:
Well, whatever the case, tomorrow's just graduation party
prepartions. Sleep, sleep.

messages.242: "Spring is really in full flow now."
messages.285: Nemu squinted her eyes as she looked up to the sky.
messages.322:
"...Really? It's not like these falling sakura petals ever
change."
messages.397: "Spring isn't just about the sakura, you know."
messages.464:
"You can feel a change in the air, there are more insects
around..."
messages.551:
"Not to mention the shopping district always holds bargain
sales around springtime, to coincide with all the opening of
schools."
messages.639: "You've seen that a lot, I bet."
messages.694: "While the opposite holds true for you."
messages.826: Nemu looked towards me with a blank face.
messages.1023:
I grab at her head, looking down on her as menacingly as I
can.
messages.1081: "It's none of your business, stop talking about it."
messages.1174: I finally let go of her head.
messages.1229:
As soon as I let go of her twin underwater beetles, she
stood up straight again.
messages.1344: Straightening her hair, Nemu looked up at me questioningly.
messages.1508: "Brother, are you doing this on purpose?"
messages.1590: "I mean, what's your reason for doing this. R-E-A-S-O-N."
messages.1650:
"Hah? All the students go to school this way. Are you
feeling okay?"
messages.1722:
I unconciously started moving my forehead towards her's, but
the people around me managed to bring me back to my senses.
messages.1925:
"You're being rather weird today. Are you feeling okay? Is
spring doing weird things?"
messages.2001: That girl always makes me worry.
messages.2076: "I could say the same for you."
messages.2125: Nemu simply stated, a little smile on her face.
messages.2274:
"That from today onwards, school only consists of graduation
party preparations."
messages.2362:
"And that's none of your concern, since you shrugged off any
attempts to get you to participate with your famous
"troublesome"."
messages.2463:
"So the truth is that you have nothing to do during the
spring break, which is why you came. Right?"
messages.2549: Nemu grinned evilly, her cheeks puffing out involuntarily.
messages.2615: Damnit, why are her cheeks so damn smooth.
messages.2703: "...Nii-san, what's wrong? Why are you pulling your cheeks?"
messages.2861:
Nemu tilted her neck in thought, and I sighed and murmured
at the same time.
messages.3007: I turn around to face the voice from behind me.
messages.3078: "Good morning, Asakura-kun! And you too, Nemu-san."
messages.3179:
After just a slight moment of confusion, her transformation
into reverse mode was complete. She gave Kotori a respectul
bow.
messages.3377: "(...He just calls her Kotori so freely?)"
messages.3404:
The feelers on her head immediately stood at attention, to
my unawareness.
messages.3498:
"Well, the student committee is pretty closely linked to the
disciplinary committee, so we've exchanged greetings..."
messages.3612:
"I see. Anyway, let's head to school instead of just
standing around like this."
messages.3753: Our previously stalled legs finally began to move.
messages.3782:
But there was something particularly different than before;
something about our surroundings.
messages.3848:
I could distinctly feel as if I was being watched by several
people as I walked.
messages.3941:
The pain of popularity. It must be hard having a chip on
your shoulder like that.
messages.4005:
"By the way, what's up with the mask? Do you still have a
cold?"
messages.4087:
"It sort of got worse... I wanted to make sure I didn't
infect anyone else."
messages.4169:
...Although there's several male students who would faint at
the thought of possessing something of Kotori's, even a
germ.
messages.4293: "...No one likes to be down with a cold."
messages.4344:
"Pretty much. But you should be resting anyway, especially
now when you have no reason not to."
messages.4456: I turned my head the other side to Nemu.
messages.4538:
She was staring absent-mindedly at the ground, until her
head raised at my calling of her name.
messages.4698:
And with that, the conversation ended. Kotori looked at me,
as if expecting me to say something.
messages.4762:
Looks like the baton has been passed to me-- or so I
thought, until Nemu slowly opened her mouth again.
messages.4896:
"...Uhhm, Shirakawa-san, what will you be doing for the
graduation party?"
messages.5027:
"Just call me Kotori. And likewise, may I just call you
"Nemu" as well?"
messages.5181: "I'd be performing a song with some of my friends."
messages.5285: Wooow... I could hear Nemu mutter.
messages.5331:
"It's an Italian song. I'm part of a group of 3 performing
it, with myself as the vocals..."
messages.5428:
"The other two, one is on acoustic bass, and the other plays
the piano. They're really good!"
messages.5637:
As if just awakening herself to that fact, she covered her
mouth with her hand, then for some reason glared at me.
messages.5723: "But wouldn't an Italian song have Italian lyrics?"
messages.5817: "The meaning is clear though. It's like a prayer chant."
messages.5907: "But enough about me. What would you be doing, Nemu?"
messages.5944:
Immediately frank and up to the point. She certainly treats
Nemu differently than she treats me.
messages.6070: But that's the difference between males and females.
messages.6111:
Nemu on the other hand, looking a bit more at ease, returned
an easy smile.
messages.6199:
"I'm part of the disciplinary committee already, so I'm not
participating in anything in particular."
messages.6270: "Ahh, so you'd be like an usher. Let's do our jobs well!"
messages.6342:
Kotori bowed towards Nemu, and Nemu hastily and confusedly
managed a bow back.
messages.6387:
"(What are they doing right in the middle of the path to
school...)"
messages.6436: It's a little weird, yet somehow enjoyable.
messages.6507:
"What about you Asakura-kun? What are you participating in
to come to school today?"
messages.6615:
"Brother was just stupid and forgot that today was
graduation party preparations."
messages.6728:
The two of them immediately started giggling as if they've
been friends forever. What's up with that...
messages.6812:
As their mouths were getting ready to burst into laughter, I
said.
messages.6931:
"If you have nothing to do, why not drop by the music room
and watch us practice?"
messages.6995: "We'd be borrowing the music room from noon onwards."
messages.7114: "You should go, you seem to want to."
messages.7172:
As she said that, her face expressed a smile, but her eyes
didn't. Really, what a snide person...
messages.7268: "That's why I said, I'd keep it in mind."
messages.7359: We glared at each other for a bit.
messages.7382:
Kotori watched us from her safe vantage point, giggling
lightly.
messages.7617:
Nemu and I were walking towards school together. Suddenly,
Kotori voice called out to me from behind.
messages.7704: Her cold had gotten worse, so she had to wear a mask.
messages.7753:
Kotori told me that her group had borrowed the music room
for the afternoon, and invited me to take a look.
messages.7854: Well, I'd keep that in mind when it comes.

messages.226: A voice rang through my head...
messages.249: It felt like it was calling me from both afar, and up close.
messages.298: A gaggle of children were playing somewhere...
messages.341: ...Looks like I've entered someone else's dream, again.
messages.418:
As if answering my thoughts, a vision of a young girl
appeared in front of me. She was holding a ball.
messages.486:
She was playing with the ball, by herself. I could hear
playful voices elsewhere, but no one was around her.
messages.583: She had to be lonely, playing with that ball alone...
messages.655: Suddenly, five boys appeared, surrounding the girl.
messages.759:
The 5 of them stood, surrounding the frightened girl,
glaring at her menacingly.
messages.857:
The girl seemed to want to run away, but every escape route
was covered.
messages.941:
No matter where she looked, all she saw were the boys. She
grew increasingly scared.
messages.1037: "All those weird things you said really came true."
messages.1105: "Nakamura got bitten by a dog because of you!"
messages.1179:
The boy, apparently named Nakamura, showed the girl his
bandaged leg.
messages.1258: "B, but, I only heard it from God..."
messages.1314: She was trembling, but still tried to reply.
messages.1361:
Maybe it wasn't the smartest move, though... there was clear
anger in the boys' eyes.
messages.1527: "Why would God want to talk to you!"
messages.1785: Her eyes were watering, as she desperately pleaded.
messages.1956: The boys taunted her in perfect synchronization.
messages.1993:
The girl continued clutching the ball tightly. Her lips were
quivering.
messages.2038: Tears started to drop down the corners of her eyes.
messages.2073: The hell's up with these brats? Ganging up on a poor girl...
messages.2129:
If only this wasn't a dream, I'd be putting a stop to this
nonsense immediately...
messages.2213: "Hey, you better stop bullying her! Bad things will happen!"
messages.2299:
Another boy, seemingly a friend of the group, called out to
the boys surrounding her.
messages.2432:
"Bad things! That girl's a child from the shrine, you'd be
punished by God if you bully her!"
messages.2570:
The 12 pairs of eyes belonging to the 6 boys locked on to
the still-cowering girl.
messages.2644: The air seems to have changed...
messages.2733:
The girl's thoughts were communicated directly to my brain.
Each word seemed clear as day to me.
messages.2840: "(Why are they looking at me like that...?)"
messages.2881:
The boys' eyes had changed. Instead of firey or taunting,
they were cold and unnerving.
messages.2959:
Looking at my own gender behaving like that, made me
disgusted.
messages.3186: "We better stop bothering with her from now on."
messages.3239: "Y, yeah... I'm scared, something might happen to us!"
messages.3309: "The curse of a witch is scary!"
messages.3388:
The girl silently stood there, doing her best to keep
herself from crying... it pained my heart.
messages.3483: "(I don't want to cry in front of them...)"
messages.3522: The girls feelings were clearly communiacted to me.
messages.3621: The boys then walked away from her.
messages.3662: The girl, once again, started clutching the ball tightly.
messages.3714: A line of liquid dripped down her eyes, and off her cheek.
messages.3761: it struck the ball, leaving a wet spot.
messages.3796:
She endured, and endured.... until finally, one sad tear
escaped...
messages.4116:
The girl's tears started streaming, one-by-one, like a
waterfall.
messages.4186:
What a sad dream this is... I wanted to hug her, and tell
her it was just a dream.
messages.4256: But, I simply can't do anything as I am.
messages.4339: The girl eventually ran off, still crying.
messages.4404: The scene changed, to the shrine where Tamaki stays in.
messages.4453: She eventually reached the tree, and...
messages.4567:
All her pent up emotions were released from her mouth and
eyes.
messages.4641: The tears seemed to flow endlessly down.
messages.4668: Her wails resounded around the deserted shrine grounds.
messages.4711: I didn't know dreams could be as painful as this.
messages.4756: Besides this girl, I couldn't see anything else.
messages.4816:
Rather than some dream brought up from imagination, this
seems like a childhood memory...
messages.4953:
The sudden voice caused her tears to run dry, and she looked
around frantically.
messages.5068:
I looked up with the girl. I didn't have a clear view, but
made out the sihoulette of a boy sitting on a branch.
messages.5213: "If you can climb up here, you'd find out."
messages.5320: "...I'm wearing a skirt. I can't climb up!"
messages.5428:
The girl looked around first, to make sure no one was
watching. She then began her slow ascent.
messages.5538:
Her little hands and legs stretched with all their might, as
she climbed as hard as she could.
messages.5627:
The boy grabbed onto the girl's hand, and helped her up to
the branch he was sitting on.
messages.5729:
The boy's face was still hidden to me, thanks to the glare
from the sun behind him.
messages.5816: Looking at where she started from, her eyes grew wide.
messages.5900: "You cried so much... have this, it should cheer you up."
messages.5960:
The boy offered his hand to the girl, revealing a chestnut
manjuu on it. When did it get there...?
messages.6053: "Wah, a chestnut manjuu! Why's this here?"
messages.6098: The boy silently gave the chestnut manjuu to the girl.
messages.6156: "Is it really okay for me to eat this?"
messages.6224: The girl put the whole chestnut manjuu in her mouth.
messages.6435:
The girl put a hand over her mouth, as if trying to hide it.
She seemed genuinely shocked that she was smiling...
messages.6694: The girl shook her head rapidly.
messages.6737: "Witches ride on brooms, right? You don't have one."
messages.6851:
"Besides, witches who use their magic to help people are
really awesome!"
messages.6973: "Really. So you should be happy to be called a witch!"
messages.7136: The girl's face relaxed into a relieved smile.
messages.7185:
The two eventually dropped to the ground. But the boy's face
was still hidden.
messages.7305: The girl's thoughts flowed into me once again.
messages.7382: "(This boy... he isn't looking at me weirdly...)"
messages.7499: "(It's so weird... and I can't hear God's voice now...)"
messages.7671: "Friends? You don't have to ask me that."
messages.7819: "Then, I want to be your wife!"
messages.7984:
The girl stuck out her pinky. That obviously meant only one
thing.
messages.8083: The boy silently stuck out his, as well.
messages.8172: Right after, my vision exploded into sheer white.
messages.8285:
A girl, seemingly different from the last one, was sitting
in a chair.
messages.8349:
It wasn't the girl from the last dream... but the only
difference between them seemed to be age.
messages.8427: And she looks quite like Tamaki... it probably is her.
messages.8495:
...Now that I think about it, the previous girl looked like
a young Tamaki too...
messages.8565: So, the dream I saw just now... that was Tamaki's dream?
messages.8633:
In the white room--in the middle of the whiteness, Tamaki
inhaled and exhaled deeply.
messages.8687:
So many voices poured from the whiteness. They were the
words that Tamaki had heard around her.
messages.8851: "That's amazing. Can you see my future?"
messages.8971:
"We're friends, right? Please tell me how my boyfriend and I
will end up!"
messages.9047: "Eh? I'd meet with an accident? Don't joke around!"
messages.9112:
"I thought you'd be more serious about it... how
disappointing."
messages.9235: "(...I don't want to see other people's futures...)"
messages.9345: "(But... no matter what I do, I always see it...)"
messages.9389: "(If only I could control it, even a little...)"
messages.9449:
"(But this is the fate of all Miko... I must endure, and
surely God will protect me...)"
messages.9641:
Even after the dream ended, I could feel Tamaki's thoughts
within me.
messages.9771: It was on top of that tree, that I met... her.
messages.9818:
Considering what I did there though, how could I forget
about her?
messages.9898:
It felt like I was watching a dream. (Which I was really
doing anyway)
messages.10003: Why don't I have any memories of that event?
messages.10046:
My inability to remember it, and Tamaki's dream, made the
incident circle around my head even more.
messages.10157: Thinking too hard about it was making my head hurt.
messages.10202:
It's never easy to recall memories from young... that may be
the reason why I don't remember it.
messages.10299:
Yet... the feeling of creating that chestnut manjuu, and the
touch of her hand, seemed to linger inside...
messages.10428:
Why can't I remember it... regardless, that's undoubtedly
the reason for our engagement.
messages.10575:
It may have been merely a promise to marry, made as a child,
but it was still one.
messages.10665:
But that doesn't explain why she doesn't remember it either,
or the "deep bond" that we share.
messages.10784:
So basically, thanks to the ambiguity of dreams, many things
still remain unknown.
messages.10895: Tamaki had that kind of past, huh...
messages.10951:
She was never one to throw off her reservedness in the first
place. And with the ability to see people's futures...
messages.11019:
People who knew that, were curious about their own futures,
and wanted Tamaki to see theirs.
messages.11120: It was simply begging Tamaki for a favour, nothing more.
messages.11161:
They weren't friends. Just people trying to peek into the
fourth dimension.
messages.11208:
And when Tamaki did see the future, hear God's word about
it, would she have wanted to say it either?
messages.11286: It's fine if it's a good future, but if it's a bad one...
messages.11331:
It seems she'd been using her power to save other people
from misfortune, while still hiding it...
messages.11403:
The school'd been gabbing about it for ages, about her weird
behaviour.
messages.11450:
Whether to have everyone know about her clairvoyancy, or
think of her as a weirdo...
messages.11528: Don't worry yourself so much about it.
messages.11553:
I found myself saying that unconsciously. I wanted to say
those words to her, to comfort her.
messages.11629:
Carrying the weight of nearly unbearable feelings, I finally
got out of bed.
messages.11740:
School more or less ended yesterday, so there's no reason
for me to go there.
messages.11841:
Except for my encounter with Koyomi-sensei yesterday, when
she strongarmed me into helping her with her "projects".
messages.11944:
Why did I accept? Because I'm "sincere", "obedient", and
"helpful", of course.
messages.12047:
As I arrived at school, I saw the figure of Tamaki. It
seemed she had some reason to come to school too.
messages.12144:
With the dream still replaying constantly in my head, I
didn't know how I should greet her...
messages.12204:
As I wracked my poor brain trying to come up with an answer,
my legs kept moving to the point where she noticed me
herself.
messages.12347:
Tamaki greeted me with her usual mix of calmness and
innocence.
messages.12415:
She may be able to see the future, but she can't see the
powers I have...
messages.12501:
If she knew, and she knew that I knew... what would she
think?
messages.12571:
I forced myself to return her greeting as normally as
possible.
messages.12596: I really can't forget about the dream, though.
messages.12650: But how should I ask about it...
messages.12683:
Timing is of utmost importance on sensitive matters like
this...
messages.12728:
I should just cut the useless crap and get to the heart of
the matter...
messages.12784: Act first, get in trouble later, as they say.
messages.12864: In any case, the direct approach seems the best.
messages.12926: Just as I was about to start some conversation...
messages.13023:
Miharu made her presence known, with the sound of her shrill
voice.
messages.13270: "That's meaaaan, Asakura-senpai! And that's still a puppy!"
messages.13334: This really isn't the time to be cracking jokes like this...
messages.13597: "Just as I thought. You're famous here~"
messages.13712:
"I'm Amakase Miharu, of the discplinary committee. Nice to
meet you!"
messages.13796:
"By the way, the discplinary committee is the faction formed
to protect the order and safety of the school, day-by-day."
messages.13878:
"...The way you phrase it, makes it sound like you've been
influenced by those superhero anime."
messages.13949: "Nope! My ideas are entirely my own!"
messages.14096: "For today, I am once again a servant of the school!"
messages.14182:
"Whether trouble springs from the east, or hazards at the
west, I will rush to the scene of the crime!"
messages.14298:
"So, please excuse me. Senpai, if you wish to continue
associating with this guy, be careful as well!"
messages.14403: Miharu turned to Tamaki as she talked.
messages.14460: What an offensive thing to say...
messages.14503:
Knowing her though, she said it of pure innocence, not of
malice or anything.
messages.14629: That dream I saw was affecting me lots.
messages.14660: I was thinking a lot more about her feelings now.
messages.14720: She should be fine with that...
messages.14753: The way we are now, anyway.
messages.14869: Noticing her rudeness herself, she quickly changed her tune.
messages.14953: "It is fine, do not worry about it."
messages.15150:
With the timing shattered to pieces, I refrained from
enquiring any further about Tamaki's powers.
messages.15232: Instead, the three of us walked quietly into school.
messages.15448: I saw a dream of Tamaki's childhood.
messages.15475:
She was bullied by her classmates, and cried under a tree. A
boy called out to her from the top of the tree...
messages.15565: The boy presented a chestnut manjuu to Tamaki as a present.
messages.15608: No doubt, that boy was me when I was young.
messages.15645: It seems we promised ourselves during that time...
messages.15682:
On the way to school with Tamaki, I tried to ask about it,
but the interefering Miharu threw the timing off.

messages.137:
As expected, once I actually hit school, I quickly found
that there was nothing for sometone like me to do.
messages.213: "Bored..."
messages.232:
I cast my gaze on the students scurrying back and forth.
They looked like fish in a water tank.
messages.320:
Nothing for me to do here, I should just go home and
sleep...
messages.447:
"Yo, Asakura. Sitting, so filled with inactivity, in your
chair like that, you're a model student for the entire
student body."
messages.533:
"You're no better, standing there grinning like a stupid
idiot."
messages.627:
"Oh, I'm stealthily manouvering through the hallways,
carrying out my observations of student life."
messages.720: I played the straight guy to perfection.
messages.779:
"Why are you just sitting there like some deadbeat anyway?
Why don't you go help in the events if you have nothing to
do?"
messages.913: That's how I feel now, anyway...
messages.974: "Or you could help me with my project."
messages.1044: One of THOSE smiles. I waved my hand at him, bothered.
messages.1095: "I'd rather be home and snug in my bed."
messages.1157:
"Your participation would make the success of the project
guaranteed. You have an obligation to do so, with your life
if needed."
messages.1249: "Just what kind of project is this?"
messages.1381:
"Lately, you've been pretty friendly with Shirakawa Kotori,
haven't you?"
messages.1572:
"The matters concerning Shirakawa Kotori would gain far more
credence if they come from you, now."
messages.1682:
"What do you think are characteristics that a man would need
to be suitable for Kotori?"
messages.1779: "It's practically impossible for someone to be that."
messages.1841:
"Well, then apparently there's a man in this school who
makes the impossible possible, no?"
messages.1957:
"...Well, if she wasn't interested in any men around, that
would be good news for a lot of people."
messages.2065:
"...And relating to that, I've recently obtained the latest
gossip regarding Shirakawa Kotori."
messages.2175:
"This morning, you were found heading to school with
Shirakawa Kotori."
messages.2321:
"And later, both of you were holding hands and disappeared
into the shopping district while talking."
messages.2429: "...In other words, who are you? A robot clone?"
messages.2516: His completely idiotic words made my head hurt.
messages.2595: "If you're bored, why don't you go to the music room?"
messages.2679:
"I've heard that Shirakawa and her friends were doing
something there."
messages.2778:
Well, the chances of me going home and sleeping are twice as
small,
messages.2827:
The chances of me staying here, four times as small, and the
chances of me wanting to talk with Suginami more was 256
times as small.
messages.2919:
"Against all logical odds, you've actually managed to
suggest something good."
messages.3011:
"Ha ha ha, there's a reason why I suggested that, it's all
written in the stars."
messages.3187: Tired of fake laughter, I sling my bag onto my shoulder.
messages.3358: Suginami grinned widely, patting my shoulder.
messages.3409: "What the hell are you talking about..."
messages.3610:
In the end, I decided to see Kotori's practice session in
the music room.

messages.139:
Before I even reached the doorway to the music room, I could
see and hear the hustle and bustle of a major commotion.
messages.213: What I could see, was a massive group of uniformed students.
messages.256:
My ears heard the sound of a wobbling and wavering song--
probably the song Kotori's group is practicing.
messages.330: "(It's probably because of this huge crowd...)"
messages.365:
My reading of the situation quickly found it's way into my
thoughts.
messages.421:
"(To have to practice in this kind of environment, it must
be horrible for Kotori and her friends...)"
messages.497: ...Then again, I am part of that environment.
messages.545:
But this morning, Kotori asked me herself to watch her
practice.
messages.613:
And I highly doubt all these people were afforded the same
honour...
messages.685: "(So I'm not like the rest of these idiots. Right.)"
messages.747:
Re-assuring myself, I drill right through the mass of
students.
messages.1024: I drilled through the crowd, as if looking for treasure.
messages.1080: I've finally arrived at El Dorado!
messages.1210:
I rub my eyes a few times before opening them again, and the
figure of Kotori graced them.
messages.1278:
Standing there looking as relaxed as can be, with a clear
expression on her face, and of course, her voice.
messages.1358:
It entranced me to the point where I was able to ignore
everyone else in the room.
messages.1434:
Her entire countenance seemed like one of a goddess, passing
through the earth and blessing everyone with her song.
messages.1567:
Her partners on her flanks, the bass and piano player, were
very skilled as well.
messages.1614:
This'll surely be the main attraction of the graduation
party...
messages.1687: My eyes and ears were fixated on the performance.
messages.1827: Kotori started to bend over, coughing violently.
messages.1869:
Her friends looked at Kotori with worried faces. The
surrounding students broke out into a series of murmurs.
messages.2024:
Now that she could no longer hide behind the mask, it was
obvious her physical condition was still pretty bad.
messages.2121:
I'm sure that mentality is shared by all the people around
me as well.
messages.2156:
It's much better to resk one week fully than to rest one day
and let it deteriorate the next...
messages.2218: That way you can sing to your full potential, all the time.
messages.2292: I'm sure everyone else feels that way.
messages.2337: --Huh, she seemed to be coughing a lot.
messages.2450:
The people around me were whispering to each other in
restrained murmurs, yet every word seemed clear as day to
me.
messages.2465: Definitely I heard it... critcisms of... her.
messages.2541:
My curiosity piqued, I inclined my neck towards the source
of the murmurs.
messages.2777:
I turn around completely and see a whole bunch of students
whispering to themselves by the wall.
messages.2897:
They knew nothing, yet spit out their vile poison in such an
ignorant fashion.
messages.2924:
Kotori's violent coughing took it's toll, making her
collapse onto her knees, hands on the ground.
messages.2975:
Her friends immediately ran up to her, dropping to her head
level and whispering something into her ear.
messages.2994: --I thought Shirakawa-san was better than that.
messages.3072: --I bet she can't even hit the high notes.
messages.3111:
I guess it's normal to criticize something if you're
dissatisfied with it, like a movie's audience. But this...
messages.3191:
"(This isn't an official show. It's just a practice
session!)"
messages.3216:
Kotori's friends were still looking over her, visibly
worried and flustered.
messages.3308:
Aided by the poison from her "colleagues" and with one final
look at Kotori's pale face, I hardened my resolve.
messages.3437:
I shouted out as loud as I could, while clapping my hands
above my hand. Everyone's attention turned to me.
messages.3517:
I scuttled over near Kotori, and gave her a quick look over
my shoulder.
messages.3575:
"This practice session is now declared private! Everyone,
please leave the room!"
messages.3659:
The commotion returned almost immediately. All the people
looked at each other in confusion.
messages.3755: "Who're you to tell us what to do?!"
messages.3806:
As he said that, the student pointed a finger at me
accusingly, and the audience started booing.
messages.3896:
"Come on, everyone! This room is being used with permission
right now!"
messages.3968:
"Were all of you permitted in this room? When did that
happen!?"
messages.4032:
I could feel the glares from all the people in the room
(minus three). The booing stopped temporarily, and I
continued.
messages.4112: "And me? You haven't heard? I'm Kotori's group's manager!"
messages.4170:
The commotion came to a halt, as the room turned deathly
silent. I had came up with the perfect excuse.
messages.4293:
I gave Kotori an affectionate smile. One that she's given me
so many times before.
messages.4374: "Y, yes! A, Asakura-kun is our manager!"
messages.4506: "Now that you understand, please leave the room!"
messages.4545:
Silence. I could still feel the anger emnating from the
faces of the students.
messages.4621: Then-- I heard the sound of a door opening.
messages.4652: One student disappeared into the hallway. Then two.
messages.4689:
One-by-one, the students started filing out of the room and
into the corridor.
messages.4741: And when the final student disappeared through the door--
messages.4846: Kotori collapsed onto the floor again, exhausted.
messages.5039:
The music room was filled to the brim with people. The
majority, of course, were male students.
messages.5116:
Kotori was singing as best as she could, but eventually her
cold took over her will.
messages.5203:
And when that happened, the male students started
badmouthing her.
messages.5265:
I couldn't take much more of that, and came up with a lie
that chased the crowd out of the room.
messages.5346: As soon as the crowd left, Kotori collapsed onto the floor.

messages.180:
Having gone out to buy drinks, I returned to find Kotori in
the same spot, sitting on a chair. She gave me a weak smile.
messages.307: "Here you go. You drink black tea, right?"
messages.476:
With my arms carrying 4 cans, I couldn't pass her one
myself.
messages.546:
After Kotori took one, I passed two more to the two friends,
then went back to Kotori's side.
messages.669: I reached deep into my pocket, and pulled it out.
messages.791: Kotori rubbed her fingers on her temples as she murmured.
messages.847: "If you want to. Do you like chocolate?"
messages.1080:
She opened the can of her medicine. In the quiet room, such
a small action made a noise that echoed throughout the room.
messages.1201:
I called that out to the two against the wall. What're they
doing so far away?
messages.1309:
"...Those two are a bit embarassed about talking to our
so-called manager."
messages.1367:
Guessing my question, Kotori answered while giving me a
little smile.
messages.1431:
Her smile seemed so pale. It showed tiredness, as if her
very soul had left her.
messages.1634:
Hearing a voice from the direction of the wall, I turned my
eyes to look at the two leaners.
messages.1708:
"Ah, the girl who just spoke is Tomo-chan. The other one is
Mik-kun."
messages.1801: People address her with the "kun" honorific?
messages.2022: Looking weak, Kotori returned her fingers to her temples.
messages.2201:
"I get a lot of headaches... so this isn't anything special,
please don't worry about it."
messages.2271:
"Well, but... a bad cold along with constant headaches must
be painful, right? At this point, you should follow
Tomo-chan's advice..."
messages.2410: Kotori gently leaned her head to the side.
messages.2477: "I'd be fine after... a little rest. Just now, it was..."
messages.2551:
Kotori hesitated mid-sentence. After a few seconds, she
squeezed it out.
messages.2766: "...It somehow doesn't feel like we've just met."
messages.2799:
She then timidly held out her hand, as if she'd never heard
the words "Nice to meet you" before.
messages.2857:
I took her hand lightly and gave it a little handshake. Her
hand felt cold to the touch, unlike mine.
messages.2904:
"I'm Asakura... Asakura [name]. Nice to meet you. But, er,
how did you know who I am?"
messages.3004: "I've heard a lot... Kotori talks about you all the time."
messages.3103:
Kotori scowled at Mik-kun, albeit with eyes that denoted a
sense of closeness.
messages.3206:
"Geez~, you promised me you wouldn't say anything about
that, mother."
messages.3377: "Kotori wouldn't like it if I say anything more."
messages.3447:
Kotori was red as a tomato -- which was at least better than
pale as a ghost -- and stuck out her lower-lip poutingly.
messages.3566:
"It's not that I don't want to say it but... it's not
interesting for the person in question."
messages.3642: "No, even if it's not interesting, I don't mind hearing it."
messages.3752: Rejecting my plea, she opened her juice can.
messages.3873: The usual sweet smile. Her normal face had returned.
messages.4075:
"Um... Asakura-kun. Earlier, your talk about you being the
manager... was that...?"
messages.4159:
"Yeah, it was just nonsense. I had to find some way to chase
everyone out, so I made up a fib."
messages.4249: "That unruly mob could've probably rioted at any time."
messages.4363:
Tomo-chan laughed a bit, but had a dejected look on her
face.
messages.4442:
"We've told them plenty of times... not to come in. But they
keep doing so anyway..."
messages.4543:
"We'd normally go on with practice since we can't wait for
them to get bored... then that happened."
messages.4642:
Tomo-chan gripped her can tightly, her gaze falling to the
floor.
messages.4712: "...Ugh, I'm sorry. I was part of that too, after all..."
messages.4776:
"Ah, no no no. Kotori already told us that you would be
coming to hear us."
messages.4860:
Tomo-chan waved her hand and head rapidly. She seemed
genuinely afraid that I thought I was a bother...
messages.4962: "Both ways, Asakura-kun would make a good manager, right?"
messages.5030: My first instinct was to oppose what she said.
messages.5090: "No, not really... all I did was open my big mouth..."
messages.5249:
Kotori kept her gaze on me. Her tone was light, but her eyes
were serious.
messages.5328: "Asakura-kun... would you please be our manager?"
messages.5369:
"Well... if you three are fine with it, I have no
objections."
messages.5453:
Kotori turned her head towards her friends. The two of them
looked at each other, then at Kotori as they both nodded in
assent.
messages.5613: A laughing smile. Looks like the old Kotori has returned.
messages.5747: "Really though, I have no idea what a manager should do..."
messages.5813:
I slumped my shoulders slightly and shrugged. Modest or
humble or whatever, that was the plain truth.
messages.5907: "As long as you just stay here, it'd be fine."
messages.5995:
"Let's resume practice. We still have the room reserved for
about one more hour, right?"
messages.6107:
Kotori stood up from her chair. Mik-kun and Tomo-chan also
returned to their places at the piano and bass respectively.
messages.6214: Then, the performance started once more.
messages.6243:
More than once, it stopped due to untimely coughs, but they
continued best as they could for the remaining hour.
messages.6494: I made up a lie to shoo away the curious onlookers.
messages.6537:
Then Kotori suggested that the lie might not be a bad thing
to be the truth, and I became their manager.
messages.6601:
With just the 4 of us remaining, they practiced hard and
long without any unneeded interruptions.
messages.6663: Looks like being a manager isn't bad at all.

messages.153: Freedom, finally...
messages.180: That woman really knows how to make use of people...
messages.217:
On a beautiful spring day like this, I should be relaxing or
napping on the lawn...
messages.305:
Although to be honest, the thought of that never came to my
mind.
messages.354:
The only thing I could think about was the dream I had this
morning.
messages.399: About Tamaki's childhood, and her clairvoyance...
messages.473: I couldn't say that I wasn't curious about it.
messages.522:
But if possible, I wanted to give her a little of my
strength too.
messages.569:
If I could just talk with her about it, I could maybe help
her out.
messages.637: ...But, that may not be so easy.
messages.672: Miharu interrupted us earlier in the morning.
messages.707:
I hadn't seen her at all afterwards... guess I have to start
searching for her.
messages.783:
For cases like this, I should go to Suginami... despite his
"quirks", his network is second to none.
messages.894:
He seemed to be "busy" in school with the graduation party
preparations...
messages.1017:
"Your fiancee's run away? A divorce before marriage,
interesting."
messages.1160:
"If you're looking to start a consolation fund, I'm the man
you want."
messages.1209: "...Why did I even bother. See ya."
messages.1286: Completely insensitive to other people's feelings.
messages.1360: Is he even human at all?
messages.1436: "Now now, no one said I didn't know."
messages.1492: "If you know it, spit it out already."
messages.1563:
"But I'm happy it's come to this. I'd give you two my
blessing."
messages.1694: "I mean, for your marriage ceremony, of course."
messages.1794:
"Where will it be? The shrine? Or perhaps a more scenic
location?"
messages.1868: "...Since you don't know, I'd just go."
messages.1912: I have no time today for Suginami's idiot act.
messages.1959:
I wasn't expecting myself to be this nervous about Tamaki
either.
messages.2039:
Giving up on the idiot, I turned around and started walking
away, when,

"Of course you can say that, the two of you can practice at
home, right?"
messages.2526: At those words, the three started giggling.
messages.2582:
I kept quiet since I didn't really understand, but I guess
it was something to do with Kotori's conscientiousness?
messages.2737: Tomo-chan, understandably worried, raised her eyebrow.
messages.2814: "It'd... probably prolong your cold even more, right?"
messages.2989: "My white blood cells won't lose to some cold so easily."
messages.3078:
Having said that in the middle of coughs didn't make it
sound any more convincing.
messages.3189:
"But even if you say so, didn't you have to rest one week
for the influenza you had last year?"
messages.3299: "I, influenza isn't the same as a cold~ Right, Asakura-kun?"
messages.3361: "I guess. Like the difference between ramen and soba."
messages.3453: "More like the difference between a cat and a lion."
messages.3562: "...In any case, try not to aggravate it any more."
messages.3678:
"I know you're looking forward to it, but if you think you
can't handle it, maybe you shouldn't go..."
messages.3776: "Ehh... I'm sorry, but I can't do that."
messages.3821:
Kotori smiled wistfully. Mik-kun didn't do much more than
give a smiling sigh.
messages.3910:
"I know, before you even said that. When it comes to music,
you're a different person entirely."
messages.4041: "That's not true and you know it."
messages.4113:
Another wistful smile, as Kotori stood up from her seating
position.
messages.4556:
Practice with Kotori and friends. Despite her cold going on
for longer than it should, she still insisted on going to
her outing this Sunday.
messages.4642: She might break down if she continues with this...

messages.342: "Can we go to the Sakura Park again today?"
messages.461: "Compared to yesterday, it seems to be much better today."
messages.569:
"Your singing, I mean. Well, nevermind, it's just a
know-nothing's opinion anyway."
messages.657:
"You think so? But if you really think that, it makes me
happy enough... *cough*"
messages.733: "You just need to get rid of that cough..."
messages.804:
"Yeaaah, it's been so strange. Normally I'm strong enough to
recover from this sort of thing much quicker..."
messages.1143:
"...I've been trying my best not to break into a yawn for
most days."
messages.1276: "I've been reading a book... a book about vocals."
messages.1396:
"No, no, that's not good at all. Patients should get as much
rest as possible."
messages.1478:
"Do you need me to sleep together with you and sing you a
lullaby?"
messages.1557: "Eh, ehhhh-... don't say things like that..."
messages.1632:
"I really won't be able to sleep at all if that was the
case..."
messages.1713:
As she looked at me out of the corner of her eye, I started
getting too wild ideas in my head.
messages.1775: "I, I didn't mean it in the way you thought..."
messages.1835: It was just a stupid joke, that's all..."
messages.1914:
I turned away from Kotori's face, trying not to immerse
myself anymore into her eyes and those thoughts of mine.
messages.2068: I cleared my throat, and got ready to change the topic.
messages.2134: "Aaaanyway, you should really rest more at night."
messages.2224:
"I know... it somehow feels like when a major exam is coming
up..."
messages.2310: Looks like the plan worked. I let out my held breath.
messages.2391:
"I guess I'm still unsure of myself on whether I can do
it..."
messages.2451:
"So today, are you going to try not reading your book
instead?"
messages.2590: "Then there's no way you could sleep early."
messages.2651: "Well, yes... but it just eases my mind."
messages.2760: I addressed her in a purely dignified manner.
messages.2931: Then, we continued heading towards that place.
messages.2956:
For 10 years, this place has remained it's silent, usual
self.
messages.3024:
I suddenly remembered the times Sakura and I would play
around here, peeping into the holes in the giant tree.
messages.3143:
"(Well, even Sakura hasn't changed in terms of her
appearance...)"
messages.3192:
"But reading a music book or not shouldn't affect your
condition at all..."
messages.3264: "In the end, maybe it was still that annoying gallery?"
messages.3361: "...That was probably a factor as well."
messages.3447: "To be honest, at that time, I really felt horrible..."
messages.3505: "Yeah, really. Your face was as pale as a ghost then."
messages.3585:
It was the kind of situation where you'd nervously look over
your shoulder to check for zombies.
messages.3764: I stayed silent, and looked at Kotori.
messages.3795:
Placing her fingers to her temples, she looked upwards at
the giant sakura tree.
messages.3886:
"Everyone... everyone's always expecting something from
me..."
messages.3961: "...What am I supposed to think about that...?"
messages.4023:
"When did I become so good as to deserve that kind of
attention...?"
messages.4174:
That, oozing out from the people yesterday, was what caused
that situation to come about.
messages.4263: In the end, it was all about that.
messages.4296:
As far as I could know, Kotori didn't come by that title by
chance.
messages.4382:
Her general personality and talents brought it about, even
if she didn't particularly want it.
messages.4477:
And from that image of an idol, everyone started expecting
her to be things others aren't, just because of that title.
messages.4551: That was-- what they want to see, a disillusionment.
messages.4582:
It was the kind of image that she didn't want, yet she's
been so unfairly burdened with it.
messages.4730:
"And at the graduation party... it'd be even longer, won't
it?"
messages.4876:
The sakura petals danced between us, constantly striking the
giant sakura tree.
messages.4930:
"Start your practice now. For yourself. And for Mik-kun and
Tomo-chan."
messages.5156:
Taking a deep breath, Kotori walked up to the base of the
sakura tree, and around it.
messages.5210: The huge trunk completely obscured her figure from my sight.
messages.5297:
The sakura petals started revolving around the base of the
tree, as if drawn there by Kotori.
messages.5706:
Like yesterday, the two of us headed to the Sakura Park
after practice was over.
messages.5807:
Kotori was still worried about yesterday's events. Against
her own will, she was made an idol of the school.
messages.5961:
But that isn't why she keeps singing. It's because she loves
to sing.

We were just about ready to dig in, chopsticks in hand, when

I silently stared at the table. We had went to the

The sashimi just lay there, practically crying out to be

"It's really out of the way too, getting some more soy sauce

messages.940:
"Well, it's okay. Look on the bright side, we can still put

messages.1039:
The bright side aside, even a non-gourmet like me can tell

Sashimi was the main dish of tonight's dinner, but the

Making sure that my wallet was in my bottom pocket, I headed

"T, that's right! Do you want to try it with me? Sekken 4,

I'm not talking about Suginami, actually. He's not the

messages.338:
The "noisy" one simply likes to talk about everything and
anything without a care in the world.
messages.578:
"But I heard from Nemu-senpai that Asakura-senpai has just

messages.689:
"It's nothing to do with the graduation. There's nothing
wrong with me going to school, is there?"
messages.801: "Then it's fine. Now if you'd excuse me, I'm in a rush."
messages.964: "Ah, senpai just got shocked by that. I got it right?"
messages.1101: "No, it's nothing you need to hide!"
messages.1186:
Muttering that under my breath, I quickened my pace towards
school.
messages.1242: Behind me, Miharu started following me as well.

messages.1450: "I want to go see Tsukishiro-san as well!"

"After all, I want to be her friend. I should see her every

messages.1662:
"Isn't that the reason why you're going there as well,

messages.1783:
"Tsukishiro-san is so cute as well. With that and her

messages.1932: I ignored her, quickening my pace even further.
messages.2117:
Tsukishiro's slightly surprised face turned to look at mine,

messages.2314: Behind me, Miharu's face popped out, with a little wave.
messages.2446:
Tsukishiro squirmed her gloves off, and as usual, started

messages.2540:
"Yeah, it hasn't changed much. The fertilizer has been in

messages.2725:
"...Not really. People really shouldn't be around here in

messages.2962: "That's not true. It's not that you're not wanted..."

"Yeah... it's just that we don't want random epople to start

messages.3176:
One of the reasons why Tsukishiro chose this place, was

messages.3262:
Miharu and I didn't see a single person on the way here

messages.3376:
"B, but, we're glad that Asakura-senpai and Amakase-san

messages.3581:
"That's good. --Oh! Do you want to eat a banana? I thought

messages.3739: "Don't tell me you've never eaten one?"
messages.3799: Miharu slowly retrieved a banana from her bag.
messages.3865:
"...So your bag is used to hold bananas, and not textbooks,

messages.3981: "N, not true! I do bring along stuff for studying..."
messages.4043:
The flustered expression on Miharu's face showed just how

messages.4158:
"Okay, Tsukishiro-san. ...Umm, should I give one to the doll
too?"
messages.4349: Laughing a little, Miharu took out two bananas from her bag.
messages.4409: Tsukishiro accepted one from Miharu, and put it in her bag.
messages.4528:
And after a quick glance at me, Tsukishiro went back to
staring at the plant.
messages.4616: I sat on a nearby block next to her, and did the same.
messages.4680:
Miharu, standing beside me, then brought her mouth down to
my ear, and started to whisper.
messages.4789:
"...Senpai. Tsukishiro's just staring at that plant even

messages.4926:
"Since we're here, I thought we'd all talk, or do something,
or..."
messages.4998: "If you think so, why don't you try."
messages.5039:
Miharu, finally casting off the puppy-dog eyes she was

messages.5194: "Tsukishiro-san, would you like to talk with me for awhile?"
messages.5256:
Tsukishiro simply shook her head, and glanced at her doll's
face.
messages.5344: "Sorry. This flower is really important to Alice."
messages.5469:
Miharu quickly walked back to me. Then, this time with a
troubled face, started whispering in my ear.
messages.5611: "Tsukishiro-san... doesn't want to play with me~"
messages.5673: "If you knew her better, you'd expect that..."
messages.5750: "That's true, but... I want to be closer to her..."
messages.5820: "I can understand your feelings, but, well."
messages.5864:
I want Tsukishiro to open her heart more too... but I don't
know what more I can do for that to happen.
messages.5979:
If I try to overdo it, I might regret the consequences for
the rest of my life.
messages.6198:
From the trembling bushes, a tall man in dark clothes popped
out.
messages.6347:
Suginami grinned at us, then went to stand in front of
Tsukishiro.
messages.6444:
"Still taking care of that flower, as usual. But doesn't
that get boring, doing it every day?"
messages.6585:
"Me? I was wondering whether Tsukishiro-jou could teach me a

messages.6685:
"Having experienced Tsukishiro's mastery of the technique
yesterday, I desire to learn that splendid skill as well.
messages.6777:
Saying that "I've brought a doll too!", he revealed a panda
doll from within his bag.
messages.6876:
"It's white and black skin are it's biggest charm, and it's
actually a ferocious monster in disguise. It's Panda-chan!"
messages.6964:
As he moved it's arm up and down, the mouth on the panda
doll started moving as well.
messages.7050:
"Good afternoon! My name is Johnny Wolf, the panda! Nice to
meet you."
messages.7116: "It's so obvious that it's you talking!"
messages.7266:
"Exactly, and that is why I have come to partake in
Tsukishiro-jou's tutelage!"
messages.7336:
Suginami thrust the panda in front of Tsukishiro, and
started moving it's mouth again.
messages.7426:
"Please, teach me Pirosuki's skills. I want to be able to
talk too!"
messages.7502:
Tsukishiro turned her face away from him, and the doll's
mouth opened again.
messages.7610: "I'm not Pirosuki, I'm PIROS! Remember that name!"
messages.7695: "I remember you. How could I forget, Pirosuki?"
messages.7785:
"You don't! And I'm not some tool for ventriloquism, don't
put me together with that panda!"
messages.7907:
"So a panda can't do it... then how about this, twin
raccoons, Shizuma and Sukekiyo!"
messages.8010:
"Raccoons, foxes, whatever, you're completely wrong!
It's..."
messages.8099:
As soon as Tsukishiro put her gloves back on, the doll
immediately became lifeless again.
messages.8153: Then, forcing the words out of her pained mouth,
messages.8269: And with a bow, ran off.
messages.8377: Suginami was left standing there, dumbfounded.
messages.8529:
Putting back the panda and raccoons, he combed his hair with
his hands, laughing.
messages.8651:
"It didn't just backfire! We've been trying so hard to get
closer to her..."
messages.8769: "My dear puppy... I hold the same feelings."
messages.8918: "Tsk tsk. You two are so worrisome."
messages.8965:
When you're holding two different types of puppets like
that, who wouldn't be?"
messages.9065:
"Whether it's ventriloquism, whether Pirosuki actually
talks, the fact is, Tsukishiro-jou converses through that
doll, no?"
messages.9251: "And that's exactly what I want to learn!"
messages.9387:
"Tsk. At this rate, I won't be able to learn the true

messages.9522:
"Times have been tough. During a recession like this, taking

messages.9648: "Oh? Isn't it good once in awhile?"
messages.9730:
"By the way, just showing up in front of me, isn't that

messages.9849:
"During this time of the graduation party preparations...
just wandering around in front of a discplinary committee
member...

messages.10082:
"Well, my plan for a "Graduation Party Ventriloquism Super

"Haha, believe it or not, that's up to you, my dear puppy.

While talking, he stuffed his fellow panda and raccoons into

messages.10506:
"And Asakura. About you-know-what, be at the rooftop at 1600

messages.10593:
Throwing those words at me, he then disappeared into the

messages.10688:
"...Asakura-senpai, what did Suginami mean just now? What

messages.10799:
"I, it's got nothign to do with me! Suginami's just trying

messages.11037:
It seems no matter what, Tsukishiro will need more time

messages.11113: There's still so much I don't know about her, but.

I certainly know the full extent of the Banana Bomber's

Following up form yesterday, I went to see how Alice was
doing.

On the way, I ran into Miharu, who started asking about

We went together to the usual place. Miharu called her out

messages.11681:
Well, it's been like this all the while, hard to expect
anything differnt.

The bigger problem was afte, when Suginami intruded once

messages.11803:
Holding several strange... things... he appeared to come

messages.11928:
Despite his many attempts at cajoling her into action, she

messages.12020:
He tried to make us believe that he just wanted to get

messages.12100:
The fact that she never talks, and makes a doll talk for

interested in.
messages.12225:
I have no clue what Suginami wishes to achieve, but more

There was another woman as well, watching worriedly over

messages.911:
"This child holds the qualities and nature of a Miko. It

"But, well, you used to say, that it was your opinion that

messages.1184: "I see, I see. Then, it's just about this one."

Grandma, in so saying, once again switched her hair-messing

messages.1314: "Can you see the future of these two?"
messages.1382:
Each end of the Miko's lips rised slightly, in a gentle
smile.
messages.1455: "Heh, just wanted to make sure, which you seem to be."

I woke with a start, my body instantly moving into a sitting
position.
messages.1913: I flew out of bed like a bolt of lightning.
messages.1950: A quick dash down the stairs,
messages.2004:

in my hands.
messages.2070: I answered the phone, out of breath.

messages.2192:
What does she want that she would need to use the phone for?
