messages.4771:
It is a graduation now. If I wasn't honest any other time,
now would be one where I should.
messages.4933: "Aww, you mean it's not envy on a grand scale?"
messages.5388:
I came across Kotori and Nemu along the way. The former
reminded me that the contest was coming soon, and wanted me
to go watch it...

messages.154:
Did this school really have this many people? That's what I
asked myself as I gazed over the numerous male students.
messages.294:
All the giggling and gaggling around the room made my head
throb.
messages.383:
I sighed heavily, and looked towards the stage. A second
heavy sigh followed. On the curtains was a large banner:
messages.539:
It was just the same as last Christmas. And just like last
Christmas, I didn't want to be around such a huge gathering
of people.
messages.621:
"(About the only thing to look forward to is the girls that
actually come out...)"
messages.670:
Where all the boys suddenly learn exactly where their brain
is located.
messages.960: "Our deepest apologies for the long wait."
messages.1005:
Swept away by the wave of noise, the apology was barely
heard by the masses.
messages.1066:
"But now, we are proud to present you the Miss Kazami
Academy Contest, sponsored by the handicrafts club!"
messages.1153:
A series of shouts of approval could be heard from the
audience.
messages.1211:
Despite the comparitively soft booing coming from me,
several faces immediately turned towards me suspiciously.
messages.1301:
"Let's welcome entry number 1! The handicraft club's hot
pick! From Kazami Academy's Year 3 Class 1--Asakura Nemu!!"
messages.1433:
"--Is what I want to say, but unfortunately no! Asakura Nemu
will not be participating this year."
messages.1636:
"An invitation was sent for her to parcipate by the
handicraft club, but she cited that av illness prevented her
participation."
messages.1776: That Nemu, did she try and eat her own cooking?
messages.1829:
"Ehh~~, please settle down. Although you may be disappointed
now, I'm sure you'd enjoy what we have saved for last."
messages.1948: "So please sit back and enjoy the rest of the show!"
messages.2020:
From his pacification, the audience quickly quietened down.
They must be Pavlov's dogs or something.
messages.2126: "Now then, get ready for the first contestant!"
messages.2185: "Entry number 1, From Kazami Academy Year 2 Class 3..."
messages.2324:
I absentmindedly stared as the stage as contestant after
contestant came and left.
messages.2390:
I was completely oblivious to their answers on the greatest
joys and sorrows or whatever the hell the announcer was
asking them.
messages.2517:
As I murmured, more people turned to face me. I knew they
were trying to hold back some vicious words.
messages.2639:
"And now we present to you the final contestant in the Miss
Kazami Academy Contest!"
messages.2759:
Of course when the announcer referred to saving for last at
the beginning, this was what he was meant.
messages.2853:
"Presenting the handicraft club's hot pick! From Year 3
Class 3 of Kazami Academy, Shirakawa Kotori!!"
messages.2988:
The tremendous shout of joy from the crowd was enough to
make the entire stage sway.
messages.3073:
I tried to push my way closer to the stage, but to little
avail.
messages.3149:
"So, Shirakawa-san, how do you feel about being the last
contestant?"
messages.3247: "Yes, I feel like I've been waiting a long time for this."
messages.3325:
"Ohh, very composed words! You must be feeling very
confident!"
messages.3429:
"Eh? N, no, not really~ Right now, my heart is beating so
fast it hurts!"
messages.3523:
She placed her hand on her chest, and caused the entire
audience to let out a dreamy sigh.
messages.3607:
"Now, you said prior to your arrival that you had a special
announcement to make, so please go right ahead!"
messages.3717:
"Ah, although it's short notice, my friends and I will be
performing a musical piece for the graduation party. Please
come and listen!"
messages.3840:
All around the room, I could hear the sounds of pamphlets
being opened. It was so loud, even the deaf could hear it.
messages.3990:
"Alright, very well advertised! Now let's get the tempo back
with a few questions!"
messages.4096:
"What club activities do you participate in? The handicrafts
club, perhaps?"
messages.4180: ...That's a question I hadn't heard yet.
messages.4230:
"Ah, ehm, I regularly attend student committee meetings,
it's a sort-of special club..."
messages.4328:
"Understood, not very interesting so let's move on! Now the
next question... please tell us your 3 sizes!"
messages.4425: "Well, it's about the same as Doraemon, you could say."
messages.4495:
"Whoa, we have a maniac here! Of course for those who don't
know, Dora-chan has the same sizes as every one of you!"
messages.4634: "...Ahem, excuse me! I have strayed off track!"
messages.4716: "Then, everyone, time for the final question! Ehh, ahem!"
messages.4843: In a flash, the entire audience went quiet.
messages.4880:
I half-expected a stupid question like this. I looked at
Kotori, and she had a surprisingly calm look on her face.
messages.5011: "...Actually, I've been waiting for this question."
messages.5082:
It wasn't just me either. The entire room was awash with
noise. Even the judges and announcer had a confused
expression.
messages.5290:
She stopped in the middle of her words. The noise eventually
settled down as the audience figured out why she had paused.
messages.5376:
Now, absolutely everyone's gaze was fixated straight on
Kotori.
messages.5476: "I wish to confess to this person right here, right now."
messages.5592:
The impact of that revelation stunned everyone into complete
silence. The announcer and judges were speechless.
messages.5678: Unable to think of anything else, I started walking.
messages.5732:
Walking closer to the stage. Why I did, even I didn't
understand.
messages.5818:
"...Excuse me. To confirm the situation, I shall repeat my
question."
messages.5918: "Who is the person Shirakwa Kotori has in mind?"
messages.6020: The hundreds of black shirts started stirring.
messages.6099:
In the massive room, the sound of my footsteps echoed
loudly.
messages.6270:
Complete silence. I could hear and feel nothing from the
surrounding people.
messages.6429:
At once, the noise returned--angry ones? In any case, it was
quite scary.
messages.6503:
I could feel the kickback from all the Kotori fanboys in the
room.
messages.6608: "Excuse me! Please settle down! Please be quiet!"
messages.6666:
...Despite saying it several times, it was constantly
drowned out.
messages.6736:
But his persistence was to be admired. Eventually his cries
reached the audience, andmsilence returned to the room.
messages.6873:
"Ahem, so, Shirakawa-san has just said her confession.
However."
messages.6969: "We do not have an answer as of yet!"
messages.7047:
"Asakura-kun. If you are here now, please come on stage and
give Shirakawa-san your answer!"
messages.7122:
The recurrence of the noise that followed could be heard all
along the mountains and the valleys.
messages.7192:
Everyone was staring at each other, wondering who this
Asakura was. But I'm not just Asakura...
messages.7337:
I continued walking. The announcer was right. I have to give
her a reply now.
messages.7413:
She stood in front of this many people in order to deliver
her message.
messages.7537: I stepped up onto the stage.
messages.7554:
The spotlight was fixed squarely on Kotori, as she stared at
my darkened figure.
messages.7642: I continued walking forward. Forward until I reached her.
messages.7813:
She talked in a whisper that the announcer couldn't hear,
but I could.
messages.7896:
"If I didn't do it this way, I wasn't sure if my feelings
would reach you..."
messages.8081: Kotori's feelings. Her feelings of love for me.
messages.8126:
Compared to that, the rest of the audience's stares couldn't
reach me on the stage...
messages.8259: "Now it's my turn to show my feelings."
messages.8332:
"...I'm not an eloquent speaker, so I have to show you in my
own way."
messages.8398: I replied to her in the way I felt I should.
messages.8562: In that moment, my mind registered nothing except Kotori.
messages.8632:
Where I was, and my surroundings were forgotten. The only
thing I could sense were those soft, tender lips.
messages.8748:
...quickly snapped back to reality, as a hellish roar cried
out from the crowd.
messages.8846:
While I was in dreamland, two of Buddhism's hells was taking
form in front of the stage.
messages.8938:
Crying ones, angry ones, even ones who were taking off their
clothes...
messages.9001: "I think for now, it's best if you two leave for awhile."
messages.9079: I was saved by the announcer's quick-thinking suggestion.
messages.9159: She knows that this isn't the place as well.
messages.9202: With my face red, I held out my hand.
messages.9283: With a similarly red face, she held on to it.
messages.9527: The Miss Kazami Academy Contest started.
messages.9592:
After a bit, it was finally Kotori's turn. The announcer
asked her a fairly typical question.
messages.9695: Her answer was my name. I staggered my way onto the stage.

messages.250:
The graduation ceremony ended with Koyomi-sensei's final
words to our class, and we headed back to the classroom.
messages.328: I thought her speech would be a bit more sappy, but instead,
messages.396:
"Be careful during the spring break, you won't have my
guidance anymore."
messages.466:
It was just like any other parental advice. It was
disappointing, in a way.
messages.528:
Seeing sentimental words come out from her mouth, seems an
even longer distance away now.
messages.563:
The emotional factor wasn't completely neglected at the
graduation ceremony though, thanks to the songs sung.
messages.633:
"Look Up and Ahead", "Light of the Firefly", such songs were
perfect in stirring up emotions in a fragile heart.
messages.705:
Although half of the feelings could be attributed to the
occasion too...
messages.754: Life in this school was good.
messages.787: Not like much would change once April rolls around, though.
messages.839:
I gave myself a good stretch from the long ceremony, and
took a glance in Tamaki's direction.
messages.884:
I caught her staring at me, causing her to quickly look
away. Even her shy reaction was somehow cute.
messages.964: Looks like it has to be me to make the first move.
messages.999: I stood up, and went forward to Tamaki's desk.
messages.1185:
With her second "yes", she flashed a feel-good smile and
stood up as well.
messages.1241: So this is the graduation party...
messages.1333: "Hmm... where do you want to look around?"
messages.1368:
Tamaki and I observed the hustle and bustle of activity
around us.
messages.1403:
She never failed to walk exactly in step with me, as she
looked around curiously.
messages.1481: "Was there something you wanted to see?"
messages.1568:
Tamaki opened, and looked at the pamphlet distributed by the
Discplinary Committee.
messages.1628:
I wonder what stuff there is this year? Maybe she has some
objective?
messages.1692:
Suddenly, remembering something, Tamaki clapped her hands
together.
messages.1765:
"A few days ago, Asakura-sama mentioned something about a
maid cafe..."
messages.1829:
Her face displayed her complete innocence as she talked to
me.
messages.1891: If I let this just pass by, I may regret it later.
messages.1932: I made it short and sweet.
messages.1959: "Well... I don't think it'd be interesting for you."
messages.2124: "If that's the case, I can't think of anything else..."
messages.2169: She fell into deep thought again.
messages.2207:
Actually, maybe going to that maid cafe would refresh us a
little?
messages.2285:
I wonder, what would she feel, being served by another girl
in a maid outfit?
messages.2349:
I doubt she'd get all "cuteeee~" like us guys... would she
think it's normal?
messages.2431:
On top of that, it's a maid cafe... it would be weird to go
to one of those things as a couple.
messages.2517:
She won't be very happy at the amount of "reconaissance" I
would be doing.
messages.2598:
I was walking blindly while thinking, and Tamaki's voice
brought me back from my thoughts.
messages.2658:
I turned around. Tamaki was looking at a notice on one of
the bulletin boards we had passed by.
messages.2775: I backtracked and stood at her side.
messages.2798:
It was an advertisement for a sweet red-bean soup drinking
tournament.
messages.2843:
"Huh. The winner gets to go to a Dosney Resort, frolicking
with mice..."
messages.2961:
The prizes for these contests sure are getting bigger and
bigger.
messages.3106: Wow, her taking proactive action is rare.
messages.3162:
"Haha, no way. This kind of contest would attract those
weirdos who actually practice for it. We can't win."
messages.3268: "We'd never know for sure, until we try."
messages.3317: "I know you like sweets, but with that kind of body..."
messages.3383: It doesn't look like she could take that much.
messages.3420: Maybe 2 cups before she gives up...
messages.3479: "Then, let's have a little competition between us."
messages.3533:
I thought that would discourage her, but it only seemed to
provoke her fighting spirit.
messages.3601:
This is... odd. Was she irrevocably linked to sweet red-bean
drinks for years or something?
messages.3685: "If I win, we shall go on a date."
messages.3751: I was taken back at Tamaki's sudden propsal.
messages.3815: How did we go from sweet red-bean drinks to dates, though?
messages.3928: Tamaki looked at me from below, with puppy-dog eyes.
messages.3957:
With those kind of eyes staring at me, there's no way I
could refuse...
messages.4029: "It's not that I don't want to..."
messages.4195: "Hold it! What about if I win?"
messages.4244:
If I'm being forced into this, I might as well try to get
something out of it.
messages.4349: "Ahh, that's right. What would you like?"
messages.4394: "Hm... how about a week's supply of yakisoba bread?"
messages.4569:
We both walked to the registration counter, wtih a skip in
our step.
messages.4654:
Expectedly, there were plenty of well-built students there,
and the warming-up sessions had already started.
messages.4738:
Several cups of steaming-hot sweet red-bean drinks were
lined up in a white cross.
messages.4808:
Beside us, one rather portly chap was exercising his
abdominal muscles... his warming-up, perhaps?
messages.4915:
Wherever I looked, I was greeted by the sight of warriors
ready to do battle.
messages.4977:
Oh well... this is a battle between Tamaki and myself. I
don't need to think too much about the others.
messages.5083:
"Attention all, if you wish to participate, please submit
your entry forms!"
messages.5157: Tamaki and I went to enter our forms, side-by-side.
messages.5256: As she finished writing, she layed out her resolve.
messages.5327:
Honestly though... it's not like there's any pressure on me
to win this battle.
messages.5403:
Even if I lose, I'm not exactly getting the short end of the
stick.
messages.5465:
Yakisoba bread if I win, a date with Tamaki if I lose. I
actually have to think about which I want...
messages.5551:
Deciding whether to go on a date through a battle though...
well, if Tamaki's fine with it...
messages.5695:
The herd of contestants, sitting in a row, all opened their
covered cups at once.
messages.5792:
If I drink it too quickly, it'd have a bad effect on my
endurance...
messages.5864: And no matter how you cut it, Tamaki's still a girl.
messages.5903: She can't have that much tolerance for things like this.
messages.5957: The line between victory and defeat is sharp here...
messages.6000: As I drank, I stole a glance in Tamaki's direction.
messages.6039:
She was drinking out of her cup with the elegance you'd
expect from her.
messages.6107: At that speed, giving up is only a matter of time...
messages.6171:
...Those yakisoba bread are starting to look more and more
attractive...
messages.6212: I started to speed up my drinking.
messages.6253:
Oh yeah, isn't the beauty contest today? I wonder who's
taking part?
messages.6325:
Perhaps Shirakawa Kotori, the school idol? If she does,
she'd be the highlight for sure.
messages.6383:
I tried to fill my mind with thoughts like that to keep my
mind away from the feelings swelling in my mouth.
messages.6457:
By the fourth cup, the pain was getting exponentially
higher.
messages.6513: Five cups is going to be my limit...
messages.6573:
Just as before, she was elegantly drinking what was her
fifth cup.
messages.6639:
Gah... her reaction hasn't changed one bit... I'm going to
lose.
messages.6753: If I keep on going, I'd be putting myself in danger...
messages.6825: If I lose, I'd go on a date with Tamaki...
messages.6862:
But, before I could think about it too deeply, Tamaki
suddenly stood up.
messages.6970: She called out to me, just one seat away, in a strong voice.
messages.7013:
The abruptness caused a piece of the mochi to get stuck in
my throat.
messages.7062:
I quickly reached for a cup of tea and swallowed it down.
The last thing I'd want is to die here...
messages.7409: "I won't be able to make it there in time..."
messages.7487:
But she definitely seemed like she was backed against a
wall...
messages.7567:
I'd stopped caring about the competition as well, after
seeing her reaction.
messages.7608:
Tamaki looked at me, with the seriousness of the world in
her face.
messages.7680:
"Asakura-sama. You must run to the gym with all your
strength, and get onto the stage, at once."
messages.7779: Isn't the beauty contest happening there right now?
messages.7835:
"Shirakawa-san will be on the stage at that time... please
push her down."
messages.7996:
Tamaki grabbed my hand, and rushed out of the competition
area.
messages.8041:
Once we exited, following what Tamaki said, I ran as fast as
I could, to the gym.
messages.8105:
I checked behind me, and suddenly noticed that Tamaki had
thrown off her uniform, revealing her Miko costume
underneath.
messages.8189: Her Miko costume... that must mean...
messages.8234: What's... going to happen to Kotori?
messages.8304: I hurriedly opened the door to the gym, and rushed inside.
messages.8383:
Just as predicted, on the stage was Kotori, all dolled up in
a dress and being interviewed.
messages.8459: Without thinking, I ran for the stage.
messages.8517: Like a stampeding horse, I carved a path towards the stage.
messages.8564:
Sensing my intent, even the inteviewer quickly stood aside
in shock.
messages.8682:
Hoping my words were enough, I pushed Kotori to the floor,
and covered her with my body.
messages.8798: Kotori's eyes were filled with sheer surprise.
messages.8831:
The spectators were immediately put into disarray, wondering
what on earth was going on.
messages.8941:
I heard the sound of something breaking, right above my
head.
messages.8995: I steadied my balance over Kotori, and braced myself.
messages.9042:
Thinking about it calmly, I was in a rather incriminating
position, but I decided not to say anything about it.
messages.9133: The sound of sharp metal piercing something.
messages.9175:
Apparently, an arrow-like object had flew just above, and
past, my head.
messages.9267: I have thought such sinful thoughts of such a pure body...
messages.9327: My life might not be enough...
messages.9402:
The deafening silence eventually encouraged me to lift my
head.
messages.9451:
Tamaki, still clad in her miko-costume, caught my attention.
She was standing at the entrance, holding a bow.
messages.9543: That appearance, so beautiful, yet so distant...
messages.9594:
Looking around the stage, I spotted a wrecked spotlight. It
was pierced at one side by an arrow.
messages.9701:
Tamaki changed the course of the falling spotlight, by
knocking it away with her arrow shot.
messages.9788: I breathed a huge sigh of relief.
messages.9828: Kotori, still bound by my arms, was completely dumbfounded.
messages.9875: "Whew... it was just in time. Kotori, are you injured?"
messages.9973:
I looked below the stage, at the wave of onlookers trying to
comprehend what they just saw. It was so silent.
messages.10228:
What started from one person's mouth, became a cacophany of
sound throughout the entire gym.
messages.10331: Soon, the applause began, echoing everywhere.
messages.10395: Tamaki was completely lost at what to do.
messages.10434: She seemed like a mouse, frightened and timid.
messages.10512: I better go to her side...
messages.10551: I got up from over Kotori, and dusted her off.
messages.10642: Kotori thanked me, seeming to have calmed down a little.
messages.10755: I then started to dust my own uniform off.
messages.10823: I left her on the stage, feeling a little bad for doing so.
messages.10879:
But, there was somoene who needed me. I hurried to where
Tamaki was.
messages.10940:
Surrounded by a wall of male students, Tamaki's eyes
pleadingly looked in my direction.
messages.11014: I took her hand into mine.
messages.11114:
I accompanied her out of the still-tumultous gymnasium, like
a scene from a movie.
messages.11194:
The baying of the crowd, wanting us to come back, reached my
ears...
messages.11264:
With the sensation of Robin Hood's hand flowing through my
own...
messages.11398: Tamaki and I ran off, for the rooftop, at full speed.
messages.11441:
Out of breath, we stopped and held on to a fence to support
ourselves.
messages.11557: I said to no one in particular.
messages.11586: Tamaki, catching her breath, simply smiled.
messages.11633: "Well, thanks to your "yin", we managed to save Kotori."
messages.11852: Tamaki's cheeks slowly started to redden. It was so cute...
messages.11929:
The brave Robin Hood who rescued the school idol... was a
blushing young girl, in front of my eyes.
messages.12083:
Helping out and saving people always leaves a good
aftertaste.
messages.12153: The air at the rooftop seemed fresher then before.
messages.12262:
Unlike my feelings of contentment, Tamaki's face was clouded
with regret.
messages.12453: "I'm glad that we were able to save Shirakawa-san..."
messages.12532:
Tamaki returned my smile, but couldn't hide her
expression...
messages.12663:
Is there even something more that I don't understand about
her?
messages.12751:
"Now, everyone will know about my clairvoyance for
certain..."
messages.12843:
With such a flashy rescue, there's no way it won't become
instant publicity material.
messages.12909: The rumours WILL spread, and the truth will be found out.
messages.12958: The whole school will soon realize Tamaki as a "prophet"...
messages.13032:
In fact, she's probably scared of that due to her
experiences at her previous schools.
messages.13159: All wanting to ask about their futures.
messages.13192:
So, to keep from that, staying distant from the people she
first meets...
messages.13262: I can't imagine feeling that kind of pain myself...
messages.13324:
"If people come up to you and ask weird things, call me. I'd
deal with it, somehow."
messages.13413: I can do this for her...
messages.13454:
Of course, this won't be able to lighten her heart by
itself.
messages.13526:
But no matter what, if anyone in school tries to mess with
her, I won't forgive them.
messages.13594:
I won't let her feel the loneliness and despair from her
last schools, now.
messages.13732: She was still as downhearted as before.
messages.13806: With a deep breath, Tamaki turned to face me.
messages.14027: Just what is she going on about?
messages.14127:
"You're not very good at reading a girl's feelings, are you,
Asakura-sama?"
messages.14242: "I thought you might be a little better at that..."
messages.14312: A lonely smile accompanied her words.
messages.14370: I must've said something really odd...
messages.14432: "What IS it that has you so troubled?"
messages.14467: Her face still carried a dark expresison.
messages.14526: "....The... date... that we promised, is gone..."
messages.14598: "Ah, you mean... the competition just now?"
messages.14669:
In all the excitement, I'd completely fogotten. She
challenged me in order to win a date.
messages.14757: In the end, the battle didn't finish.
messages.14792: I looked back to see the competition still going strong.
messages.14837:
Well... if the challenge had continued, I wouldn't have been
able to take more than 5 cups...
messages.14917: It really should've been my loss to accept.
messages.15034: "I lost the sweer red-bean drink competition."
messages.15161: I found myself drawn in by those mysterious eyes...
messages.15221: "I would have given up sooner rather than later."
messages.15309: "So, we can count that as a victory for you."
messages.15446: "Yeah. I'd go on a date with you."
messages.15534: "That is fine as your prize, right?"
messages.15575: It really seems more like a win for me.
messages.15667: The smile returned to her face, a wonderful and bright one.
messages.15737: I'd not seen such a beautiful smile before.
messages.15801:
At the rooftop, the wind blowing around us, we exchanged
promises to go on a date.
messages.15863: The feeling of us surrounded by the wind... so pleasant.
messages.16055:
Tamaki and I were looking around the graduation party, when
Tamaki happened upon a flyer for a sweet red-bean drink
competition.
messages.16139:
Tamaki said that if she won, she wanted to go on a date with
me.
messages.16205:
But, during the battle, Tamaki foresaw danger happening to
Kotori, and abandoned the competition.
messages.16271:
Following Tamaki's words, I rushed to the beauty contest
venue, and just made it in time to save Kotori.
messages.16353:
Eventually, we escaped from the gym, and managed to find our
way to the rooftop.
messages.16402:
There, Tamaki was down, having her power exposed. I promised
to protect her from whatever gossip would occur.
messages.16519:
In truth though, she was more disappointed about losing her
chance at a date with me.
messages.16603:
I let Tamaki know that I was about to give up on the
competition anyway, and asked her out on a date.

messages.179: The graduation ceremony took place with no major incident.
messages.253:
The refreshing, warm spring wind felt great as it blew past
me.
messages.339:
In my hand was my diploma wrapped up in a tube--with a
rather strange fish scale-like pattern on it.
messages.450:
--Maybe this school is into more occult things than I
realized...
messages.555: I yawned and stretched, pleasantly bored.
messages.639:
I might as well enjoy it while I can; there's a compulsory
event coming up anyway.
messages.693: "I guess I'd see how the graduation party is going."
messages.740:
I stood up and started exploring the various food carts and
stores around,
messages.835: Kudou was standing some ways away, deep in thought.
messages.944: I called out to him, waving my hand.
messages.1039:
A gust of wind blew past the open window, setting Kudou's
hair asway. It had an amazing sheen as it shook.
messages.1217:
"Not really...... just thinking about how hard we all worked
to get past these three years."
messages.1293: His deep feelings on the subject were plain to see.
messages.1322:
He's talking as if he's some baby bird getting ready to
leave the nest... what a dreamy fellow.
messages.1406:
"Geez, I can see your emotion dripping onto the floor. We'd
still be in the same school for the next three years, no?"
messages.1569:
Kudou glanced at me with slight displeasure. It's true,
though...
messages.1785: "Don't act dumb, I meant the second button."
messages.1851: Now that he said it, I did promise that a few days ago.
messages.1890: I wasn't acting dumb, I'd really completely forgotten.
messages.1981:
I put all my strength into tearing the button off my
uniform.
messages.2035:
But it was made well. The button still held tight
stubbornly.
messages.2151: "You're going to put a hole in your uniform like that."
messages.2198: Kudou started nagging at me for some reason.
messages.2249:
"It's fine. We'd have new uniforms for the new school year
anyway."
messages.2343: "That's not the problem! It's a precious thing, you know."
messages.2469:
Kudou took a familiar-looking pair of scissors from his
chest pocket, and brought it to my uniform.
messages.2552: "I'm going to cut it, don't move."
messages.2602:
With the top of Kudou's head in front of me, I could smell a
fragrant citrus scent, giving me a weird feeling...
messages.2723:
At the same time I felt something being cut away from my
uniform, Kudou's head retracted itself from it's proximity
to my chest.
messages.2815: "Done. I'd go give it to her now."
messages.2854: The second button of my uniform was safely snug in his hand.
messages.2955: I shouted out hurriedly at Kudou's fast-moving back.
messages.3063: He turned around to face me again.
messages.3088: "You're going to hand over the button, right? Can I go too?"
messages.3154:
Getting my thoughts together quickly, I knew that at the
very least, I wanted to see this girl once.
messages.3303:
Kudou's reaction was surprisingly quick, shaking his head
back and forth vigourously.
messages.3359: "Why not? It'd be good to meet her."
messages.3410: My lips turned into a small pout.
messages.3508:
"...I bet you were lying about the kimono-wearing girl,
weren't you? It's some gorgonzola space creature, isn't it!"
messages.3631: My aggresive tone made his face turned bright red.
messages.3821:
"Uh, but, that's... she's the really shy type, so if she
actually met you in person, she'd get embarassed and run
away!"
messages.3928:
He was gnashing his teeth as he explained... what's with the
suspicious behaviour?
messages.4064: "...I, in any case! I can't let you meet her!"
messages.4171:
Kudou threw his graduation certificate tube at me as a
distraction, then quickly ran off.
messages.4284:
Searching for this girl would be like trying to find a
needle in a haystack as well.
messages.4344: ...Well, he said it wasn't some space monster at least.
messages.4393:
I bet he was made to promise by that girl not to let me see
her, and tried to put it on himself...
messages.4487: "(I really do have my very own yamato nadesico...)"
messages.4556:
--But it's not really realistic to say that when I haven't
even seen her face.
messages.4638: Thus, my interest in the Yet-To-Be-Seen Girl grew even more.
messages.4867:
While wandering about the food stores at the graduation
party, I bumped into Kudou.
messages.4935:
After relieving me of my uniform's second button, I asked
about my secret admirer, but he ran away.
messages.5064: Grr, I just want to see her face!

messages.214:
On the way back from the graduation ceremony, as I walked
through the sakura-laden campus, my sighs echoed loud and
true.
messages.296: The graduation party at the school had barely begun.
messages.399:
I never liked all that hustle and bustle, so I headed for
the school gates.
messages.459:
Apparently I was the only one who scorned this much-awaited
event. Not a single soul was around me as I walked out.
messages.611:
Just like the falling sakura petals, uncertain of where they
would land, I was filled with the same feelings.
messages.667:
...Being the only one not participating in the graduation
party really was discouraging.
messages.743:
Thanks to all the situations that occured, there isn't any
girl by my side as I walked.
messages.831:
"(Maybe if I was more proactive those days, the situation
would be different now...)"
messages.901: My thoughts wandered to those enjoying the festival.
messages.988:
Nemu and Miharu would, of course, be seriously fulfilling
their disciplinary committee duties.
messages.1060:
Kotori and Mako would probably be helping clean up after...
Moe-senpai would just fall asleep.
messages.1163:
Sakura... now that I think about it, I didn't see her at all
there. Well, she's impossible to pin down to one place
anyway.
messages.1282:
Really, knowing so many fine young women so well, any other
person wouldn't be in this situation on graduation day...
messages.1438:
Others are others, and I am myself. I'd just assume the
"lone wolf" motif, and won't think about it.
messages.1528:
...That's right. No reason to think about it any further if
it can't be solved.
messages.1650: A voice echoed out from behind me.
messages.1754:
I turned around to see Kudou, holding his graduation
certificate tube like myself.
messages.1887:
Kudou's always been popular with the girls, and he's as
close to a bishounen as you can get.
messages.1947:
Considering today's supposed to be a special event, I
would've figured that something special would've happened...
messages.2065:
"Well, a girl brought me to the back of the school to
confess with a letter... but I turned her down."
messages.2283: Kudou gave me a strange look for my "say no more" attitude.
messages.2330:
"Are you trying to underline the difference between us,
Kudou-kun?"
messages.2420: "Eh? N, no, that wasn't what I was trying to say..."
messages.2463: He covered his mouth in slight embarassment.
messages.2553: "I'm just not searching for a girlfriend right now."
messages.2598: "...At least you have the luxury of choice, eh."
messages.2623:
I said plainly what I thought. This guy, when he does
actually start to search for a girlfriend, will have the
pick of the litter.
messages.2738:
I slapped my cheek with my hand. I shouldn't be stupid,
that's not decided yet... people are people, after all.
messages.2872: "...3 years... we worked hard to get here."
messages.2932: His words was filled with thoughtful emotion.
messages.2975:
"What're you trying to say? After the break, we'd still be
walking this way to school again."
messages.3089:
"That's true, but... pah, you're horrible at reading the
atmosphere."
messages.3147: He glared at me from the corner of his eye.
messages.3192: "This isn't the mood that two idiots should be in."
messages.3252: I stretched back and released a big yawn.
messages.3364:
He muttered those words, gazing at my laid-back demeanour
with a wry smile.
messages.3443: "...But that's something I've always envied about you."
messages.3525:
I turned my head to face him, wiping the tears from my eyes
from the yawn.
messages.3583:
"No matter the situation, always being the same. You have a
firm grasp of what makes you, you. That's what I'm envious
of."
messages.3741:
...That's the first time someone's said that to me. It's not
like I was conciously trying to be myself...
messages.3863: "...I'd work hard, and try to follow your example."
messages.3914: He laughed as he said that, somewhat out of place.
messages.4030:
"Given that I'm a friend of you and Suginami, that's to be
expected."
messages.4176: I laughed and puched Kudou int he back a few times.
messages.4234:
From these years of knowing him, I've come to realize that
he's far more interesting than just a pretty face.
messages.4326:
When the new school year starts, I should try to get a bit
closer to him...
messages.4398:
That's right, I still have my future before me. Who knows
what encounters I'd have that will shape my future in the
main school.
messages.4565: "Wha...? You scared me there, geez. What is it?"
messages.4604:
He rolled his eyes as my voice unexpectedly rose several
notches.
messages.4687: I smiled and stretched a little.
messages.4732: "...Anyway, are you heading back as well?"
messages.4786: "I guess so. I don't have a companion for the party."
messages.4829: A brief, almost curt response from him.
messages.4862: "Want to look around the graduation party with me, then?"
messages.4913:
If I went home now, I'd just fall asleep. I don't want to
waste my good mood now that I've finally got it back.
messages.5048:
His face changed from one of surprise, to one of
appreciative thoughtfulness.
messages.5137: "Why not? It'd be good once in awhile."
messages.5176:
"Good! First target, the food stores! The goal is complete
consumption! Let's go!"
messages.5288:
Barely even waiting for his answer, I grabbed his hand and
started walking back to school.
messages.5342:
Just sitting here and whining long-windedly, nothing will
come from that.
messages.5402: I'd move ahead, believing in the bright future!
messages.5612: Today was the graduation party, and I was left alone.
messages.5659:
Just as I was starting to walk back home, I bumped into
Kudou.
messages.5708:
After talking about lots of things, I regained my
positivity, and convinced Kudou to look around the
graduation party together.
messages.5817: I'd move ahead, believing in the bright future!

messages.198: Leaning against the school gate, I let out a small sigh.
messages.237:
In the end, we were caught by a lecturer, and I thanked God
that we weren't punished with anything worse than a
scolding.
messages.340:
But in order to prevent chaos, he ordered that I would not
be able to attend the trio's performance for the graduation
party.
messages.458:
Thanks to that, I ended up not being able to see Kotori's
gallant figure in full flight. What a crappy manager I was.
messages.607: "Hey, Kotori, good wo... huh, where's the other two?"
messages.693:
"They didn't want to be in the middle of a romantic moment,
so they left first."
messages.894: "How was it? The performance, I mean."
messages.929: Kotori nodded, satisfied, and gave me a thumbs-up.
messages.1015:
"Absolutely perfect. We ended spectacularly, as well. At the
end, the applause was deafening..."
messages.1103:
So to say, she closed her eyes as soon as the song ended and
let her hears tell her everything she needed to know.
messages.1222: "Thank you... We couldn't have done it without you, either."
messages.1273:
"No no, I didn't do anything... anyway, let's go. I'd walk
you home."
messages.1375: All of a sudden, Kotori's expression softened even further.
messages.1743:
"Even if I wanted to, I can't stop smiling and giggling once
in a while to myself now..."
messages.2035: She grinned and elbowed me lightly.
messages.2101: "Wa, ha ha ha ha ha ha ha."
messages.2213: "It's from the final boss of Spartoy X."
messages.2382: Sho looked towards me and smiled sweetly.
messages.2429:
"...By the way, that makes the third time you've asked that
now."
messages.2516: "Eh? It can't be only that little..."
messages.2586: "How many times do you plan to say it, then?"
messages.2643:
"...Several. It'd take a long time for me to digest this
happiness. Let me chew on it for awhile."
messages.2783:
I was just as happy really, but my sarcastic language still
came to the fore.
messages.2867: "Eating a lot then sleeping, sounds good though."
messages.3013: "Heh... our true feelings couldn't reach him..."
messages.3072:
I stared up into the dark sky, and talked into the spring
wind.
messages.3140:
Although the island's sakura petals weren't fluttering at
this time, I could still smell their scent.
messages.3276: "That's true... just look at what happened just now."
messages.3346:
"It doesn't even feel like just now. I'm still looking over
my shoulder occasionally to check."
messages.3526:
"Geez, it's not our fault that we get stared at by the
entire student body as someone to be looked up to..."
messages.3699:
We continued walking down the road, the two of us together.
We slowed our speed, not wanting to reach her home just yet.
messages.3881: "It's starting to get a bit cold."
messages.3946:
"You think? Now that the sun's down, it feels just right for
me..."
messages.4012: "...Hmm, that wasn't what you were supposed to say."
messages.4070: I took my hand out from my pocket.
messages.4119:
""Let me warm your hand". Now that would have been
appropriate."
messages.4264: "Isn't it a bit late for that now?"
messages.4331: "...It's starting to get a bit cold."
messages.4383: As soon as she said that, I took her hand.
messages.4416: Her hand was soft and warm.
messages.4457:
I felt as if our hearts were connected through that physical
contact.
messages.4555: But this time, the pounding was a heavenly feeling.
messages.4594: "(I wonder if she's feeling the same way...)"
messages.4676: I started feeling a little embrassed.
messages.4728: "It's okay, my heart is pounding too."
messages.4812: "When we kissed in front of everyone else, at that time..."
messages.4917: Gradually, I started feeling warmth all over.
messages.5019: Eventually, we reached the front of Kotori's house.
messages.5064: Reluctantly, I let go of her hand.
messages.5101: Just in front of her gate, Kotori turned around.
messages.5183: "Asakura-kun. Let's go on a date tomorrow."
messages.5245:
As that word reverberated around my brain for awhile, I
slowly nodded.
messages.5341: "Then, shall we meet at the school gates at 12?"
messages.5405: "Got it. Geez, now I'd end up staying up all night waiting."
messages.5559: "Then again, I'd probably be guilty of the same thing..."
messages.5664: "I'm still so excited, I don't think I can sleep..."
messages.5794:
Giving me a quick wave, she suddenly disappeared into her
house.
messages.5862: "...Me too, maybe I should buy some sleeping pills."
messages.5913:
I gripped my hand tightly, not wanting the leftover warmth
on it to escape.
messages.6144:
I couldn't watch the performance, but Kotori said it went
perfectly. I'm glad.
messages.6241:
Then I walked Kotori home. The atmosphere seems even sweeter
than usual.

messages.199: On this beautiful day, I can do what I want!
messages.230:
It's not a Sunday, nor spring break yet, but simply the
glory of a rest day for us graduates.
messages.292:
It seems the school will continue to hold lessons through
next week, though.
messages.341:
Unlike last year, where I was jealous of the graduates, this
time, I'm the hero!
messages.442:
With that mood, the ever-blooming sakura petals seemed even
more pleasant than usual.
messages.551:
Just about time for lunch period. Tsukishiro'd surely check
on that plant... that Roskill Lavender, once lessons end.
messages.654:
I looked at the clock in the park. Figuring that it was a
suitable time, I started heading for the school.
messages.716:
I had to try and tell Alice what I had heard from Sakura
yesterday; that there's no way the Roskill Lavender can
bloom in Japan.
messages.837:
She may well have to find out sooner or later, but in this
case, it'd probably be much better if it's sooner.
messages.911: The longer I wait, the bigger the expectations will grow.
messages.958:
That's why, despite the possibility of seeing Tsukishiro's
sad face, I wanted to leave no regrets behind.
messages.1181: Tsukishiro was giving the Roskill Lavender some water.
messages.1316:
Tsukishios spoke, with joy clear on that
usually-expressionless face.
messages.1465: At the crucial point, I hesitated.
messages.1514: Was this really the right thing to do?
messages.1555: There's no knowing whether it'd actually bloom after all.
messages.1592:
The very fact that this plant exists here, despite how
delicate it is, and how difficult it's supposed to grow...
messages.1664: It might just bud. A flower might just bloom.
messages.1781:
Finishing her watering, a lone waterdrop was hanging from a
leaf of the Roskill Lavender.
messages.1863:
It then dropped to the groound, exploding into a splatter of
smaller drops.
messages.2067: I didn't come here to convince her to give up.
messages.2123:
Nor did I come here to tell her to stop trying to grow that
plant.
messages.2172:
Her feelings of love for the plant was clear; it would be an
awesome situation if it actually bloomed.
messages.2283: Just... I just didn't want her to get too hopeful about it.
messages.2353:
"Someone I know, told me that that plant is a very difficult
one to grow."
messages.2413:
Tsukishiro's eyes kept gazing at me, her full attention on
me now.
messages.2456:
"It's called Roskill Lavender, and apparently only grows in
Scandinavian countries, or something?"
messages.2561:
Although a bout of dubiousness crept into her face, she
continued to display complete attentiveness.
messages.2637:
"That person said that, thanks to the climate of Japan,
Roskill Lavenders can't be grown here."
messages.2742:
Tsukishiro's eyes slowly turned to the plant, looking as
weak as ever.
messages.2833:
"It's not impossible for a plant like that to have grown
here, but it'd be more closer to a miracle than anything
else. And--"
messages.2942:
Her face grew more gloomy by the second. But I couldn't stop
now.
messages.3018:
"--A Roskill Lavender won't be able to bud in Japan's
climate."
messages.3104:
Her shoulders started to tremble. She bit her lower lip,
looking up at me.
messages.3186: "And if it can't bud flowers, it'd wilt."
messages.3301: Her voice was cracking as she whispered.
messages.3395:
"But look at it... it's never really looked healthy, always
on the verge of wilting..."
messages.3576:
Tears were forming in the corners of her eyes, and slowly
started rolling down her cheeks.
messages.3646:
She quietly removed her gloves, and stroked the doll once
more.
messages.3774: "...If we work hard, it'd bloom someday."
messages.3819:
Her entire body was shivering, as she held the doll tightly
to her chest.
messages.3879: "I didn't mean for you to give up."
messages.3928:
"I just wanted you to know the full extent of the
situation..."
messages.4020:
"...Even so, we'd continue putting our all into making it
grow."
messages.4076: "This Roskill Lavender will surely answer us."
messages.4155: "And when it blooms, our wish will come true."
messages.4198:
Being held by such a quivering body, the doll itself seemed
to remain calm.
messages.4290: "...Alice and I believe that a flower will bloom."
messages.4350:
Upon the doll saying that, Alice ran past me and behind, and
towards the school building.
messages.4426: A speed at which my voice wouldn't be able to reach her.
messages.4463: A speed at which I wouldn't be able to catch her.
messages.4500: "Maybe I shouldn't have said anything at all..."
messages.4570: Her sad reaction to my words, I was fully expecting it.
messages.4648: Yet, I still felt that I shouldn't have said it.
messages.4687:
Her sorrowful face when I told her about the Rosekill
Lavender...
messages.4751:
It was one I regretted ever making, and one I could never
forget.
messages.4937:
Not able to keep quiet about what Sakura told me, I repeated
to Alice that expecting the Rosekill Lavender to bloom in
Japan was unreasonable.
messages.5062:
But Tsukishiro, with tears falling from her eyes, exposed
her feelings to me, saying that it'd surely bloom, someday.
messages.5163: Then she ran off, before I could call out to her.
messages.5225:
I knew it was going to happen, but remembering her sorrowful
face made me regret ever doing it.

messages.251: I glanced at the clock. The hour hand just hit 11.
messages.296: "...One hour should be enough to get ready..."
messages.368: Any more rest would be for old balding men.
messages.462:
Kotori has a committee meeting today at school, so we're
meeting at the school gates.
messages.623: I picked up the note on the table.
messages.670:
"Brother, I've went out. There's some sweet buns in the
cupboard."
messages.754:
I boiled some water, prepared the coffee, and munched on
some sweet buns.
messages.816: "Yesterday, Nemu didn't talk to me at all..."
messages.865:
She had heard about what Kotori and I had done during the
Miss Kazami Academy Contest, so I was in for the cold
shoulder.
messages.986:
She wouldn't look me in the face, or answer any questions
beyond a single-syllable response.
messages.1118: I drank my coffee and started talking to myself.
messages.1408: "Nope! Like I said, right on time."
messages.1510: "Hm? Is something wrong? You look disappointed."
messages.1557:
"Well, no... how do you say it... I just didn't think I'd be
saying things like "Did I make you wait?"."
messages.1721: "I hardly think you can call me any good like that..."
messages.1825: Kotori gently placed her hand on my chest.
messages.2033: "I can't change my face so easily~"
messages.2198: "Just walking and shopping. It'd be great in this weather."
messages.2254: Kotori looked up at the dazzling blue sky as she talked.
messages.2326: And I stared at her dazzling smile instead...
messages.2461: "Huh... were those students glancing at me just now?"
messages.2543:
I suppose they're going for extra lessons. I quickly turned
my head back, and caught one of them. He quickly turned his
back.
messages.2679:
Sure enough, I'm getting curious looks. I could see it on
people's faces as I passed by them.
messages.2808:
"It can't be helped. We're essentially school celebrities
now..."
messages.2917:
Kissing on stage with an entire audience looking, it'd be
hard NOT to become famous from that.
messages.2997:
"At least it was right before springtime. Now all the new
students will come in, and that situation will slowly die
down."
messages.3121: "Dying down... that wouldn't be bad at all."
messages.3249:
The wind was perfect, the weather was good. It was a perfect
day for just walking around and enjoying nature.
messages.3321: The gentle wind scattered the sakura petals all around us.
messages.3381:
Kotori spread her arms out, as if trying to stop the sakura
petals around her, and begin speaking.
messages.3491:
"It's a little boring to have sakura that blooms all year
around..."
messages.3565:
I narrowed my eyes and looked at the scenery around me as I
queried her.
messages.3644:
"I mean, it's like there's no real special occasion to going
flower-viewing now."
messages.3720:
"Yeah, I guess. If you see something too much, you get sick
of seeing it."
messages.3846:
"Next time, do you want to go flower-viewing? Just the two
of us."
messages.3925: "I'd make a good lunch for us as well."
messages.3970: "That'd be great. A perfect start to spring break."
messages.4075:
It should be a normal occurence, yet why does it make my
heart flutter so?
messages.4137:
Now, I can't imagine not having met her, not having felt
this way...
messages.4280:
I glanced at Kotori, and noticed her cheeks were fushed with
red.
messages.4430:
She started looking at the ground, her index fingers playing
with each other.
messages.4633: "I've been waiting a long time for that..."
messages.4674:
Her cheeks were still redder than tomatoes, but I caught her
sneaking a nervous glance at me.
messages.4761:
Saying something like that and extending my arm took more
courage than I thought it would.
messages.4823:
Kotori smiled joyfully, and tightly held my hand. She seemed
so satisfied just from that...
messages.4988:
"Shopping, though... what do you want to buy? Or are you
just window shopping?"
messages.5083:
"Window shopping is good, but I do have something in mind
today."
messages.5166:
"I was thinking of looking for a wedding present for my
sister."
messages.5264:
"It's getting closer and closer, the 6th of May to be exact.
It's not really an auspicious day, though..."
messages.5391:
"She doesn't really care about things like that, I hope she
doesn't have to carry the burden of it after..."
messages.5516: "...What are you thinking? Your face looks weird."
messages.5629: I smiled as wide as I could.
messages.5872: She led me by the arm to a nearby window.
messages.5940: I was thinking about the dream I saw a few days ago.
messages.5979: That dream, was the person dreaming it really Kotori?
messages.6055:
If it's true, then Kotori has no blood-ties to the rest of
her family, and Koyomi-sensei...
messages.6142:
"Ahh... it's too expensive. My allowance isn't enough for
that..."
messages.6212:
Kotori, her face almost right up against the window, had an
unhappy expression. She truely wanted to do as much as she
could...
messages.6372:
Kotori looked up, still facing the glass. We stared at each
other's reflections.
messages.6568: "Whaat~? It's bad when you leave people hanging like that~"
messages.6640: Kotori admonished me with a smile, still through the glass.
messages.6699:
"Ahh, don't worry, it's nothing big. By the way, it wasn't
an arranged marriage or anything like that, right?"
messages.6833: "Ehm, not as far as I know."
messages.6884:
"Then it's a marriage out of love. That's a lot more like
Koyomi-sensei."
messages.7025:
"Yep, yep! That's why I said it was nothing. Don't worry
about it. Anyway, what's that?"
messages.7154:
I pointed at something being shown in the window. Kotori
shifted her gaze to that, and started murmuring the price to
herself.
messages.7255:
I really shouldn't say anything about the dream I saw.
Somehow, I feel like that's an invasion of privacy.
messages.7368:
I'd just wait for the time where Kotori decides to tell me
about her family problems herself.
messages.7448:
Unless she does that, It shouldn't be that big of a problem.
The possibility of that is strong, methinks.
messages.7528:
After all, look at the way she's so happily choosing a
present for her older sist--
messages.7617:
I suddenly felt conscious about myself, and I returned to
the real world to see Kotori back to staring at me through
the glass.
messages.7745:
I quickly turned to face her real self rather than her
reflection.
messages.7964: She was giggling. She seems so happy...
messages.7999: What I'm seeing now, the ever-cheerful Kotori.
messages.8074:
"Uu~... these items are too rich for my blood. Let's go
somewhere else!"
messages.8132:
She took my hand again, and started walking. This link
between us was real. But...
messages.8200: I still carried uneasy feelings with me.
messages.8249:

"(Come to think about it, the last time we talked on the

here specially to keep you company!"
messages.1150: "I brought all these banana cookies here too!"
messages.1242:
"Bananas are very nutritious, don't you know? It gives you
lots of stamina after you digest it, so you can keep running
without..."
messages.1373: "And look at how right I am."
messages.1483:
She stamped her feet into the ground with her arms crossed,
just like a kid.
messages.1558:
Moments after, she became docile again, just like a
spring-toy that needed to be wound up again.
messages.1727:
"Yeah. It seems she carried a huge wish for the plant behind
the gym..."
messages.1837: "So that's why, she worked so hard to make it grow...?"
messages.1874:
"Pretty much. That recent storm made it impossible though...
and that was the last seed she had."
messages.1992: "Meaning her wish will never be granted..."
messages.2060:
"That's about it. What kind of flower is that, really... a
rare flower that only can grant wishes, supposedly..."
messages.2248:
"Even if the flower blooms, there's no guarantee it'd grant
your wish... the disappointment from that would be immense."
messages.2368: "I haven't even thought about what I'd wish for."
messages.2438:
"Your wish would be something like "I want 1 million
bananas!", right?"
messages.2548:
"You understand well! Hmm, 1 million might be a bit too much
even for me, though. I'd settle for ten thousand!"
messages.2661:
"Same difference. You can make that kind of wish come true
by working your butt off and spending your earnings on it,
anyway."
messages.2781:
"...That'd take around 400,000 yen. Not so attainable for me
right now..."
messages.2847:
Miharu sighed with despair, seeing her dreams of bananas
fade away.
messages.2895:
Right now, it's an unattainable dream, but in the future,
that cost may well be possible to fund.
messages.2973: ...Although spending 400,000 yen on bananas is crazy.
messages.3031:
"She should tell us what she wished for... maybe we could
make it come true?"
messages.3162: "You don't think it'd be way too much for us to fulfill?"
messages.3218:
"You mean, like, taking over the world, or flying through
the air, or producing wagashis from your hand when you
want?"
messages.3349:
"...You think Tsukishiro would grow that plant so
wholeheartedly, to wish for such silly things like that?"
messages.3513:
"Although I'd be really happy if I could make a banana
appear in my hand whenever I want."
messages.3587: "...It's not as good as it sounds."
messages.3710: I cleared my throat. Hope she didn't notice...
messages.3830:
"We won't be able to get closer to Tsukishiro-san at this
rate, huh..."
messages.3908:
"That's not true... I'm sure she wants to become closer to
us as well."
messages.4030:
"Why are you being so feeble now? What happened to that
overbearing energeticness?"
messages.4131: "Even I get a little depressed sometimes..."
messages.4197: "...Saying it yourself, you'd get no help from me."
messages.4255: Miharu giggled at my straight reply.
messages.4300:
"All we need, is a little chance to break through her
shell."
messages.4390: "And help heal the deep, deep wound in her heart?"
messages.4431:
"No matter how deep it is, it can always be healed. It might
just take time."
messages.4531: "I guess so. Someday, we'd all be good friends for sure."
messages.4646: I threw another of the banana cookies into my mouth.
messages.4749:
"Okay then! Let's go to Tsukishiro-san's place! I'm sure
she's bored, during this spring vacation!"
messages.4894:
"Why not? It's not even 2 PM yet. It's not an odd time to
visit, and I don't think we'd be bothers there."
messages.5001:
With a clenched fist and a war cry, Miharu leapt up from the
sofa.
messages.5155:
"Too bad, your "troublesome" doesn't have any effect on me.
I saw it way in advance, after all!"
messages.5272:
Sighing, I grabbed Miharu's hand, and dragged her out and
towards Tsukishiro's place.
messages.5435:
"Ah, this would be Asakura-sama and Amakase-sama. Welcome.
--Oh, where might Suginami-sama be?"
messages.5651: Miharu laughed embarassedly at my sarcasm.
messages.5739: Seiba-san left his seat, and came back shortly.
messages.5793:
He opened the envelope, and read the contents, nodding and
making "hmm" sounds.
messages.5865:
"Is something wrong? That letter seems to be,
interesting..."
messages.5953:
"Ah, I was just pondering the coincidental timing of it
all."
messages.6024:
Seiba-san handed us several photos that came with the
envelope.
messages.6099:
"It seems Suginami-sama has been travelling indeed. I am
quite envious of him."
messages.6197:
The picture was of Suginami standing in a main street in
England, eating fish and chips.
messages.6296: "Where did he go at this time..."
messages.6335:
That irritating grin raked within me, as I glared at his
picture.
messages.6427: "He will return to Hatsunejima tomorrow, it appears."
messages.6572:
That statement was as true as could be. It's useless to
think about it, so that'd be the end of that.
messages.6753:
"Unfortunately, the mistress has went shopping today. I
believe she intends to purchase more records."
messages.7001:
"I will inform the mistress that the both of you came to
visit her... please come back any time you wish."
messages.7223: "I guess I should be heading back too."
messages.7325:
"Your house is kinda far away from here, and I'd only be
more trouble, so..."
messages.7520:
"Actually, I'm going out to eat for dinner tonight, so I
need to head back early to prepare."
messages.7636:
"Do you want to come too, senpai? I think my parents
wouldn't mind; they'd welcome you, in fact!"
messages.7820: "That "troublesome" had a serious "troublesome" feel to it."
messages.7977:
"See you later, senpai! I'd come visit you soemtime next
week, too!"
messages.8055:
Miharu gave me a quick bow, then ran off in the opposite
direction.
messages.8150:
"Pah, and I thought spring break was for spending time with
friends."
messages.8201:
Let's see... Tsukishiro isn't around, Miharu went home,
Suginami is in England (or so he claims)... that leaves no
one.
messages.8376:
That's the release date for all the newest manga issues. I
better hurry up and check it out.
messages.8444:
Making sure I had something in my wallet, I entered the
bookshop in the shopping district.
messages.8559:
All the popular mangas were stacked up in a mountain of
books, and surrounded by people.
messages.8637:
I grabbed one from near the base of the "mountain". At this
rate, they'd all be gone within a few hours.
messages.8727:
With the bought manga snugly under my arm, I continued
wandering around the shopping district.
messages.8781:
If I walk around here long enough, maybe I'd bump into
someone I know, and we could do something less boring.
messages.8888:
--And right on cue, Tsukishiro was sitting on a bench I was
talking towards.
messages.9056:
"Ah, I heard it from Seiba-san. Miharu and I went over in
the afternoon to visit, and heard that you were out
shopping."
messages.9220:
"Shall we head home together? You are done with your
shopping, right?"
messages.9278:
Beside Tsukishiro was a paper bag, with what looked like a
record sitting inside.
messages.9393: Tsukishiro shook her head from side to side.
messages.9520: Tsukishiro's eyes wandered over to her foot.
messages.9654: Tsukishiro looked back up at my face, and nodded.
messages.9701: "How much does it hurt? You can't walk by yourself?"
messages.9812:
She swung her leg back and forth a bit, with her face
constantly grimacing in pain.
messages.9899: I removed her shoes, and slowly peeled off her socks.
messages.9957: That smooth, white ankle was swollen, slightly red.
messages.10002:
"If you don't move it around too much, it should heal fully
by tomorrow or so."
messages.10088:
"I'm going to that convenience store to buy a compress. Wait
a bit, okay?"
messages.10199:
I entered the convenience store just across the street, and
quickly bought a compress and some bandages."
messages.10316: I placed the compress on her ankle.
messages.10411: "You have to keep it cool to keep the swelling down."
messages.10487:
"It'd be best if I carry you on my back, home... do you mind
that?"
messages.10557: She shook her head back and forth, no.
messages.10655:
"It's okay, there's no way I could've left you here like
this anyway."
messages.10725:
I threw Tsukishiro's sock and shoe, and the manga I bought,
into the convenience store bag. I then squatted in front of
her.
messages.10875: With a nod, she slowly climbed on top of my body.
messages.10931: I stood up, feeling her delicate body on my back.
messages.11060:
Tiny arms were lightly hitting my back. I quickly let my
arms drop to the side; the arms that were formerly holding
her behind.
messages.11184:
"A, ahh... I didn't... mean to touch your behind... not
there..."
messages.11262: Hearing her quiet yelps made me extremely embarassed.
messages.11324:
Stumbling back and forth with my words, a soft voice lilted
into my ears.
messages.11438: Her mouth was at the tip of my ear, whispering.
messages.11527: "Y, yeah... it was. Let's just head back."
messages.11587:
I took the path through the park, unusable by vehicles, to
go home.
messages.11751: "What kind of record did you buy?"
messages.11826:
"Ahhh, I don't know him either. All those orchestra music
are foreign to me."
messages.12056:
"Well, don't worry about it. I'm glad enough to see you
doing better... besides your leg, anyway."
messages.12166:
She really is weak at talking in the end; her words were
always preceded by a moment of hesistation.
messages.12268: She'd probably be more comfortable in a quiet environment...
messages.12317: I decided to stop blabbering, and quietly continued walking.
messages.12411: We emerged from the park, and into Sakura Avenue.
messages.12442:
Having walked down this path so many times on the way to
school, it felt familiar somehow.
messages.12508: A voice then called out to me.
messages.12537: I couldn't tell what it was saying.
messages.12572:
More than actually being able to hear it, I could feel it
flowing through me.
messages.12708: What is the thing flowing through my body so rapidly?
messages.12879: My eyes were suddenly enveloped in a sea of black.
messages.12912:
I couldn't see a thing, but I could feel something deep
within the darkness.
messages.12966: It was the voice I heard from before.
messages.13041: "No, no! What I wanted wasn't this dumb doll!"
messages.13112: "I want to have friends! To make friends!"
messages.13164: "I hate you, hate you! I hate father, I hate mother!"
messages.13228: "I hate the circus! I hate everyone!"
messages.13282:
"Piros can't say anything, he can't talk to me about
anything!"
messages.13355:
"I want mother and father to play with me, to read books to
me! I don't want them to go to the circus!"
messages.13460: "They don't play with me... mother and father should die!!"
messages.13530: The voice of a tiny girl.
messages.13555: A voice that sounded like it's been crying for a long time.
messages.13650:
I suddenly recovered consciousness, and found myself still
walking on the usual Sakura Avenue to school.
messages.13731:
Tsukishiro was sleeping, her rhythmic breathing almost
hypnotic.
messages.13785: That must've been Tsukishiro's voice just now...
messages.13851: Seiba-san's words came flooding back into my head.
messages.13960:
"A doll, which could not even speak, was not enough to heal
the mistress's heart."
messages.14043:
"The mistress, in the end, became filled with anger at her
parents, and threw a temper tantrum at them."
messages.14109: In the end, the circus was never meant for her...
messages.14163:
"Kyouji-sama and Sophie-sama were distracted by the
mistress's harshness, and during a performance, met with a
terrible accident. They did not survive."
messages.14247: Tsukishiro then thought that it was her fault...
messages.14305:
"Since then, the mistress would no longer let her true
feelings be known to others."
messages.14420:
Killing her parents, with her own words. That was what she
thought she had done.
messages.14505:
"Perhaps whenever the mistress opens her mouth, the memories
of that incident flood back."
messages.14592:
"The mistress appears to be deathly afraid of ever hurting
anyone else with her own words again."
messages.14751:
No matter what she could say to us, Miharu and I wouldn't
take it badly at all...
messages.14813:
Tsukishiro's parents couldn't have wanted her to become this
way.
messages.14869:
It's not definite that it's Tsukishiro's fault that they met
with the accident, after all.
messages.14947:
But I'm sure they wouldn't have wanted to die, and leave
their only daughter so distressed, either.
messages.15085:
Her real parents are no longer with us as well. Yet now,
she's living her life, and working hard to make her dreams
come true.
messages.15177:
She said after all, that she still had me and my parents,
which left me a little embarassed.
messages.15255: I want Tsukishiro to notice that too.
messages.15292: That Miharu, Suginami... and I, are all here.
messages.15331:
We're always worrying about her, wanting to get closer to
her.
messages.15434: But, she just couldn't get the words out of her mouth.
messages.15475:
So perhaps, that's why she got a doll to communicate to
others for her.
messages.15560: I wanted to tell her all the feelings I had just now.
messages.15652:
But all I got in reply, was the steady breathing of the
sleeping Tsukishiro.
messages.15865: Apparently, Miharu was very worried about Tsukishiro.
messages.15923:
To Miharu, so desperate to become Tsukishiro's friend,
hearing that she was still depressed must've been painful
for her.
messages.16020:
We went to Tsukishiro's house to try and get closer to her,
but unfortunately, she went out, and we couldn't see her.
messages.16141:
Having done the best we can, Miharu and I seperated. I ended
up going to the shopping district.
messages.16209:
There, I met Tsukishiro, who was heading back from her
shopping. She apparently injured her leg.
messages.16289: I carried her on my back, all the way home.
messages.16330:
On the way, the sleeping Tsukishiro's memories of the past,
and feelings of loneliness, coarsed through my body.
messages.16445:
Tsukishiro, you're not alone. Miharu, myself, and even
Suginami are all ehre.
messages.16515: I whispered that to the sleeping Tsukishiro, on my back.

messages.181: ...That Suginami. Where the hell has he been?
messages.239: I received another souvenir from him yesterday...
messages.325: A giant "Welcome!" in Japanese was written on it.
messages.393: The Eiffel Tower is supposed to be in France...
messages.438:
Well, I suppose it doesn't matter to me where on earth that
idiot is.
messages.516:
He once told me with a straight face that "Last week, I
visited some relatives on Mars", and I replied "How was
it?".
messages.654: The cellphone in my pocket suddenly started vibrating.
messages.734: Pressing a few buttons on the cellphone, I opened the mail.
messages.779:
"Hm, hm... "I in fact have one more souvenir to give you.
You'd be delighted with it. So come to the park right
now"...eh?"
messages.884:
Like hell. I'm not going to go out in the middle of the
night to receive some souvenir of England with "Made In
Asia" on it.
messages.986:
Just as I was about to close the mail folder, another one
arrived.
messages.1050:
"Now what? "P.S: If you don't come, you'd regret it for the
rest of your life"... oh really?"
messages.1118:
That's ridiculous... using such grandoise words almost made
my heart stop.
messages.1231: I stood up, and returned the cellphone to my pocket.
messages.1280:
Looks like I'm going to just go along with his expectations
again...
messages.1414: "I'd walk slowly, it'd be better if I'm late."
messages.1457: Talking to myself in bitternress, I headed out of the house.
messages.1543: Another souvenir? What does he want with me about it.
messages.1601:
If I don't come, I'd regret it for the rest of my life?
That's old hat.
messages.1692: Calling me out specially, at this time of the night.
messages.1737: He may be an idiot, but he's not dumb.
messages.1782:
Pulling myself together, I headed out into the curtain of
darkness, preparing to meet Suginami.
messages.1999:
For some reason, Suginami called me out in the middle of the
night.
messages.2038:
I had a bad feeling with whatever he wanted me for, but I
headed out as per his expectations anyway.
messages.2165: What on earth is that guy thinking...

messages.259: I gazed at the white clouds above.
messages.309:
I was lying on a bed, watching the pure white clouds roll
by.
messages.358: Suginami's face then popped into my view.
messages.424: "Don't worry. Leave the rest to me."
messages.465: A serious face, very unlike him.
messages.517: "You just stay here and be a good boy... understand?"
messages.644:
"I'll head for Tsukishiro-jou's location now, then... it's
time for her to find out."
messages.747: I couldn't move from my bed.
messages.787: Suginami's figure quickly disappeared from my vision.
messages.836: Miharu will probably cover for me now...
messages.1111: "This is as serious as it gets, after all..."
messages.1148:
From now on, in Asakura-senpai's place, Miharu will cover
the following of Suginami.
messages.1222:
Suginami-senpai was running past junctions and streets, and
I did my best to follow him.
messages.1298: Shortly after, Tsukishiro's home came into view.
messages.1371:
"Hah, hahh... Suginami-senpai, wouldn't a taxi be faster? To
get to Tsukishiro-san's place..."
messages.1493:
"True. Considering the circumstances, we must do everything
we can to extend what little time we have."
messages.1563:
As he spoke, he slowed down his speed, and hailed a nearby
taxi.
messages.1656: "Hah, hahh... Suginami-senpai, you run really fast..."
messages.1714: "I cannot wait for any puppy. Every second is vital."
messages.1794:
Despite running all the way from the hospital to here,
Suginami-senpai didn't seem to even sweat one drop.
messages.1900:
We implored the taxi driver to go faster, and the taxi
increased it's speed bit by bit.
messages.1986:
But Suginami-senpai still seemed nervous and fidgety,
tapping his finger on his knee irratatedly.
messages.2064:
It can't be helped... it's such a serious amtter involving
his best friend.
messages.2122: When I heard it myself, I was so shocked as well...
messages.2182:
I wanted to go straight to the hospital, but Suginami-senpai
said that Tsukishiro still hadn't heard, and rushed towards
her home.
messages.2305:
The taxi was moving even faster than the speed limit here,
yet my heart was still pleading it to go faster and faster.
messages.2523: "I know. You better not slow me down."
messages.2687: "W, what in the name of...!? What did you just say!?"
messages.2812: "Call Tsukishiro-jou as fast as possible, Sebastian."
messages.2933:
Seiba-san hurried up the stairs, and called for
Tsukishiro-san.
messages.3059: Tsukishiro-san looked at us with a confused face.
messages.3144: "Tsukishiro-jou, listen to me calmly and carefully..."
messages.3229: "Asakura met with an accident... a traffic accident."
messages.3306: Tsukishiro-san inhaled suddenly, and leaned forward.
messages.3371:
"He's in the hospital right now. I thought you may not have
known, so we came here as fast as we could."
messages.3504:
I heard Tsukishiro swallow deeply, as she digested what
Suginami said.
messages.3593: "Tsukishiro-san, let's go, to where Asakura-senpai is..."
messages.3715:
At that moment, Tsukishiro-san jumped up and dashed towards
the entranceway.
messages.3871:
Even the ever-calm Seiba-san's face had hardened with shock,
as he questioned Suginami-senpai.
messages.3949:
Suginami-senpai, simply, slowly and wordlessly, nodded to
him.
messages.4129: "Alright. Please take care of the mistress."
messages.4272: "Puppy, we're going to chase after Tsukishiro-jou."
messages.4374: We hurried out of the mansion, and looked for the taxi.
messages.4465: "Dear puppy... did you tell the taxi to wait for us?"
messages.4609: "Ugh, what's done is done... Tsukishiro-jou, can you run?"
messages.4678:
Tsukishiro-san, with a quick nod, ran off in the direction
of the hospital.
messages.4801: "It's the Mizukoshi Hospital! Do you know where it is?"
messages.4840: Without slowing her pace, Tsukishiro-san nodded in reply.
messages.4881:
Her speed was so amazing, that it was leaving even
Suginami-senpai in the dust.
messages.5001:
I guess the stamina power of bananas has reached it's
limit...
messages.5072:
"There's a bicycle at Asakura's house! The key's in the
mailbox!"
messages.5178:
Just as Suginami-senpai said, there was a bicycle at
Asakura's house. I borrowed it for a short while, and headed
onwards.
messages.5297:
"I'd be fine, just watch for Tsukshiro-jou.... ugh... looks
like I'd be there late..."
messages.5384:
Tsukishiro-san's pace was blazingly quick, but with me
pedaling with all I had, I managed to catch up to her.
messages.5479:
The training she received at the circus when she was a child
really hasn't gone to waste.
messages.5561:
I wanted to reach where senpai was faster as well, but my
feet couldn't pedal any faster than they were now...
messages.5678:
"Haah, haah, haah, Tsukishiro-san... do you... want to get
on...?"
messages.5781:
Then, tilting her body slightly forward, somehow moved up a
gear and accelerated.
messages.5959:
Tsukishiro-san constantly repeated Asakura-senpai's name in
between her quick breaths.
messages.6025:
She's really worried... just looking at her pained face,
made my chest tighten up as well.
messages.6252:
Moving as quickly as we humanly could, we reached the
hospital.
messages.6325:
"Excuse me... may I know which ward Asakura-san is staying
in...?"
messages.6562:
With Suginami-senpai's guidance, we entered Asakura-senpai's
hospital room.
messages.6702:
Asakura-senpai appeared to be unconscious, lying in bed in a
private room.
messages.6802:
The realization that he was in accident was beginning to
sink in.
messages.6942:
Tsukishiro-san pushed me out of the way from behind, and
rushed over to Asakura-senpai's side.
messages.7127: "O, oy, Tsukishiro-jou... don't shake him like that!"
messages.7263:
Tsukishiro-san's voice was unusually strong, filled with
emotion.
messages.7386: "...Don't die, I, I.. I don't want you to die!"
messages.7478:
She spoke strongly, firing off what she wanted to say and
not holding back.
messages.7535:
Tsukishiro-san was finally speaking, with all her heart, her
own feelings.
messages.7661:
"...I... Senpai, I... I love you! I want you by my side
forever, never going away!"
messages.8105:
"Hold it! I said we'd help to heal a person's heart
problems, but I don't remember promising to help romantic
pursuits!"
messages.8377: "I've seen enough... I can't take much more of this."
messages.8454:
"Why am I, of all people, helping with Asakura's love
affairs..."
messages.8641: "Oh boy... now this is what I call awkward."
messages.8680:
Still lying under the sheets, I lifted my body into a
seating position.
messages.8764:
"Well, we fulfilled the objective anyway, so I suppose it's
alright."
messages.8857: "...Um, may I know what is going on?"
messages.9089:
"The plan would've had a much higher chance of failure, if
the dear puppy knew the truth."
messages.9236:
"Suginami talked to me yesterday. "I know a lowerclassman
with a heart problem. I want to try and save her."... was
what he said."
messages.9373:
"So, I talked with my father about it, and managed to get
him to loan one empty room. I promised it to Suginami last
evening."
messages.9548:
"Sorry, Tsukishiro. It's as she says. I didn't get caught in
any accident. I'm still as healthy as ever."
messages.9634: The operation is over, it seems.
messages.9661:
"It was Suginami's plan. He thought that you wouldn't just
be able to start communicating your own feelings by
yourself."
messages.9774:
"What was needed, was a bigger push, shock treatment... you
could say."
messages.9873:
"W, w, w, wait a minute here! So Suginami and Asakura-senpai
were lying to all of us!?"
messages.10037:
"T, this isn't a joking matter! We were so worried about
you! Right, Tsukishiro-san!?"
messages.10246:
"This is horrible! Completely uncalled for! Terrible!
Atrocious!"
messages.10544:
"...I'm glad Senpai's fine... that Asakura-senpai's still
here..."
messages.10641: Tears were rapidly dropping from Tsukishiro's eyes.
messages.10697: I broughy my hand up, wiping them from her soft face.
messages.10792: "I'm sorry, Tsukishiro. I didn't mean to trick you..."
messages.10897:
"And, thank you, Tsukishiro... I'm happy to hear your true
feelings."
messages.11006:
"Ha ha ha, Tsukishiro-jou! Do you not realize that you just
spoke your feelings through your own mouth?"
messages.11201:
"Isn't it a good feeling, to say what you truly feel
yourself, to the one you love?"
messages.11356:
Her tears had stopped. Replacing them, on her face, was a
beautiful smile.
messages.11480:
"H, hold on! It's fine with Tsukishiro-san, but what about
me? Why did you deceive me? Why did you get me involved?"
messages.11634:
"Well, to trick your enemies, you must first trick your
allies, you could say..."
messages.11705:
"But, but... grrr, I cannot accept this! I demand
compensation, in the form of 1 million bananas!"
messages.11825: "...My dear puppy. What is today's date?"
messages.11900:
"March... ah, it's April today... ermm, April 1st....
ahhhh!"
