messages.793:
Having my first kiss stolen by a guy... yet ending up
falling in love with him...
messages.873: That's such a laughable thing to happen.
messages.965: That's why I can't let anyone know.
messages.1076: The last bell rang throughout the school.
messages.1107:
Just thinking about things like that made an entire school
day pass by.
messages.1206:
I needed a change of pace. I decided to walk through the
Sakura Park back home.
messages.1361:
The wind scattered the sakura petals. The sakura petals that
would not die...
messages.1421:
I leaned against one of the many trees, and gazed at the
dancing, fluttering sakura petals.
messages.1495: "...He said he liked sakura trees in leaf."
messages.1536: But this island hasn't ever seen them.
messages.1577: I felt a twinge of regret inside me.
messages.1635:
When I noticed it, I couldn't help but smile bitterly to
myself.
messages.1680: Even now, I was still thinking of him.
messages.1828: I waved to her when I saw her.
messages.1947: I'm not just doing that though...
messages.2020: "Asakura-kun... you've been in deep thought a lot lately."
messages.2063: She looked at me, her worry evident.
messages.2108: "You realized? I've been having the new-school-year blues."
messages.2147:
I spread my arms wide in gesture, as if that explained
everything.
messages.2220: But the suspicious look she gave me,
messages.2267: made me droop my shoulders in defeat.
messages.2341: I asked her, muttering my words.
messages.2425: A firm nod. Her eyes were indeed serious.
messages.2574: I made a decision, and prepared myself to explain.
messages.2609:
"The truth is... well... I think I've sort of fallen in
love."
messages.2705: "Sort of... why? You're not sure about it?"
messages.2765:
Kotori looked at me curiously. I didn't know how to explain
it either.
messages.2849: "..."Sort of" is the simplest way to put it."
messages.2890: I took glances all around me.
messages.2921: How am I supposed to say this... I hung my head in shame.
messages.2985:
"It's like... because the other person involved, it isn't
normal..."
messages.3065: "So it couldn't be real love, or so I thought."
messages.3125: "But... lately, I... think I've really fallen in love..."
messages.3199:
As I continued to speak, I felt like the load on my
shoulders was slowly being taken away.
messages.3271: Yeah, this is an anonymous confession.
messages.3316: Kotori doesn't know who the person I really like is,
messages.3374:
So since i'm a coward, I'd just make sure to leave out that
detail.
messages.3531: Somehow, she came to that conclusion as if it wasa nothing.
messages.3665:
Don't tell me I was the only one who thought that no one
noticed...
messages.3760: After a couple of deep breaths, I resignedly nodded.
messages.3887:
Kotori took a long hard look at me-- then whatever she was
thinking of made her laugh slightly.
messages.4087: Her laughter felt like she was belittling all my troubles.
messages.4211: When people confess of sorts, and you react like that...
messages.4325: Kotori apologized, although she continued to giggle.
messages.4437:
I was just barely able to hear what Kotori said in a
whisper.
messages.4526: Questioning what I had heard, she quickly shook her head.
messages.4657: And the giggling continued once more.
messages.4810:
"There's no need for you to try and deceive yourself about
your feelings. If you like Kudou-kun, you should accept it,
right?"
messages.4939: I couldn't accept that those feelings existed.
messages.5007: Because they shouldn't exist in the first place.
messages.5158: "Ahaha... but really. You should be honest, and quickly."
messages.5218:
"But there's no point in accepting it if I'm unwilling to do
so..."
messages.5269:
Why are you so confident about that, Kotori? All I could do
was meekly object.
messages.5400:
She hit the strike zone perfectly, poking my in the nose
with her finger.
messages.5509: At her calm, yet direct words, I obediently nodded.
messages.5552:
"But, if I'm honest with my feelings, you don't think Kudou
would take it badly?"
messages.5671:
That's normal to think after all. If I thought Suginami had
the hots for me...
messages.5759:
...I felt cold shivers running down my spine just from
thinking about that.
messages.5806: "And he's said before that there's a girl he likes..."
messages.5884:
I took a peek at Kotori's reaction as I said my piece in a
small voice.
messages.5942: Kotori and Kudou really look like they go well together.
messages.5994:
They're the kind of pretty-boy-pretty-girl couple that
everyone would be jealous of.
messages.6039:
And in recent days, since I've been basically spying on
Kudou, I've noticed that the two of them are really close.
messages.6121: Maybe, Kotori actually likes Kudou as well...
messages.6175: That thought sneakily invaded my mind.
messages.6258: "Don't worry about that. It'd be fine, fine!"
messages.6301:
She easily brushed off my words, shaking her head and
smiling happily.
messages.6385: "...How can you declare that so easily?"
messages.6499:
With all "that's all I have to say~" smile, Kotori started
to walk into the storm of sakura petals.
messages.6801: Sheesh, Kotori, that's asking a lot.
messages.6838: If it was that easy, I wouldn't be this troubled.
messages.7083:
In the end, I did nothing throughout class except think
about Kudou.
messages.7174:
On the way home, I bumped into Kotori. I confided in her,
and she told me to "Be honest with myself", but something so
simple doesn't help.

messages.229: It was the first day of Golden Week.
messages.258:
Although since it was a Sunday, there was no noticable
difference.
messages.336: I had nothing to do whatsoever.
messages.363: Tamaki was busy at the Miko Club today.
messages.444: There hadn't been any chance to go on a date.
messages.481:
Well, I'd just tolerate this a while longer, and go to the
Miko Club training camp.
messages.526: We should be able to spend time together there.
messages.740:
Sakura came crawling in from the window, with Utamaru
sitting proudly on her head.
messages.861: "You're as fond of tresspassing as ever, huh."
messages.908: "The entranceway is meant for entering, ya know."
messages.1172:
"...Where've you been brought up, to learn that kind of
dialect?"
messages.1274: "Heheh, my bro's being hella angry, huh?"
messages.1360:
"Hows bout we go ridin' dirty outside to forget ya troubles,
dawg?"
messages.1418: Her inane chatter was best left ignored.
messages.1457: At least it can't get boring now.
messages.1532: "Now then! You look like you've just had a date rejected."
messages.1611: I can't let her know she's right on the mark.
messages.1723: Sakura giggled a little, returning back to her usual voice.
messages.1838: "What were you doing at school, anyway?"
messages.1973: Can't be anything important, I bet.
messages.2014: "Ahhh~. It must be nice to be so carefree like you."
messages.2083: "Ehh? I'm always worried about something or other."
messages.2255:
"Yup! Like what kind of cat food to buy today, or how
tomorrow's weather will be!"
messages.2373: Maybe I'm the idiot after all.
messages.2400:
It'd be totally unlike her to be worried about something
from the bottom of her heart.
messages.2542: I was too irritated to answer.
messages.2611:
"C'mon, cheer up! Actually... do you want me to console
you?"
messages.2673: In a split second, Sakura's eyes lighted up.
messages.2866: Sakura suddenly grabbed me at my waist and started tickling.
messages.2967:
I could barely control my laughter. Tears were starting to
flow from my eyes.
messages.3075: Sakura happily continued her tickle torture.
messages.3173: I tried to resist as much as possible.
messages.3213: "If you want me to stop, then go on a date with me!"
messages.3287: I managed to yell out in between fits of laughter.
messages.3327: "Oh really? Shall I keep going then?"
messages.3368: She increased the speed of her tickling.
messages.3448: I finally succumbed to Sakura's mission.
messages.3508: "Right! Let's go to the Sakura Park!"
messages.3551: Sakura finally released her hands from my hips.
messages.3640: Sakura and I left my home, and set off for the Sakura Park.
messages.3817: Sakura stretched her arms out to greet the sunlgiht.
messages.3848: It really is good weather, though.
messages.3873: A light, calming breeze blew by every few minutes too.
messages.3942:
She inclined her neck towards the direction of the wind,
letting it brush past her face.
messages.4019:
"Of course, if it was Tamaki-chan next to you instead of me,
you'd be happier."
messages.4101: She giggled as she teased me.
messages.4163: Although that may be exaggerating a bit as well...
messages.4194: But this weather really makes it a fine day.
messages.4227: I kind of feel like thanking Sakura for getting me out here.
messages.4308: "Hey hey, can we go to the Unwithering Sakura place?"
messages.4380: The place where Sakura and I promised to meet again.
messages.4470:
Sakura tugged on my arm, leading me to the location of the
Unwithering Sakura.
messages.4651: "It's been so long since we both came here."
messages.4698:
She stared at the trunk of the Unwithering Sakura tree as
she whispered.
messages.4813:
"It's been said that wishes made while under this tree can
come true."
messages.5005: To see Sakura, so solemn and serious.
messages.5080: Sakura suddenly hugged the tree tightly.
messages.5164: She then whispered in a tiny voice.
messages.5199: One that was barely audible, yet I could hear part of it.
messages.5236: "We'd have to part soon"... she said...
messages.5327: Confused, I called out to her.
messages.5370: But she continued hugging the tree, not replying to me.
messages.5501:
Sakura finally let go of the tree, and her usual bright and
cheerful voice returned.
messages.5557: Were my ears playing tricks on me?
messages.5578: It wasn't just my imagination that she said that, right?
messages.5659:
But in the end, the words that came out of my mouth were no
different from usual.
messages.5743: "Hmhm? Onii-chan, did you suddenly grow feelings for me?"
messages.5887: "You're still so cute when you're embarassed~"
messages.5934: She started to lean on my arm again.
messages.6036:
"Now now, don't you worry, I'd keep it a secret from
Tamaki-chan!"
messages.6119: With Sakura still glued to my arm, I trudged back home.
messages.6336:
With the training camp looming, the days without spending
time with Tamaki continued.
messages.6383:
I was at home, bored, when Sakura invaded my personal space
yet again.
messages.6445:
She coerced a date out of me through tickle-torture, and we
went to the Sakura Park.
messages.6515:
We went to the Unwithering Sakura tree, where Sakura
suddenly got solemn.
messages.6564:
I'm sure I heard her whisper to the tree that "We have to
part soon"....

messages.187: Be honest with your feelings, she said.
messages.239: And Kotori reminded me of it earlier today, winking at me.
messages.361: I stared at the sky through the window.
messages.464: I sighed, practically out of habit.
messages.491: Even if you say that, until I accept it myself...
messages.563: "...Ahh, the sky is so blue today..."
messages.681: Round and round and round and round...
messages.722:
Hiding away alone during lunch, I paced around the
courtyard.
messages.812:
The students passing by stared at me as if I was some zoo
animal on display.
messages.915: Tired of walking, I sat down on one of the benches.
messages.954:
If I go back to class now, I might bump into Kudou or
Kotori.
messages.1003: Not something I had the guts to do.
messages.1061: I let out another of my inumerable sighs.
messages.1102:
If I could just stay here the whole day, and avoid contact
with them...
messages.1207:
...If I don't start heading back now, I'd be late for
afternoon classes.
messages.1267: Left with no choice, I slowly starte walking back.
messages.1347: I wonder what Kudou would think if I confessed.
messages.1403: Most probably, he won't react very well.
messages.1467:
He might even think I'd be getting back at him for his fake
confession the time before.
messages.1618:
If I don't put it well, I may regret it for the rest of my
life.
messages.1750:
There'd be no way we'd be able to go back to just being
friends if I confess as well.
messages.1892:
And if that starts becoming gossip, about where Kudou and I
stand...
messages.1915: Oh boy oh boy oh boy......
messages.2024:
As my brain filled with useless little thoughts, my ear
detected a tremor coming from the ground.
messages.2088: The rumbling started to get closer and louder, quickly.
messages.2213:
"Hahaha! You think that can hold me down, my dear puppy!?
Laughable!"
messages.2293:
"In the name of Nemu-senpai and the God of bananas, I'd
definitely catch you!"
messages.2488:
Caught in the middle of the dispute between the Suginami and
Amakase factions, I was thrown to the floor in the frenzy.
messages.2529:
Suginami was probably trying to ferret out information from
the discplinary committee again.
messages.2560:
In a way, he enjoys the inevitable chase after. A pretty
ominous sign for the future...
messages.2599: I started to get up, supporting myself with my hand.
messages.2665: As I tried to, I felt a dull pain in my fingertip.
messages.2733: I thought I felt something strange when I fell down...
messages.2772: "Owww... I must've jammed it into the floor."
messages.2834: Whenever I tried to move it, the same dull pain took over.
messages.2885: I kept it still, and headed for the infirmary.
messages.3035: As I went, the end-of-recess bell rang.
messages.3101: Oh well. I have an excuse at least, thanks to my finger.
messages.3169:
...And I'd take any chance I can get to avoid Kudou for as
long as I can.
messages.3249:
As I came to the front of the infirmary, I decided against
knocking to avoid more pain on my finger.
messages.3369:
In any case, at this time, there won't be any students
inside anyway.
messages.3513: I called out as I stepped inside.
messages.3695:
My eyes were met with Yuki-sensei holding a stethoscope to
the chest of what looked like a female student...
messages.3826:
An apology flew out of my mouth isntantly, as something with
me started to swell.
messages.4049: ...Indeed... that was my classmate, Kudou Kanae.
messages.4151:
Yuki-sensei quickly stood in front of Kudou, covering her
from my sight.
messages.4262:
"Leave it under cold water for awhile, then apply this and
don't move it."
messages.4471: With such a heated atmosphere, I quickly left the infirmary.
messages.4492: Then I leaned my back against the door.
messages.4618:
I unreasonably tried to get my brain to fully comprehend the
scene I just saw.
messages.4659:
Hypothesis number 1. It was another person, with a striking
resemblance.
messages.4674:
Hypothesis number 2. A curse was placed on Kudou which
caused the expansion of the chest, and required immediate
consultation.
messages.4746: Hypothesis number 3. A conspiracy involving space aliens.
messages.4889:
Something like this doesn't work when there's only one
person to play the boke and tsukkomi roles.
messages.4925:
There's the most obvious answer for it, albeit the one that
my mind's finding hard to understand.
messages.5030:
--Namely, looking like a guy, but actually a girl... for
some reason, disgusing herself as a guy.
messages.5114: There's probably an explanation for that.
messages.5225:
But both ways, forgetting about alien conspiracies, that's
the most likely reason.
messages.5254:
And so often, I thought his face looked female. Apparently
it was...
messages.5361:
I could put away all the circusmtances first-- as I thought
about it, I started smiling to myself.
messages.5447:
Yes, now that I know Kudou's a girl, there's no need for me
to keep these feelings to myself.
messages.5527: I can accept it now! I really like Kudou Kanae!
messages.5591: ".....Alright! This is the awakening of my love!"
messages.5636: In the middle of the deserted hallway, I made a guts pose.
messages.5895:
Thanks to Kotori's advice, I started acceping my feelings
bit by bit.
messages.5979:
But even that didn't stop me from worrying endlessly daya
fter day...
messages.6073:
As I was strolling in deep thought, a chase between Miharu
and Suginami led to me injuring my finger.
messages.6176:
Thanks to my trip to the infiramary after, I foudn out that
Kudou was really a woman.
messages.6252:
Now with my mind perfectly clear, I made a large guts pose
in the empty hallway.

messages.179:
With the lights switched on, I stared at the ceiling while
lying on my bed, thinking of Kudou.
messages.253: Maybe what I saw at lunch break was an illusion...
messages.286: Since after that, Kudou never returned to class.
messages.344:
As time passed, I started doubting whether what I saw was
the truth.
messages.393:
I see pink bears after all. It wouldn't be too much of a
stretch to call that a hallucination.
messages.463: No, but... I saw it with my own eyes...
messages.504: "...I may not have thought about it calmly."
messages.545: Yeah, I don't really have trust in even my own eyes anymore.
messages.612:
The telephone started ringing outside, but figuring Nemu
would get it, I didn't move one inch.
messages.877:
I've relied on other people to do things like that for so
long, I've forgotten that I have to do them myself now.
messages.1007: I sighed as I got up from bed.
messages.1168:
My heartbeat sped up several notches at the sound of the
voice.
messages.1277: I returned the greeting, and a bout of silence ensued.
messages.1327: "Um.... about today... did you see anything?"
messages.1368: Finally breaking the silence, Kudou started to speak.
messages.1440:
"W, what thing? You mean, the thing about you being a
girl..."
messages.1571: I spoke too directly without thinking again...
messages.1664: I apologized in a tiny voice.
messages.1748: Her tone was serious, as she implored me.
messages.1830: All lost at sea, I somehow got my question out.
messages.1913: That reply made me worry a little.
messages.1959: I didn't know what to say to Kudou's question.
messages.2013: Apparently the reason is an uncomfortable one for her.
messages.2040: But I like her, and I want to know more about her.
messages.2085:
I'm interested in what's going on, and whether I can help in
any way.
messages.2167:
Yet at this point, I didn't want to trouble her too much
with questions...
messages.2269:
"...Alright. Tomorrow... can you go to the Sakura Park? I'd
explain everything there."
messages.2353: Her quick response left me at a loss for words.
messages.2454:
I'd completely forgotten what I wanted to say. My sweaty
hand was gripping the receiver tightly, until just a dial
tone remained.
messages.2630: I put the receiver back on it's place.
messages.2659: What's she going to tell me tomorrow...
messages.2837: That night, I received a call from Kudou.
messages.2878:
When I asked her why she disguised herself as a man, she
said that she'd explain everything at the Sakura Park
tomorrow.
messages.2956: Leaving that thought behind, her voice left my ears.

messages.255:
Just as the line was cut yesterday, I wanted to ask what
time to met...
messages.331: But I couldn't get it through.
messages.405:
I felt a tiny bit of happiness that I could meet Kudou
again.
messages.478:
I can't forget the sad tone of "her" voice before she hung
up.
messages.542: "Just what is she going to tell me?"
messages.581:
I sat on my bench with arms outstretched on it, a layer of
flower petals slowly enveloping them.
messages.649: "Haha, I look like a guy who just got rejected..."
messages.694:
I looked around countless times, trying to find the familiar
school uniform.
messages.758: But Kudou's figure never showed up.
messages.871:
I turned my head towards the direction where the voice came
from.
messages.976:
Standing there, was a gentle-looking young girl, dressed in
a kimono, with a slightly embarassed smile.
messages.1064: The short-cut hair and kimono went very well together.
messages.1215:
No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't place this girl from
anywhere in my memories.
messages.1305: Amazed, the girl let out a slight giggle and murmured.
messages.1386: "Sheesh, you're really really slow... you idiot, Asakura."
messages.1557: Nowhere to run... she continued smiling at me.
messages.1694:
Kudou's family spanned several generations. Being the only
child, she was grilled to perfection in morals and
behaviour.
messages.1846:
"To ensure that I would have no thoughts of illicit romance,
I was to conceal myself as a male in school..."
messages.1987:
"...And that's what the head of your family, your
grandmother, said?"
messages.2099:
It sounded more like a plot from some manga, but that was
the reality placed before me.
messages.2167: After a short pause, Kudou continued.
messages.2236:
"The times where my true identity as a female was
discovered, I was immediately transferred into a different
school."
messages.2337: "That's crazy! What about your own feelings!?"
messages.2435: "The head of the family's orders... cannot be opposed."
messages.2484:
"Customs or discpline or whatever, that's completely
unreasonable... I'm not satisfied with that outcome at all."
messages.2574:
Ah, I'm not trying to make your grandmother out to be some
horrible person though...
messages.2721:
A little smile began to grow on Kudou's cheeks from my
words.
messages.2815:
"Please... I don't want to be taken away from my class, or
Kazami Academy."
messages.2907: She stared at me, her eyes pleading.
messages.2943: "So please, keep my secret... between you and me..."
messages.2999: Kudou bowed so deeply, I couldn't bear to watch it.
messages.3069: "D, don't do that, lift your head."
messages.3108: Haah, I'm doomed. I can't win against something like that.
messages.3166: This girl, and such a sad story...
messages.3217:
"...If that's your wish, I'd make sure no one else finds
out."
messages.3295: After a quick cough, I gave her my word.
messages.3406: Kudou lifted his head, slightly surprised.
messages.3441:
"It'd be bad for me if you left as well. I can't take
Suginami's crap by myself."
messages.3585:
Kudou peered at me for awhile... then a beautiful smile grew
on her face.
messages.3759:
Alarm bells were ringing in my heart... my cheeks started to
flare.
messages.3819: "And... it'd be nice for the two of us to share a secret..."
messages.4002:
Trying to hide my embarassment, I quickly stood up from the
bench.
messages.4080:
"S, since we're out here already... let's have a drink
somewhere."
messages.4152: I held out my head to her.
messages.4238:
A little hesitant at first, Kudou then smiled and held my
hand while getting up from the bench.
messages.4320: I regretfully released her snow-white, cold palm.
messages.4369: "Ah, since it was my invitation, I'd treat you this time."
messages.4624:
We walked together to a coffeeshop at the nearby shopping
district.
messages.4678: And we then just whiled the time away...
messages.4715:
Yet, it was some of the most satisfying time I had ever
spent.
messages.4938: At the place where Kudou and I promised to meet,
messages.4963:
In front of me, was the pretty kimono-clad girl, Kudou
Kanae.
messages.5015:
Kudou's reason for pretending to be a guy was because of the
order's of the head of her family.
messages.5083:
And if it were to be revealed that she was a girl, she would
immediately be transferred.
messages.5169:
Promising to keep her secret, and prevent others from
learning her secret, we spent the rest of the day idly, yet
happily.

messages.220:
"Next up, we have some shocking news on the unwithering
sakura petals."
messages.321:
My ears picked up at the words, as I turned away from my
toast and to the TV.
messages.410:
"A man passing by the giant sakura tree has alerted us that
the giant sakura tree, famous in hatsunejima, has lost it's
petals."
messages.545:
...I couldn't believe what I was hearing, but the news then
brought us a visual.
messages.623:
It was the ever-present giant sakura tree. However, I was
seeing it in a way I had never seen it before.
messages.794:
"The reason for this is currently unknown, however, the
island's research centre are working on their
investigation..."
messages.895:
With a sudden change of tone, the newcaster moved on to the
next news story.
messages.957: I switched the television off with the remote control.
messages.1011:
"...Well, this isn't a volcanic eruption or something,
shouldn't worry about something that's already happened."
messages.1085:
Although I said that, a tiny part of me couldn't help
worrying.
messages.1141:
After all, this isn't the world's biggest and most famous
sakura tree for nothing.
messages.1223: Those sakura petals -- they aren't normal sakura petals.
messages.1318:
Koyomi-sensei won't exactly accept thought over the wilting
sakura petals as an acceptable excuse for tardiness.
messages.1415:
I walked to Kazami Academy, with it's students behind and in
front of me.
messages.1462:
As I casually overheard some of their conversations, the
subject was obvious.
messages.1540:
"Hey, have you heard? Those sakura petals have withered...
it's unbelievable!"
messages.1631: I knew exactly what she was feeling.
messages.1670:
Anyone who just woke up from sleep to see the sight of that
bald giant sakura tree; it's nearly impossible to believe.
messages.1765:
But now, God had taken his scissors and returned what was an
abnormality in the world back to normalcy.
messages.1929:
"Bah, no use talking about crap like that. It just finally
gave up, that's all."
messages.2023:
The next voice I heard was a particularly uncaring one, full
of self-enjoyment and irresponsibility.
messages.2101: Well, I can't say I'm not like that sometimes either.
messages.2292: "Did you see, on TV? The sakura petals have withered."
messages.2446:
"It's so surprising to see them all withered like that. In
my mind, I thought it would be blooming forever."
messages.2618:
"Well, I guess this means we have to postpone any more
flower-viewing sesssions for next year, haha...ha?"
messages.2721: What's happening? She's looking oddly depressed today...
messages.2844:
"What's wrong? You're looking down... are you having a
headache again?"
messages.2912:
Remembering Kotori's problems with it before, I brought it

"If you really have any problems, don't be afraid to tell

I met Kotori in front of the classroom, but she seemed

I idly played with the bread packet I was holding. 20

That we'd both come to this bench was almost an unwritten

I arrived first, so I decided to wait for Kotori. Of course

She didn't look good during the lessons. Maybe she went
there to rest...

I stood up ready to check there, when I saw Kotori's figure

Kotori's hands were unusually empty. She'd normally be

handkerchief.

I placed my hand on her shoulder, causing her to jump in

"Ah, I, I'm sorry... I'm just thinking... about
something..."

Feeling bad myself for disturbing her, I started opening my
bread packet.

Kotori opened the can, and took a mouthful of the black tea.

sigh.
messages.2004:
She continued staring at the floor, not uttering a single

messages.2088:
"Kotori, if you're not feeling well, maybe you should leave

messages.2223:
Her shoulders were drooping, giving me the impression of

I was waiting for Kotori for our usual lunch break at the
courtyard.

She eventually arrived after 20 minutes, but she didn't look
good at all.

messages.324: "Ah... sorry... I didn't mean to scare you..."

"Ahh, classes are over. If you don't have anything to do,

The classroom was already empty of people. Kotori feebly
nodded, and I placed my bag on my desk.

The only sounds were that of the other students walking down
the corridor.
messages.822:
Everything else was silent. The conversation had stopped.
She just walked silently behind me.
messages.900:
I didn't have a mouth on the back of my head... why was she
walking so lifelessly behind me?
messages.992:
...But I felt like asking her anything now would be like
talking to a wall.

messages.1147:
I don't remember who exactly-- I still hadn't gotten far
enough to match names to faces.
messages.1209:
The footsteps faded away quickly behind us. I stopped

messages.1358:
"...That girl just now was one of our classmates, wasn't

I shrugged my shoulders, and resumed walking. After a short

I thought Kotori would normally smile and say goodbye to our

I turned my head around and stated talking again. Her face

That's what I wanted to think, but I knew inside that that

But if Kotori won't say anything about it, there's nothing I

She smiled weakly. She was like a small animal with a gun

messages.2527: With a little bow, Kotori walked off.
messages.2609: "(Wait, she did say she didn't like using the phone.)"

I watched her back disappear into the horizon, then left

I walked Kotori to the school hate. She was still feeling
down.

messages.211:
Just like yesterday, Kotori still seemed depressed today.
She seemed drained of any vitality.

Our classmates, sensing something wrong, decided not to
interfere with her and talk among themselves instead.
messages.393: Kotori was definitely giving off a different air than usual.
messages.447: "Alright, good morning~ Return to your desks."
messages.486:
At Koyomi-sensei's voice, my senses went to the blackboard

messages.733:
Just like yesterday, Kotori was still depressed. Her head
dropped, and she sighed constantly.

I started speaking to Kotori, still sitting at her desk

She looked up at me. I swallowed down a moan of despair that

The blood and spirit had entirely left her pale face. Her

messages.464:
It's as if someone replaced some of Kotori's facial parts

She forced a smile as she asked, tilting her head. I pointed

messages.755: "...Kotori, did you check a mirror this morning?"
messages.871: "...I am a girl, of course I do."
messages.919:
"Really, what happened yesterday? Were you just ill? Or do

now..."
messages.1097: "...I'm worried about you, Kotori... after all..."
messages.1146: I paused for a second, then continued.
messages.1260:
"Of course I am. A boyfriend who wouldn't be worried would

As I talked, the door in front of us was closed shut. Kotori

messages.1396: Kotori then shook her head, and started speaking.
messages.1614:
What on earth is happening? Her appearance is weird, and her

messages.1690:
She was struggling to even get anything out of her throat. I

messages.1768: It was really like talking to a wall.
messages.1791:
That was the Kotori in front of me right now. I couldn't
reach her with my hands.
messages.1905: That was all I could think of.
messages.2006:
As soon as the chime went off, Kotori returned to the
classroom. The conversation was obviously making her
uncomfortable...
messages.2204:
As I thought about it, I could've easily said something that
hurt her without realizing it.
messages.2294: Even something then seems to have affected her so deeply.
messages.2387: Kotori and I love each other. A whole lot.
messages.2453: The feelings of love bind our hearts as well.
messages.2498: The bind is bing and strong...
messages.2539:
So the only one who could hurt her this badly... would be
the one she's with?
messages.2801:
What's really up with Kotori? Worried, I called her over to
a corner of the corridot to talk.
messages.2912:
But Kotori didn't want to, and ran away at the first
possible opportunity.

messages.260: I took a quick check of the school clock.
messages.328: My watch appears to be working fine...

messages.410:
She's usually 30 minutes early, but today, she wasn't here
at all.
messages.472: Well, she's human after all, she could've just slept in.
messages.586: Maybe she caught a cold or fever...

messages.1118: It seemed like she was on the verge of collapse.
messages.1176: "Are you okay? You don't look so hot..."

It was obvious that her body was being strained to the
limit.
messages.1405:
"The headaches have been getting worse recently... medicine

messages.1489: "Why don't you rest for awhile at school?"
messages.1536: Tamaki silently shook her head no.
messages.1640: "It'd be okay if you take a break from it for one day."
messages.1859: A giggle escaped from her lips.
messages.1888:
But it looked so out-of-place, with the condition she was

messages.2179: "I'm happy that you wanted to see me so badly, but..."
messages.2275: "If it makes you collapse... it's not worth it."
messages.2350: Tamaki hung her head, and slowly opened her mouth.
messages.2423: "I'm sorry for making you worry... but..."
messages.2515: "I'm the one who would know my body best..."
messages.2655: Tamaki gave me a smile with all she could.
messages.2696: But even then, she seemed so pained to do so.
messages.2774: I couldn't bear to see it...
messages.2801: Why on earth is Tamaki pushing herself so hard?
messages.2859: It's not like she's gaining anything from it...

I said I would support her, but it seemed like I was failing

messages.2975:
What's driving her to the wall so much that she'd go to
these lengths?

messages.3120: Isn't just telling her not to overdo it, enough?

Dejected, I took Tamaki's hand, and entered the school
grounds.

Tamaki and I arranged to meet in the morning, but she wasn't

Eventually she arrived, and delivered to me the news that

messages.3920:
I told her not to push herself just to come to school, but

messages.4029:
I'm really happy she cares so much for me, but that's too
much...

messages.187:
"I tired of playing with these bags... they're not toys

messages.269:
"The black tea as well... I should've bought a cold
drink..."

I shielded my eyes from the glaring spring sun, as I

messages.643: Thinking that, the words couldn't come out.

I wanted to know what I did to hurt her. If I knew, I'd

messages.793: Never to hurt her so badly again.

A direct hit. Kotori looked up at me with a sense of

"You've been feeling so bad lately because of something I

"What was it that I said? Please tell me... I'd never say it

I held on to Kotori's shoulders. At my touch, her shoulders

"I just feel a little sick, that's all. I figured I'd leave

Hoping against hope, I started the process to create a

I placed my hand behind my back, and started thinking of a

There's 2 people who know that I can do that, and they're

The Kotori now is like a small bird who's forgotten how to

I absentmindedly played with the bread I was holding. I'd

I thought that her recently poor mood was due to something I

Along with the mystery, apparently Kotori knew about it as

messages.3572: Just what on earth is happening?

Kotori said that I hadn't done anything. That she was just

While I was thinking and walking, I ended up coming here for

"I'm sure you've noticed it as well... that girl has been

"I know this should be a wonderful time... just spending

At Koyomi-sensei's words, I returned from my sea of

"Well, in any case, whatever reason she has, don't get

I couldn't imagine myself changing; I'm always as cheerful

"I'd like to have your number. So that I can call you if

"And in the same vein, if you find out anything, phone me

I carefully entered each number, then erased it, and

As if reading my mind, she attacked with a grin. I

Koyomi-sensei's face suddenly tightened, and showed a

"This reminds me of old times. When that girl was small,

While thinking about Kotori, I randomly ended up at the

She was worried about Kotori's recent depression, and wanted

Of course, that power doesn't happen every night. There's

I somehow got the feeling that just maybe, I'd entirely lost

"Hm? Ahh, Asakura. You want to know about Kotori, I

"Yeah... her condition really does seem bad. She couldn't

She spread her arms out in disgust and sighed. But I knew it

I watched her back get smaller and smaller, thinking to

"(If I still had my dream-seeing powers, I could probably

"Ahh, sorry for the wait. That girl misunderstood the time

to marry, and vice versa, is OK.
messages.2701:
It was quite sudden and rather grandoise, but those were
both my and her honest feelings after all.

spent trying to convince her grandmother that I was the one.
messages.2862:
And what finally convinced her was the phone call I made out
of pure, honest intentions from my heart.
messages.3150:
"That time, when you told me "farewell", and when you never
called anymore, you really got me worried, you know."
messages.3258:
"But it's because of that, that we're walking side by side
now, no?"
messages.3330:

didn't like us getting close, and that was to be our last
time.
messages.3353:

otherwise. That was the power of our love.

Because of that, we were going to her house for me to
officially meet her family.

I held a box of cakes in my arms as a present. Of course, I
bought it from a reknowned Japanese confectionery store.
messages.3581:
The elegant, yet cute wrapping that the store uses, made it
popular among women, both old and young.
messages.3817:
Holding a present, and visiting the family of your loved
one.
messages.3852:
I can't say I know the exact details... but it's like
exchanging engagement gifts.
messages.3891: In short, it's like Kanae and I getting engaged...
messages.3961:
Realizing just what kind of position I was one, I started to
blush deep red.
messages.4000:
"I don't really know whether this present will go over well
at this time of the year either..."
messages.4056:
Looking at the bag dangling from my hand, Kanae's smile grew
even wider.
messages.4121:
"I love Sakuramochi! I'd ask grandmother to make her tea,
and the three of us should eat it together."
messages.4291: There's no doubt what I like better, though.
messages.4338:
...And I couldn't say that for fear of being even more
embarassed.
messages.4387: "Ah-, but I know absolutely nothing about tea ceremonies..."
messages.4453:
Just realizing it myself, I started scratching the back of
my head.
messages.4536:
"Don't worry, don't worry! I'd teach you everything you need
to know! Before you enter the tea room, you have to..."
messages.4655:
"Ahahahahaha! There's lots of time, so I'd teach you

messages.4750: "--We have plenty of time left, after all!"
messages.4982:
Under the clear blue summer sky, Kanae and I, in full formal
dress, walked together.
messages.5031:
The one way that Kanae and I could be together... that was
to be her life partner, and live that way for the rest of my
life.
messages.5113:
Thanks to that, I was on my way to meet her family
officially. Kanae told me to just act normally, but I was
still full of nervousness.。
messages.5212: Watching me struggle, Kanae simply laughed radiantly.
messages.5249:
Under the blue cherry trees in leaf, we steadily walked hand
in hand.

I ate it as she instructed...... but I can't tell the

I'm not familiar with any books, but they look like

Sakura's house is decorated in Japanese style. I feel

messages.116: A witch used to live in this house.
messages.153:
The house isn't exactly shabby, but isn't new either. There
could be a ghost living in this old Japanese house.
messages.260:
I used to look over the hedge into the house on the way to
school.
messages.338:
I wasn't interested in the building itself, but rather the
old lady who used to sit on the porch in the sun, holding a
white cat.
messages.471:
The old lady was a foreigner, with blonde hair and blue
eyes.
messages.541:
What always sticks out in my memory is not her appearance
but her happy face.
messages.623:
As a matter of fact, she's my grandmother on my mother's
side, and we were renting her house, but I never had the
chance to talk with her.
messages.757: One day when I was looking into her house, I met her gaze.
messages.871: She spoke in clear and beautiful Japanese.
messages.924: I did as she said and walked through the gate.
messages.982: It was a cozy yard with the smell of cherry blossoms.
messages.1086: I bowed my head without saying anything.
messages.1135: I don't mean I disliked her. I just didn't know what to say.
messages.1207: She seemed carefre, she kept sitting on the porch smiling.
messages.1333: 'Of course I can', I said like a little child.
messages.1422: She put down her white cat in the yard.
messages.1459: The cat purred to grandma and ran away.
messages.1585: After she spoke, she showed me her empty hand.
messages.1639: There was no snack on her hand.
messages.1686:
Grandma grinned teasingly, looking at my sulky face, and
then closed her hand slowly.
messages.1760:
She opened her hand, and this time I saw a small steamed
bean-jam bun there.
messages.1894:
After she said that, she leaned forward as if to prevent
anyone else hearing, and then smiled with her finger on her
lips.
messages.2041: I can't make any promise until I know what it is.
messages.2086: Grandma smiled with my answer in satisfaction.
messages.2159:
"I know you understand the importance of the promise. So I
will tell you this, but don't tell your mom!"
messages.2285: "I am a magician. To be precise, I am a witch."
messages.2351: I imagined a black hat, a black coat and a black cat.
messages.2403: None of them could fit my image of grandma at all.
messages.2474: "You saw my cat, didn't you? It is white, though."
messages.2511:
Laughing playfully, she put a steamed bean-jam bun on my
hand.
messages.2567: It felt real -- or rather, it was.
messages.2621: Why does a witch live here?
messages.2673: I asked her, sitting on the porch.
messages.2723: "Because I fell in love with somebody."
messages.2754:
Grandma blushed and gave the most beautiful smile I've ever
seen.
messages.2818: But I really didn't know what she meant.
messages.2956:
Grandma laughs, pressing a finger against my bun-filled
cheek.
messages.3031: "I guess I loved Japanese snacks too much."
messages.3109:
She didn't move house, but she's gone forever from this
life.
messages.3163:
The fact is, a witch who loved Japanese snacks lived in this
house.
messages.3252: I have the same blood in my veins.
messages.3431: A dream about my grandma -- I mean a witch.
messages.3472:
My grandma used to live next door, and told me that she was
a witch.
messages.3558:
She came to Japan because she loved Japanese snacks, and she
can make them appear from nowhere.
messages.3634:
And she lost the rest of her magic power after she fell in
love with somebody.
